description:
What will you love about this role? 

 At 3P Learning, we're not just creating educational products; we're crafting masterpieces that set the gold standard in global EdTech excellence. Our products are not just tools; they're tickets to learning adventures loved by millions of children worldwide! 

 If you are ready to dive into a role that’s not just a job, then look no further, because at 3P Learning, we’re on a mission to revolutionize education and have a blast while doing it! 

 We are seeking an experienced Sales Development Representative to join our Sales team. The SDR team is focused on ensuring our products are first and foremost in the hearts and minds of teachers, educators, and our ultimate end user – the kids! 

 If you are a client-centric, task-driven individual with an ability to build trust and rapport with educators combined with the ability to listen, understand, and align 3P’s value propositions, then we welcome your submission. 

 What you will be doing… 
 You will be responsible for providing sales support to the new business sales team. Primary areas of focus will include proactive and reactive management of both inbound and outbound client inquiries and outreach, top-of-funnel lead management, and CRM management. 

 Ideally, you will have 

 1+ year(s) of successful Sales Support or Sales Development experience in a busy software-focused sales environment or target-driven background. Preference will be given to candidates with EdTech experience or a background in K-12 Education. 

 Embodies sales and passionately showcases their love for curating new leads with an intense commitment to our pursuit of excellence. 

 Experience or familiarity with the Education sector within Canada and the United States. 

 Experience and aptitude for software solutions including CRM tools such as Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Gong. 

 Ability to research and compile data and materials to drive actions. 

 As this position involves considerable liaison with clients at all levels, excellent interpersonal skills, in particular communication skills, are essential. 

 Conviction, follow-up, resilience, and an internal drive for success. 

 Highly organized with an ability to proactively prioritize and manage your time. 

 Client-centric in everything you do. 

 Ideally, you will be 

 A great communicator – both verbal and written. You must be able to smile and dial the phone, hold a conversation, listen, adapt, and educate K-12 Teachers, Principals and District leaders on 3P’s software product offerings. Equally proficient at creating a clear and effective email or sales campaign. 

 Outbound lead generation and follow-up for our Business Development Managers. 

 Updating and managing prospect information in our CRM (Salesforce) to ensure efficient lead management. 

 Following up on sales campaigns created in Gong. 

 Thrive being busy! The sales environment is never on pause. 

 We offer equal employment opportunities for all employees and provide employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. 

 We look forward to sharing more about 3P, our fantastic products, and our great culture with you soon!

description:
Acceler8 Labs is where growth gets personal. 

 We’re a performance marketing company founded by two former Facebookers who decided to build something better after seeing the gap between traditional agencies and the real needs of modern brands. 

 We believe scale isn’t about bigger budgets but smarter decisions. Our team has helped brands across the globe generate over $1 billion in revenue by combining sharp strategy, bold creativity, and hands-on execution. 

 We’re designed for the digital era, where everything evolves at the speed of light. Our work evolves alongside it, adapting to the industries, platforms, and audiences we help grow. 

 We partner with some of the world’s fastest-growing brands, from disruptive startups to global household names, to turn marketing spend into measurable business growth. 

 About the Role 

We're looking for a full-time Paid Search Specialist who can turn search intent into measurable business growth. 

 This isn't a role where you'll simply manage campaigns from a checklist. You'll own performance across a portfolio of ecommerce brands, building, optimizing, and scaling Google Ads programs that directly impact revenue. 

 You'll work across Google Ads, Google Merchant Center, GA4, and Performance Max, treating data as a feedback loop rather than a report card. You'll partner closely with clients, our creative team, and paid social specialists to ensure every campaign works as part of a broader growth strategy. 

 The brands you'll support are ambitious ecommerce businesses that rely on us to make smart decisions with every advertising dollar. Your success will be measured by the business outcomes you generate, not simply impressions or clicks. 

 As a Paid Search Specialist, you will: 

 Own paid search strategy across a portfolio of ecommerce clients within Google Ads and Performance Max 

 Build, launch, and optimize campaigns focused on revenue growth and profitability 

 Manage Google Merchant Center, ensuring product feeds remain healthy, accurate, and optimized 

 Analyze campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve ROAS, CPA, and overall account efficiency 

 Conduct keyword research, search query analysis, and ad testing to continuously improve performance 

 Partner directly with clients through regular reporting, strategic recommendations, and day-to-day account management 

 Collaborate with our creative team to align search campaigns with broader acquisition strategies 

 Manage budgets and bidding strategies while treating every client dollar like your own 

 Stay ahead of platform updates, automation, and emerging search products to give clients an early mover advantage 

 You’ll thrive in this role if you: 

 Have 2+ years of agency experience managing Google Ads for ecommerce brands 

 Have hands-on experience with Performance Max, Shopping campaigns, Search, and Google Merchant Center 

 Have managed meaningful monthly media budgets while maintaining profitability targets 

 Understand ecommerce metrics including ROAS, MER, CPA, and customer acquisition 

 Are comfortable presenting strategy and performance directly to clients 

 Can balance multiple client accounts without sacrificing quality 

 Are curious about automation, AI, and emerging Google Ads features 

 Communicate clearly and confidently with both clients and teammates 

 Thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve quickly 

 Live in Canada (we're a remote-first team) 

 Why Acceler8 Labs? 

 We built Acceler8 to bridge the gap between agencies and brands, replacing complexity with clarity and collaboration. Our model is rooted in three pillars: Fuel (media), Spark (creative), and Insight (analytics), each designed to move faster, think smarter, and deliver measurable impact. 

 Here you’ll have the room to experiment, fail fast, and learn even faster. Your ideas won’t get lost in a Slack thread. You’ll be part of a team that values transparency, curiosity, and craftsmanship. 

 We take care of our people so they can take care of their work, their families, and themselves. 

 We offer: 

 Remote workdays so you can design a schedule that works for your rhythm 

 Flexible hours because great work can happen anywhere (and we trust you to know where that is) 

 Comprehensive benefits to make sure you and your family are supported, healthy, and cared for 

 Learning and certification opportunities to help you grow your craft, not just your title 

 Real autonomy because we believe in hiring smart people and giving them the space to do great work 

 The chance to build something that scales for our clients, and for you 

 If you’re ready to join a team that’s redefining what performance marketing looks like, we’d love to chat.

We take care of our people so they can take care of their work, their families, and themselves.

  • Flexible hours because great work can happen anywhere (and we trust you to know where that is) 
  • Comprehensive benefits to make sure you and your family are supported, healthy, and cared for 
  • Learning and certification opportunities to help you grow your craft, not just your title
  • Real autonomy because we believe in hiring smart people and giving them the space to do great work 
  • The chance to build something that scales for our clients, and for you


If you’re ready to join a team that’s redefining what performance marketing looks like, we’d love to chat.

description:
About Verve 

 At Verve, we’re redefining how insight works in an AI-powered world. We combine Human, Cultural and Artificial Intelligence to help leading brands make faster, smarter decisions with confidence.

 Through Verve Vero – our AI-powered platform and consultancy ecosystem – we turn human truth into living simulations, giving teams the ability to bring their customers into any decision. The result is insight that’s faster, more scalable, and grounded in real human understanding.

 The Role 

 This is a client-facing, mid-level insight leadership role focused on delivering AI-powered insight projects.

 You’ll act as the day-to-day lead on projects , owning delivery from end to end – working closely with senior leads to shape direction, while managing junior team members to execute high-quality work.

 A core part of the role is learning and applying our AI-enabled simulation tools . You won’t be expected to come in as an expert, but you will be expected to get hands-on – building, shaping, and interpreting simulations as part of your project work.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Commercial Leadership & Client Delivery 

 Lead end-to-end delivery of AI-powered insight programmes across multiple high-value client accounts.

 Act as a trusted senior advisor , shaping briefs, guiding clients through AI-enabled approaches, and constructively challenging thinking where needed.

 Own scoping, resourcing, timelines and budgets , translating business objectives into clear, actionable plans and ensuring work is commercially sound and drives real business impact.

 Identify opportunities to grow client relationships and support new business through pitches and proposals.

 Technical Delivery & Innovation 

 Interest in how AI capabilities (such as large language models, machine learning, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation models ) can enhance insight delivery and efficiency

 We’ll provide training and guidance on the tools and processes that power our AI-enabled solutions.

 Experience applying AI to insight workflows or automation is a plus, but not essential – curiosity and a willingness to learn matter most.

 Any technical experience (e.g. coding or working with APIs) is a bonus. 

 Proactive, lateral thinker – able to solve problems, comfortable operating in ambiguity and helping shape structure as new approaches evolve.

 Work closely with specialist teams to test, refine and embed smarter, faster and more scalable tools into delivery.

 Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and scalability through AI-enabled approaches.

 Stay close to developments in AI, applying them pragmatically to client work.

 Team Leadership & Collaboration 

 Lead, coach and develop Senior Consultants, Consultants and Associates, building confidence across client leadership and evolving capabilities.

 Set clear expectations that balance quality, efficiency and commercial discipline. 

 Partner closely with Sales, Consultancy and Operational teams to deliver joined-up client programmes.

 Shape Build Studio standards and best practice , acting as a visible role model for curiosity, adaptability and ownership.

 What We’re Looking For: 

 5–8 years’ experience. Commercial insight background (at a market research agency or client-side) is essential. 

 Ability to translate briefs into clear, commercially impactful research programmes. 

 Confidence operating as a senior client advisor. With experience leading complex delivery and building relationships.

 Strong commercial judgement across scoping, resourcing, and profitability.

 Curiosity about how AI can enhance insight delivery, with an openness to build capability (experience is a bonus, not essential).

 Ability to quickly learn new technical tools and ways of working.

 Leadership style that builds confidence and capability in others.

 Strong organisational skills , managing multiple projects, deadlines and stakeholders.

 Clear, confident communicator – able to explain complex ideas simply and align teams.

 A growth mindset – comfortable working in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where the model is still evolving.

 UK-based candidate . Able to work from our Manchester or London Hub at least once per week.

 Join Us 

If you’re excited by the potential of AI to change the research landscape and want to be part of a team that’s shaping the future, we’d love to hear from you.

 At Verve you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects, expand your insight, management and AI skill set , and grow in a supportive environment that thrives on innovation and impact.

 By applying to Verve, you acknowledge our use of AI-assisted tools to help screen applications against job-related criteria. All outcomes are reviewed by humans and are not determinative. You can request human review, express your views, or contest any assessment at any time via privacymanagement@addverve.com . Full details of the Privacy Notice can be found here: Privacy Notice

description:
A.I.S., Inc. (AIS) is a national scientific services firm supporting maritime activities requiring certification of compliance with environmental regulations as well as collecting data for use by Federal, State, Municipal, and other government agencies along the US coastline. 

 Primary Function: 

 AIS is recruiting Protected Species Observers (PSO) to deploy on a project during pile removal operations in New York. AIS is looking for individuals with NMFS unconditional PSO approval letters to stand watch while pile removal operations are under way to record data on protected species sightings and to implement mitigation measures when necessary. Operations will be conducted during daylight hours only and PSO will have an average of 8-12 hours of work per day. This position is expected to start late September of 2026 for approximately 2 - 3 weeks of work 

 Duties/Responsibilities: 

 Identify marine animals using the naked eye and visual technology. 

 Ability to vigilantly monitor for visual detections of marine mammals around observation location for up to 10 hours in a 24-hour period. 

 Documenting behavior and other essential data 

 Documenting data on logs in an organized manner 

 Operate and maintain field equipment including Garmin GPS, binoculars with reticles, range finder, and high-resolution digital camera with video capabilities. 

 Conduct personal QA/QC checks on data collected. 

 Attend daily toolbox, HSE and project related meetings as needed. 

 Compensation: Candidates will be paid an hourly rate to be negotiated. This is a full–time position and will be eligible for AIS benefits package after 30 days of employment. AIS benefits package includes health and dental insurance, vacation, sick and holiday benefits. 

 Minimum Qualifications: 

 Must have current STCW Basic Safety Training (BST), or GWO or BOSIET training. 

 Must have current CPR/First Aid certification. 

 4-year degree with major in biological or geophysical sciences 

 Must be certified by a physician as fit for sea duty including: 

 Not be susceptible to chronic motion sickness

description:
Director of Finance 

 Reports to: Chief Financial Officer

 Supervises: Controller (who supervises the accounting team)

 Status: Full-time, Exempt

 Leadership body: Operating Committee

 POSITION SUMMARY 

 The Director of Finance is a senior finance leader responsible for the integrity, transparency, and strategic stewardship of the Alaska Community Foundation’s financial operations. Working closely with the Chief Financial Officer, this position oversees fund accounting, financial reporting, internal controls, and regulatory compliance within a complex community foundation structure that includes donor-advised, restricted, endowment, and agency funds. The Director of Finance brings deep technical expertise in nonprofit GAAP and the ability to translate complex financial data into clear, actionable insights for leadership, board members, and stakeholders.

 The Director of Finance reviews, analyzes, and reports on the Foundation’s financial activity and supervises the Controller, who owns and executes the monthly and year-end close. The Director supports the CFO above and the Controller below—setting standards, reviewing results, and providing analysis and reporting—without performing the mechanics of the close. Close matters are routed to the Controller for execution.

 This position partners closely with executive leadership to ensure that the Foundation’s financial systems, policies, and reporting frameworks support organizational strategy, donor intent, and long-term sustainability. As a member of the Operating Committee, the Director of Finance contributes to cross-functional planning and organizational decision-making, and serves as a key bridge between the finance function and non-finance staff, program teams, and development and donor stewardship partners across the Foundation.

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

 Financial Leadership and Strategy 

 Serves as a strategic finance partner to the CFO, providing actionable financial insights to support decision-making and long-term organizational sustainability.

 Supports the CFO in long-range financial planning, scenario analysis, risk assessment, and organizational sustainability modeling.

 Contributes to enterprise-wide initiatives, including system implementations, policy development, and operational improvements.

 Translates technical financial concepts into clear guidance for non-finance staff, leadership, and board audiences.

 Fund Accounting and Financial Reporting 

 Provides oversight and technical review of fund accounting across donor-advised funds, restricted and unrestricted funds, endowments (including principal and spendable classifications), and agency and held-for-others funds in accordance with FASB ASC 958-605 and FASB ASC 958-810, with day-to-day execution performed by the Controller and accounting team.

 Ensures accurate classification and reporting of net assets with and without donor restrictions, including complex transactions such as multi-year pledges, discounting, and contribution revenue recognition.

 Reviews and analyzes the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements prepared by the Controller, and presents them to the CFO.

 Delivers timely budget-to-actual reporting at organizational and departmental levels, including year-to-date and period-specific analysis.

 Close Process and Financial Operations 

 Sets close standards and continuously improves the month-end and year-end close framework, and reviews the close executed by the Controller with a focus on accuracy, analysis, timeliness, and reporting—rather than performing close mechanics directly.

 Reviews reconciliations of all key accounts—including cash, investments, pledges receivable, and liabilities—completed by the accounting team under the Controller.

 Oversees cash management, including banking relationships and treasury functions.

 Maintains oversight of accounts payable, accounts receivable, and disbursement cycles, including grantmaking disbursements.

 Internal Controls and Compliance 

 Designs, implements, and monitors a robust internal control environment aligned with nonprofit best practices and audit requirements, with control execution carried out by the Controller and accounting team.

 Ensures compliance with nonprofit GAAP, federal and state regulations, and organizational policy across all finance functions.

 Develops and maintains finance policies covering expenditure authority, credit card and expense management, grant approval workflows, and revenue recognition and pledge accounting.

 Partners with external auditors and oversees audit preparation, which is coordinated operationally by the Controller on behalf of the finance team.

 Systems and Process Optimization 

 Serves as the finance lead for core systems including Community Suite (fund accounting), grant management and reporting platforms, and banking and credit card platforms.

 Drives system enhancements, integrations, and process automation to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.

 Develops scalable processes that support organizational growth and increasing operational complexity.

 Grantmaking and Financial Oversight 

 Oversees financial controls and workflows related to grant voucher approvals and disbursements.

 Ensures compliance with donor intent, fund restrictions, and organizational policies across all grantmaking activity.

 Partners with program and development teams to support accurate, compliant, and timely grant financial activity.

 Team and Operational Leadership 

 Supervise and develop the Controller, and through the Controller support the growth, performance, and continuous improvement of the accounting team.

 Develop and manage departmental budgets, work plans, and performance metrics in alignment with organizational goals and financial oversight responsibilities.

 Foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement across the finance function.

 Work across departments to ensure finance operations align with ACF’s strategic priorities and organizational values.

 Operating Committee Participation 

 Serve as an active member of the Operating Committee, contributing to cross-functional planning and organizational decision-making.

 Bring a financial stewardship and risk management lens to foundation-wide initiatives and ensure consistent fiscal positioning across the organization.

 QUALIFICATIONS 

 Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field required; CPA or advanced degree preferred.

 Eight to twelve or more years of progressive accounting and finance experience, with significant experience in nonprofit accounting, preferably within a community foundation or similar philanthropic organization.

 Demonstrated expertise in fund accounting and complex revenue recognition, including pledges, restricted gifts, and endowments.

 Deep knowledge of U.S. GAAP, specifically nonprofit standards under FASB ASC 958, including net asset classifications, endowment accounting, and agency versus owned fund structures.

 Experience working with auditors and leading financial statement preparation and audit processes.

 Experience with fund accounting systems such as Community Suite or similar platforms; advanced Excel and financial modeling skills.

 Strong communication skills, including the ability to present financial information clearly to executive leadership, finance committees, and board members.

 A commitment to Alaska, its communities, and the mission of the Alaska Community Foundation.

 CORE COMPETENCIES 

 Strategic financial leadership

 Technical expertise and accuracy

 Complexity management

 Systems and process orientation

 Cross-functional communication

 Integrity and mission alignment

 WORK ENVIRONMENT AND ACCESSIBILITY 

 We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. The physical, sensory, and environmental requirements described here represent the general nature of the role and are not intended to exclude individuals who can perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

 This role may involve a combination of desk-based and active work in a professional office or field environment. The position requires the ability to effectively engage in communication, operate standard office technology or job-related equipment, and perform the core responsibilities of the role.

 Reasonable accommodations will be provided in accordance with applicable laws to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

description:
Full Professor / Associate Professor / Assistant Professor of Interior Design 

 Classification: Academic Affairs

 Reports To: Dean of School of Architecture and Design

 About The American International University 

 American International University (AIU) is a private institution in Kuwait, founded in 2019, offering undergraduate programmes in Engineering and Computing, Architecture and Design, Business, Arts and Sciences, and Education, delivered in English on the American model of higher education. AIU serves a community of more than 3,000 students and is implementing the RISE Strategy 2026–2030, a five-year institutional transformation anchored in research development, WSCUC international accreditation, student success, employability, and community engagement.

 For more information, visit: www.aiu.edu.kw 

 School of Architecture & Design Profile 

 The School of Architecture and Design at the American International University in Kuwait comprises the disciplines of Architecture, Interior Design, and Graphic Design. The School offers undergraduate programmes designed to prepare students for professional practice through a combination of creative inquiry, technical expertise, and applied learning. 

 Position Overview 

 The School of Architecture and Design invites applications for a full-time faculty position in Interior Design at the rank of Full Professor, Associate Professor, or Assistant Professor, commensurate with the candidate’s qualifications and experience. The successful candidate will demonstrate excellence in studio-based teaching, an active record of research and/or professional practice, and expertise in contemporary interior design methodologies, technologies, and sustainable design principles.

 The successful candidate will contribute to undergraduate teaching, curriculum development, student mentorship, accreditation activities, and institutional service within a collaborative and multicultural academic environment.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Teaching and Curriculum Development: 

 Deliver innovative undergraduate studio and lecture courses in Interior Design, including but not limited to residential, commercial, and furniture design. 

 Integrate contemporary tools and platforms such as CAD, BIM (Revit), 3D modelling, and digital fabrication technologies into the curriculum. 

 Develop and update course content to reflect industry standards, professional competencies, and accreditation requirements (e.g., CIDA standards where applicable). 

 Guide students in senior capstone projects, portfolio development, and industry-standard practices. 

 Maintain rigorous assessment standards and studio critique methodologies

 Research, Scholarship, and Creative Activity: 

 Maintain an active research agenda and/or professional practice in Interior Design or related fields. 

 Publish scholarly work in peer-reviewed journals or present at reputable academic and professional conferences. 

 Contribute to professional practice, exhibitions, design competitions, or consultancy projects. 

 Engage in interdisciplinary collaborations and pursue external funding opportunities. 

 Service and Institutional Engagement: 

 Engage actively in departmental, school, and university committees. 

 Support program assessment, accreditation documentation, and quality assurance activities. 

 Participate in student recruitment, outreach initiatives, exhibitions, competitions, and community engagement. 

 Offer academic advising and mentorship to students. 

 Foster a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion within the academic community. 

 Required Qualifications 

 PhD in Interior Design

 A minimum of five years of experience in university-level teaching, with a proven record of excellence in delivering studio-based courses. 

 Strong portfolio showcasing professional and/or research-based design practice. 

 Proficiency in industry-standard tools and software such as AutoCAD, Revit (BIM), SketchUp, 3D Max, and Adobe Creative Cloud, along with rendering engines like V-Ray or Lumion. 

 Evidence of research, publication in peer-reviewed journals, or recognized creative practice. 

 Experience working effectively in multicultural and diverse academic environments. 

 Excellent written and oral communication skills in English. 

 Proven excellence in teaching undergraduate and/or graduate courses in Interior Design.

 A record of research, publications, and professional achievements in relevant disciplines.

 Experience with CIDA or similar accreditation standards.

 Knowledge of sustainable and emerging design practices.

 Relevant industry experience beyond academia.

 Experience supervising senior design projects.

 Demonstrated interdisciplinary collaboration and external funding experience.

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with a collaborative approach to teaching and research.

 Ability to integrate diverse cultural and ethical perspectives into the curriculum.

 Commitment to fostering an inclusive, multicultural academic environment that engages a diverse student body.

 Strong organizational skills and adaptability to meet the evolving needs of the university.

 How to Apply 

 Interested candidates should visit the Job Opportunities section on our website and submit a resume and cover letter via: https://aiu.edu.kw/careers/jobs 

 Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. The successful candidate is expected to commence employment in the Spring Semester 2027.

description:
Position Overview: 

 Anaqua is looking for an HR Associate to support our India-based workforce and partner closely with our global HR team. Reporting to the Sr. HR Regional Director in the U.S., this role is the day-to-day HR point of contact for employees in India — handling everything from statutory compliance and HRIS data to exit interview tracking and employee handbook maintenance. You'll work across time zones as part of a small, tight-knit regional HR function, with real involvement over the processes you run and regular visibility into cross-regional reporting and projects. 

 You'll Love This Job if You Like To: 

 Prepare recurring HR reports and dashboards for other departments and executives (headcount, attrition, leave utilization, and similar workforce metrics) 

 Assist with periodic reviews and updates to the Employee Handbook, as requested 

 Assist with managing onboarding and offboarding for India-based employees, including documentation, background verification, and exit formalities 

 Maintain accurate, up-to-date employee records in the HRIS 

 Support statutory compliance activities 

 Respond to employee questions on policies, benefits, and HR procedures 

 Assist with recruitment coordination — scheduling interviews, preparing offer letters, and tracking background checks 

 Support employee engagement and culture initiatives for the India team 

 Conduct internal audits to check HR process compliance and consistency 

 Partner with the Sr. HR Regional Director on ad hoc regional and global HR projects 

 Maintain a high level of confidentiality when handling sensitive employee information 

 Assist with any visa letters required for business travel 

 What You'll Need to Be Successful: 

 Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; or equivalent experience 

 2–4 years of progressive HR generalist or HR associate experience, ideally within a multinational or technology company 

 Working knowledge of Indian labor law and statutory compliance requirements (PF, ESI, Gratuity, POSH, Shops & Establishment Act) 

 Experience with an HRIS platform (e.g., BambooHR, ADP, Workday, or similar) 

 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to partner directly with a U.S.-based manager and stakeholders across time zones 

 High level of discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment with confidential information 

 Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail 

 Proficiency in MS Office particularly Excel for reporting is a requirement 

 Ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, and manage time well in a remote-reporting structure 

 Experience in the use of AI would be beneficial 

 About Anaqua 

 Anaqua, Inc. is a premium provider of integrated intellectual property (IP) management technology solutions and services. Anaqua's AQX platform combines best practice workflows with big data analytics and tech-enabled services to create an intelligent environment designed to inform IP strategy, enable IP decision-making, and streamline IP operations. Today, nearly half of the top 100 U.S. patent filers and global brands, as well as a growing number of law firms worldwide use Anaqua's solutions. Over one million IP executives, attorneys, paralegals, administrators, and innovators in large and medium-sized companies use the platform for their IP management needs. The company's global operations are headquartered in Boston, with offices across the U.S., Europe, Asia, and Australia. For additional information, please visit anaqua.com, or on LinkedIn.

 Architecture

description:
Ashtead Technology is seeking a motivated Project Manager in Turriff to support our growing Mechanical Solutions service line. In this role you will deliver complex, high-value projects from contract award through to completion, driving exceptional outcomes for clients while ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on time, and within budget while developing strong client relationships and championing our company values.

 What You’ll Be Doing: 

 End-to-end delivery of multiple medium and large-scale projects, ensuring contractual, technical, commercial, and operational objectives are achieved. 

 Develop project plans, resource requirements, schedules, and delivery timelines, proactively managing risks, priorities, and key milestones. 

 Manage project budgets, financial performance, invoicing schedules, change control, and variation opportunities to maximise project success and profitability. 

 Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, suppliers, offshore personnel, and key stakeholders, ensuring expectations are met and communication remains effective throughout the project lifecycle. 

 Coordinate engineering, manufacturing, equipment mobilisation, testing, logistics, and offshore support activities to ensure seamless project execution. 

 Ensure compliance with project governance, contractual obligations, company procedures, and financial controls, escalating issues where appropriate. 

 Oversee project documentation, reporting, technical specifications, offshore information packs, procedures, and project tracking systems. 

 Support client meetings, technical proposals, tender activities, and continuous improvement initiatives through customer feedback and project reviews. 

 What experience you'll bring: 

 Proven project management experience within an engineering, offshore, or related industry environment.

 Experience managing complex equipment projects, including modifications, testing, mobilisation and demobilisation activities.

 Strong understanding of mechanical handling equipment and the ability to interpret technical specifications, develop project plans, and coordinate project execution.

 Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to motivate teams, build strong working relationships, and support the development of others.

 Excellent organisational, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results under pressure.

 A proactive, solutions-focused approach with strong problem-solving skills and the confidence to support operational teams when required.

 Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Project.

 A full UK driving licence.

 Qualifications in Project Management and/or Engineering are desirable and will support success in the role, as well as experience working offshore, specifically with Mechanical, Hydraulic, Electrical or PLC systems.

 Who we are: 

 Established in 1985, Ashtead Technology is a leading provider of subsea equipment rental solutions, advanced underwater technologies, and support services to the global offshore energy sector. With over 40 years of experience, we specialise in enabling customers to understand the subsea environment and manage offshore energy production infrastructure, including offshore wind farms and oil and gas platforms. Our offering spans the entire lifecycle of these infrastructures, with over 85% of our equipment fungible across both markets.

 Headquartered in the UK, Ashtead Technology operates globally with over 600 staff and more than 30,000 assets, making us one of the largest independent rental fleets in the industry. We continue to invest in equipment and have a strong in-house engineering capability to provide the most technologically advanced solutions. Our growth, driven by strategic acquisitions and organic expansion, culminated in a successful IPO in 2021, with shares now trading on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange.

 What we can offer: 

 A dynamic & collaborative team environment where your contributions are valued, and your ideas welcomed.

 A positive and inclusive company culture that fosters collaboration, creativity, and mutual respect among team members.

description:
Association for New Canadians is a non-profit, community-based organization dedicated to the provision of settlement and integration services for immigrants and refugees. 

 Job Title: Diversity Shadow Project Program Manager 

 Location: St. John’s, NL 

 Position Type: 1 full-time position until March 31, 2028, with possibility of extension pending budget availability and satisfactory performance 

 Closing date: Until filled 

 Reporting to the Senior Director of Programs or designate, the Diversity Shadow Project (DSP) Program Manager leads a three-year settlement initiative focused on improving inclusive and equitable support for newcomers. The role is responsible for coordinating project planning, budgeting, community engagement, staff training, resource development, service-gap identification, evaluation, reporting, and compliance with funding and organizational requirements, with a focus on turning newcomer and partner input into practical service improvements. 

 Roles and Responsibilities 

 Project Leadership & Compliance 

 Manage the DSP work plan, budget, timelines, risks, deliverables, and reporting.

 Ensure compliance with ANC policies, funding requirements, privacy standards, and applicable laws.

 Maintain accurate project, financial, and outcome records and coordinate project resources.

 Newcomer Engagement & Advisory Committee 

 Establish and coordinate an Advisory Committee comprised of under-represented newcomer groups.

 Engage newcomers and partners to identify service gaps, barriers, and opportunities.

 Ensure participation is accessible, safe, confidential, trauma-informed, and respectful. 

 Training & Capacity Building 

 Develop and deliver staff training, referral tools, and practical resources.

 Strengthen referral systems and support collaborative solutions that respond to identified service gaps.

 Share knowledge and best practices with ANC staff and community partners. 

 Evaluation & Systems Change 

 Track project activities, outcomes, participation, and lessons learned.

 Conduct surveys, interviews, focus groups, and other evaluation activities.

 Turn findings into practical recommendations and service improvements. 

 Partnerships & Communication 

 Build strong relationships with newcomers, staff, community organizations, consultants, and IRCC.

 Facilitate accessible meetings, workshops, and consultations.

 Represent ANC at relevant community and sector events. 

 Qualifications & Core Competencies: 

 Relevant post-secondary education in social sciences, education or related fields or equivalent combination of education and experience.

 Experience managing community, settlement, equity, inclusion, or capacity-building projects and working respectfully with newcomers, under-represented communities, and community partners.

 Strong project management, organization, budgeting, and reporting skills.

 Excellent communication, facilitation, partnership-building, and conflict-resolution skills.

 Knowledge of equity, inclusion, accessibility, and trauma-informed practices.

 Experience with evaluation, data collection, and continuous improvement.

 Strong judgment regarding privacy, confidentiality, safeguarding, and financial accountability.

 Proficiency with digital and collaboration tools.

 Knowledge of the Newfoundland and Labrador settlement sector and additional language skills are assets. 

 Conditions of Employment: 

 Legal authorization to work in Canada is mandatory

 Flexible to work outside of core hours (Monday-Friday, 9:00am - 5:00pm) is required

 Evenings and weekends may be required

 Valid Class 5 Newfoundland and Labrador driver’s license and daily access to a personal vehicle are required

 Ability to travel is required

 Position is subject to a satisfactory Criminal Record Screening and Vulnerable Sector Check from the Royal Newfoundland Constabulary 

 How to Apply 

 Please upload a cover letter and resume as one PDF or MS Word document to 

 https://associationfornewcanadians.bamboohr.com/careers/303 

 Association for New Canadians is committed to the advancement of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion. We believe that diversity in our team is a key pillar in the work we do and invite all candidates to discuss their specific skill sets and experience. We will work with qualified applicants to provide reasonable accommodation upon request to facilitate this recruitment process.

 Visit us on-line at: www.ancnl.ca .

Activate Your Career with ATNZ – Get Qualified for FREE While Earning! 

 Looking for a hands-on career that gets you out and about within your region?

 Do you like interacting with others and enjoy problem solving?

We’re seeking motivated individuals interested in mechanical & electrical engineering who want to get into the Refrigeration & Air Conditioning industry by completing an Apprenticeship through ATNZ - based in Blenheim, Marlborough. I deally you're someone who resides or sees their future in the Blenheim region and is ready to commit to seeing the full 3-4 year apprenticeship through. 

 Why work with ATNZ? 

 Hands on training + support from qualified trades people and experienced mentors 

 We cover the qualification cost 

 Start earning straight away 

 Safety gear provided 

 Tool allowance on top of your pay (you don't pay it back) 

And much more!

 What Does a Refrigeration and Air Conditioning Engineer Do? 

 Refrigeration and air conditioning engineers install and maintain the components used in air conditioning and refrigeration systems. These systems provide a climate-controlled environment for either people or goods. description:
We are seeking an addition to our team Wat Warrington Hospital. The ANA role is a vital support role within our clinical team, working alongside veterinary surgeons and registered veterinary nurses to maintain high standards of patient care. As part of the team, you’ll contribute to both client-facing and clinical duties, ensuring a smooth and professional experience for patients, clients, and colleagues alike. 

 This is an ideal opportunity for someone who is passionate about animal welfare, confident in a clinical environment, and committed to providing outstanding service in both front-of-house and back-of-house settings. 

 About animal Trust 

 Animal Trust stands out from other veterinary services. Firstly, we are a unique Community Interest Company, being the only veterinary CIC in the UK to date. Our primary focus isn't solely on maximising profits; instead, we are dedicated to delivering on our mission and ensuring enough profit to sustain our business in the long term. 

 Key Responsibilities 

 • Assist with the day-to-day care of hospitalised patients, including feeding, cleaning, and providing comfort
• Restrain animals safely and appropriately during examinations, diagnostics, and treatments
• Support the clinical team in providing care across a varied caseload 

 • Prepare theatre spaces and equipment for surgical procedures
• Maintain cleanliness and asepsis in surgical and prep areas throughout the day
• Clean and sterilise surgical instruments and medical equipment
• Run in-house diagnostic tests (e.g. blood samples) under supervision 

 • Liaise with external labs regarding samples 
• Support in maintaining stock levels and replenishing clinical supplies 

 • Greet clients and assist with patient admissions and discharges
• Answer incoming calls and provide basic support or escalate appropriately
• Offer a calm and compassionate presence to clients during visits
• Accurately record patient information and communicate updates to the team 

 • Maintain high standards of cleanliness across clinical and non-clinical areas
• Follow infection control protocols, including isolation procedures as needed
• Complete daily cleaning tasks, equipment checks, and hygiene logs
• Assist with stock rotation and restocking of clinical consumables 

 About you: 

 • Calm, compassionate, with a passion for animal care
• Strong communication skills with both clients and colleagues
• Able to follow instructions and take ownership of delegated tasks
• Confident in relaying accurate information to team members and clients
• High attention to hygiene, safety, and infection control
• Previous experience in a veterinary or animal care role (desirable but not essential)
• Willingness to learn and develop within a clinical setting 

 Hours: 
08:00- 18:30hrs 

 Rota: 4 on 4 off rota 

 Average of 35hr week 

 Holiday: 5.6 Weeks (including Bank Holidays)

description:
Assist Ambulance is looking for new and experienced Paramedics to join us full-time and part-time at our Brooklyn base! Assist is a New York City EMS agency offering a full range of emergency medical and transportation services throughout the five boroughs. Assist has a proud 30 year history of providing these services to the diverse and vibrant communities of NYC. Assist Ambulance offers Advanced Life Support and Basic Life Support via emergency and non-emergency ambulance transports for various hospitals, nursing homes, assisted living facilities, doctor's offices, and community-based organizations. 

 Job Requirements: 

 Must have an active NY State EMT-P card and NYC REMAC - NREMT card is not accepted alone

 Paramedics without any experience are welcome to apply as long as they are fully certified at time of application

 Must be at least 20 years old with 1 years driving experience in New York City

 Must have a valid, clean NYS D Class driver’s license

 DJ licenses are not accepted

 Must be physically fit to lift 125 lbs. in accordance with the NYS DOH and pass a lifting assessment

 Must be able to get 19A physical clearance and negative PPD test (vouchers provided)

 Must be able to pass a 10 panel drug screening

 Must be able to commit to at least two 12-hour shifts per week that are the same days every week (steady shifts)

 Per diem is not available at this time, only part time or full time steady scheduling 

 Must be good with people and able to act responsibly under extreme duress

 Applicants' criminal history will be considered consistent with the requirements of the New York City Fair Chance Act 

 Job Attributes: 

 Weekly Payday

 Paid Training

 Flexible Scheduling

 Union Shop with 1199 SEIU (contract still being determined)

 Paid sick time/PTO

 Free uniforms

 8 Hours Pay for staff normally scheduled or working on Christmas, Thanksgiving, Labor Day, Memorial Day, July 4th, and New Year's Day

 After 90 days, 30+ scheduled hours employees are eligible for health insurance

 Paid vacation after first year of employment - increases at three, six and ten years of employment

 CME Refresher Program / Voucher

 Overtime opportunities

 Large volume of emergency calls

 5% annual raises

Role Summary: 

 The Cash Settlements Officer is responsible for ensuring the accurate and timely settlement of cash and investment transactions while maintaining strong operational controls and regulatory compliance. The role works closely with internal teams and external counterparties to resolve settlement issues, improve processes, and support reliable and efficient investment operations. 

 What Business Outcomes the Role is Responsible for: 

 Deliver Accurate & Timely Settlements : Ensure transactions, documentation, and reports are processed and completed within required timelines with minimal to zero operational errors. 

 Strengthen Risk, Compliance & Controls: Maintain adherence to regulatory requirements and company policies while ensuring audit requirements are complete, accurate, and readily available for internal, external, and BSP reviews. 

 Drive Operational Excellenc e: Resolve settlement and operational issues effectively while contributing to process improvement, digitalization, and other initiatives that improve efficiency, controls, and service delivery. 

 What We’re Looking For in a Successful Candidate: 

 Relevant Experience: Brings at least three years of relevant experience in settlements operations within banking, investments, trust, asset management, or a related financial services environment. 

 Operational & Analytical Excellence: Demonstrates strong attention to detail, analytical and problem-solving capabilities, and the ability to manage multiple time-sensitive transactions accurately in a deadline-driven environment. 

 Integrity & Stakeholder Management: Demonstrates a high level of integrity and strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to proactively identify and resolve issues and work effectively across internal teams and external counterparties.

description:
At Ballinger, we are passionate about complex challenges and real-world problem-solving. Design challenges come in all shapes and sizes, and the ones we prefer test us as design professionals. We seek out complex projects with big impact because they require us to ask tough questions, synthesize data, and push past the boundaries of existing answers into the realm of innovative solutions. Ballinger team members thrive on those challenges because our clients do, too: our work for them enables their ambitious endeavors in science and medicine, research and government, manufacturing, and technology. Ballinger welcomes ambition with career development, mentorship, and leadership opportunities. Here ideas will always be more important than hierarchy because they result in buildings as transformative as the missions they serve.

 Position Summary: 

 Ballinger is seeking a Design II to join our Interiors Studio. Working under the guidance of project leaders and more experienced team members, this position supports the development of thoughtful, functional, sustainable, and human-centered environments across healthcare, academic, research, and workplace projects. The Designer II will contribute to design, documentation, visualization, materials and furniture research, and interdisciplinary coordination while building professional judgment and technical proficiency through project experience. Assignments may include working with a team through programming, conceptual design, schematic design, design development, space planning, construction documentation, and construction administration activities.

 Position Responsibilities: 

 Conduct and synthesize research related to materials, finishes, furnishings, lighting, products, precedents, sustainability, wellness, accessibility, and applicable codes

 Develop design studies, test fits, diagrams, presentation materials, finish palettes, furniture concepts, and 3D renderings under team direction

 Pick up and generate redlines in a documentation set

 Produce and coordinate drawings such as finish plans, reflected ceiling plans, interior elevations, details, and schedules under team direction

 Contribute to furniture planning, product evaluation, specification, budgeting support, procurement coordination, and installation or punch-list activities

 Provide mentorship and actively share knowledge

 Interface and coordinate with other disciplines

 Develop knowledge of Ballinger’s project types (health care, academic/lab/research, corporate/workspace) through on-the-job experience, repetition, and scalability of tasks and responsibilities

 Travel as project requirements dictate for surveys and field/site visits during construction

 Create and maintain Firm technical standards

 Technical/Professional Skills: 

 Demonstrate foundation in interior design principles, including space planning, color, materials, furnishings, lighting, detailing, and visual communication

 Interpersonal skills combined with excellent communication skills, both verbal and written

 Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite applications (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)

 Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite applications

 Graphics and visualization skills to effectively communicate design ideas

 Attention to detail

 Self-starter, able to independently generate design solutions and provide direction to other team members

 Ability to take direction within a larger team

 Working knowledge of Revit, AutoCAD, SketchUp, Enscape, or other modeling software applications

 Strong organizational and time-management skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks across project phases or concurrent assignments.

 Interest in sustainable design, wellness, furniture, material performance, inclusive design, and the user experience

 Requirements: 

 Bachelor of Arts or Bachelor of Science in Interior Design or Architecture

 3+ years of relevant work experience

 Portfolio demonstrating design thinking, visual communication, and relevant academic or professional work.

 Working towards licensure or NCIDQ certification

 LEED Green Associate, WELL AP, or other relevant credentials are welcomed but not required.

 Please include a link to your Portfolio when applying. Applications must include a Portfolio submission for consideration. 

 It is the policy of Ballinger to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race (including hairstyle/texture), religion, color, citizenship, national origin, sex, pregnancy, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Ballinger prohibits any such discrimination or harassment.

 Ballinger's Approach: 

 Our interdisciplinary teams collaborate on solutions that require a synthesis of disciplines. We believe integrating architecture, planning, interior design and engineering is key to achieving excellence in the design of transformative environments. We were one of the first firms to merge the disciplines into a professional practice. At Ballinger, architectural and interior designers work collaboratively and creatively with planners and engineers. Our range of skills, perspectives and experiences, directed toward a common goal, produces ground-breaking outcomes.

 What We Offer: 

 We believe that people are our greatest asset and the precision, expertise and collaboration that we bring to our projects sets us apart from the competition and enables us to make an impact on our world and community. We offer a Comprehensive Benefits Package, including Medical, Dental, Prescription, Wellness, FSA/HSA, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Short and Long-Term Disability Programs, Tuition Reimbursement, Paid Parent Leave, 401(k) plan, Commuter Benefits, Paid Holidays, and Personal Time Off (PTO), Community Volunteer Events and fresh fruit and yogurt provided every morning in the office.

 Location: 

 This role is based in our Philadelphia, PA headquarters at 1650 Arch Street with three (3) days per week in office and a flexible, hybrid work schedule. Occasional travel, less than ten percent, to client sites (<10%) may be required

description:
Be part of something bigger. Build with us today — Now. For tomorrow. 

 At Baker Tilly, we care about the impact you make. That’s why we’re invested in your growth from day one—because the steps you take today define your tomorrow. 

 We are looking for a Senior Accountant - Private Audit Services to join our team —a role where your expertise will drive meaningful outcomes and your ambition will help shape what comes next. Here, you’ll collaborate with a dynamic team of professionals, united by a shared commitment to making a difference—for our clients, our communities, and one another. 

 Baker Tilly is a leading advisory and accounting firm dedicated to building better futures. With global reach and local roots, we combine the scale of a network with the trust of strong relationships. From audit and tax to consulting and specialist advisory services, we help clients navigate complexity and seize opportunity with clarity. 

 Your Role: 

 Preparing compilations, reviews, NTRs, and audit engagements;

 Preparing corporate and personal income tax returns,

 Mentoring and training staff;

 Working under tight deadlines, delivering quality work, anticipating and resolving client issues in a timely manner;

 Corresponding with partners and clients; and

 Other duties as assigned.

 What you bring to the table: 

 CPA, CA or working towards a CPA designation; completion of UFE/CFE

 Public practice experience is required

 Experienced in both Private and Public Enterprise is an asset

 Superior people and client service skills

 Good written and verbal communication

 Strong attention to detail

 Excellent problem solving and analytical skills

 Adept organizational and time management skills, including the ability to meet deadline

 What’s in it for you? 

 Career & Growth Opportunities 

 Clear career progression and advancement opportunities

 Ongoing professional development, including paid courses, certification and membership dues

 Compensation & Total Rewards 

 Competitive total compensation package including extended health care, dental and group life benefits

 Annual bonus program

 Matching RRSP plan

 Family & Flexibility 

 Hybrid workdays

 Parental leave top-up program to support growing families

 Generous vacation (3 weeks annually)

 Health & Wellness 

 Health and wellness spending account

 Convenient access to virtual healthcare, including online physician consultations when you need it

 Work Environment & Perks 

 A collaborative, open-door culture with direct access to leadership

 Fully stocked kitchen with snacks, coffee and seasonal treats

 Smart casual dress code (client/day specific)

 Regular team events and social activities throughout the year

 Additional Incentives 

 Client referral, employee referral

 Vehicle purchase incentives

 Where you’ll work: Vancouver, BC 

 Job type: Permanent, Full-time 

 Your schedule: Monday to Friday 

 Salary range : $70,000 - $84,000 per annum 

 Baker Tilly is fair and competitive when it comes to rewarding our people. We regularly benchmark across a variety of positions, industries, sectors and levels. Our total rewards philosophy is rooted in recognizing people's unique contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver. Along with a competitive base salary we offer comprehensive benefits and perks, performance bonuses and flexible hybrid work. For more information on our Total Rewards click here ! 

 When you join Baker Tilly, you become part of something bigger—an ambitious, forward-thinking company that puts people first. Ideas matter, perspectives count, and every contribution builds a stronger future. If you’re ready to make an impact, we’re ready to meet you. 

 We are committed to transparency in our hiring process. Please note the following information regarding this job posting: 

 Position Status: 

 New Role: This job posting is for a newly created role within our organization. This position has been established to support our growth, and we are excited to welcome a new team member to help us achieve our goals. 

 Use of Artificial Intelligence: 

 We use AI-enabled tools to assist with resume screening. All final decisions are made by a human recruiter.

 Ready to Apply? 

 We thank all applicants for their interest, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. If you are selected for an interview, we will contact you directly via email. All virtual interviews will be conducted exclusively on Microsoft Teams. We will never request additional personal information such as bank details or other sensitive data.

 Baker Tilly is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex (including gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, parental status, marital status, sexual orientation, disability, age, or other non-merit factors. Baker Tilly is dedicated to fostering, supporting and celebrating a diverse workplace. Accommodation is available to all applicants upon request throughout our recruitment and selection process. We will work with all applicants to accommodate their accessibility needs. 

 Baker Tilly WM LLP is a member of Baker Tilly Canada Cooperative, which is a member of the global network of Baker Tilly International Limited. All members of Baker Tilly Canada Cooperative and Baker Tilly International Limited are separate and independent legal entities.

description:
General Summary 

 Responsible to perform and specialize in one of the two areas (Platelet Processing or Quarantine of blood components). This includes blood component accessioning, sampling, quality control, maintenance, testing, component manufacturing, final labeling, and quarantine procedures. Ensures all laboratory procedures and processes are conducted in compliance with prescribed regulations. Maintains all technical activities to include training and the performance of moderate complexity, routine laboratory procedures. Maintain accurate records and documentation as well as recognize unusual test results and resolve discrepancies. Maintain excellent communication with the department and throughout the organization.

 Commit to and abide by the character of BioBridge Global’s Core Values of Accountability, Stewardship, Pioneer, Integrity, Respect and Excellence (ASPIRE). Support, communicate and reinforce the mission and vision of the enterprise.

 Provide world class customer service by capturing and being responsive to the voice of the customer (internal or external, including donors for select positions) through multiple feedback channels in order to resolve issues and drive satisfaction in accordance with the BBG customer engagement, feedback, and complaint processes.

 Major Duties and Responsibilities 

 Essential Tasks 

 · Competently perform all assigned departmental duties to include performing Pre-Analytical tasks [receipt, qualification, and modification of components, and samples] and testing on blood products.

 · Perform complex mathematical calculations, evaluate test results in an accurate and timely manner, and recognize and report unusual test results.

 · Accurately maintain all record and documentation of quality control.

 · Analyze quality control data and resolve discrepancies that may occur in reporting these tests.

 · Operate required equipment utilizing established protocols and within quality control limits.

 · Perform STBTC laboratory quarantine procedures (of blood components).

 · Perform calibrations, quality control, and maintenance on equipment used in the performance of duties. Recognize equipment malfunctions and/or technical problems and take appropriate technician level steps to resolve.

 · Use independent judgment and/or knowledge to resolve complex problems.

 · Perform product labeling and investigate any issues which prevents labeling.

 · Perform computer entry of component modifications accurately.

 · Be knowledgeable and follow established South Texas Blood & Tissue Center laboratory guidelines, policies and procedures for biological and chemical safety.

 · Perform laboratory testing through performance of moderate complexity, routine, and special laboratory procedures.

 · Coordinate activities of the laboratory to determine priorities regarding processing of units and testing as needed.

 · Utilize the data management system to include Outlook, Excel, Word, and MAC.

 · Maintain adequate level of disposable supplies through request for purchase of additional supplies, if applicable.

 · Assist in the preparation of daily activity reports related to processing, resolution of discrepancies, and retention of products not qualified for release.

 · Assist with training of new employees as needed and maintain annual training competencies for the testing laboratory.

 · Recognize unusual results and difficulties encountered in all phases of laboratory performance to include purchased goods, environmental, mechanical and product related.

 · Assist and develop testing procedures according to organizational and regulatory (NMDP, AABB, FACT, ISO, FDA, and cGMP) standards.

 · Assist with validation of all procedures performed thus providing for the safety and efficacy of products to include preventative maintenance.

 · Attend meetings, seminars, and other workshops as required.

 · Maintain a close working relationship with management keeping them informed on issues pertaining to laboratory functions.

 · Review all required paperwork.

 · Run departmental errands as needed.

 · May interact with and/or exposure to various groups, VIPs, and/or media.

 · Assist in other Laboratory areas as directed.

 Performs other duties as assigned.

 Non-Essential Tasks 

 · Provide assistance to other departments as needed.

 Education 

 Required Minimum Education 

 Requires an Associate Degree from an accredited college or university in a specialized area.

 Preferred Education 

 Prefer a Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university.

 Licenses and/or Certifications 

 · Certification as a Medical Assistant and/or Donor Phlebotomy Technician preferred

 Experience 

 Required Minimum Experience 

 · Requires two or more years of laboratory experience.

 · If Bachelor's Degree is attained, no specific work experience required.

 Preferred Experience 

 · Prefer Clinical Laboratory, equipment validation, quality control, and hematology experience.

 Experience Exception to Education 

 In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

 Knowledge 

 · Must have a working knowledge of equipment and procedures for various technologies.

 · Must recognize and facilitate resolution of unusual results or difficulties encountered in all phases of laboratory work.

 · Must have a working knowledge in all aspects of technical procedures of a clinical laboratory.

 · Must obtain a working knowledge of regulatory/quality requirements and perform within all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and policies.

 Skills 

 · Must have excellent written and oral communication skills. This includes responding to emails in a timely manner.

 · Must have strong computer skills.

 · Must be prepared to identify root causes of problems and select the best course of action when circumstances require.

 · Must have the skills to recognize unusual results and troubleshoot testing problems as soon as detected.

 · Must maintain competency in skills required for Apheresis Platelet manufacturing, Component QC, Product Quarantine, and labeling.

 · Must be competent in processing and testing equipment required in a clinical laboratory.

 Abilities 

 · Must be able to keep information confidential.

 · Must be able to make good sound judgment decisions.

 · Must be neat in appearance and well groomed.

 · Must be a self-starter and self-directed worker.

 · Must be professional, detail oriented, self-motivated, innovative, creative, assertive, organized, communicative, and have the ability to work independently.

 · Must perform well in repetitive work situations.

description:
General Summary 

 Responsible to inspect and perform all phases related to blood components production and labeling in accordance with all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), organizational policies, and regulatory and cGMP/cGTP requirements. Will prepare specialized blood components and quarantine blood components. Will also provide in‐ service training to staff regarding policies and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Responsible for activities related to the aseptic processing of human cells and tissue, maintenance of surgical instruments and equipment, and proper documentation of all activities. Must be able to operate all major and minor processing equipment and maintain processing supplies and equipment inventory. Participate in the development of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the cell and tissue processing and distribution. Responsible to perform and assist in coordination of all operational aspects of the cord blood accessioning and processing areas. Ensures all laboratory procedures are conducted in compliance with prescribed regulations. Maintains all technical activities to include training and the performance of high complexity, routine laboratory procedures. Responsible to receive, accession, and distribute testing samples to Laboratory Services testing laboratories. Recognize unusual situations and resolve discrepancies. Communicate discrepancies to management. Maintain accurate records of incoming and outgoing samples.

 Commit to and abide by the character of BioBridge Global’s Core Values of Accountability, Stewardship, Pioneer, Integrity, Respect and Excellence (ASPIRE). Support, communicate and reinforce the mission and vision of the enterprise.

 Provide world class customer service by capturing and being responsive to the voice of the customer (internal or external, including donors for select positions) through multiple feedback channels in order to resolve issues and drive satisfaction in accordance with the BBG customer engagement, feedback, and complaint processes.

 Major Duties and Responsibilities 

 Essential Tasks 

 · Process blood components to established quality standards.

 · Follow Daily Production Plan to maintain adequate inventory of blood components.

 · Accurately label blood components.

 · Prepare specialized blood components as directed.

 · Report on the final disposition of components.

 · Verify Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as assigned.

 · Quarantine blood components which are non‐conformant per SOP.

 · Perform quality control, and maintenance on equipment and document appropriately.

 · Assist senior technicians in maintaining adequate supply levels.

 · Assist in staff training as required.

 · Evaluate and document competency levels through direct observation and testing.

 · Perform weekend on‐call duties on a rotating basis.

 · Provide exceptional customer service internally and externally.

 · Maintain good working relationship with co‐workers, senior technicians, other departments, and management.

 · Report any irregularities, difficulties, and unusual results immediately.

 · Assist in the developing of the cell and tissue processing procedures according to the AATB, FDA, and cGMP/cGTP standards.

 · Utilize the aseptic techniques for processing of cells and tissue.

 · Perform instruments and supplies sterilization procedures according to sterilization guidelines.

 · Maintain processing instruments, supplies and equipment inventory, and ensure an adequate supply.

 · Operate processing equipment and maintain maintenance and monitoring records such as: freezer, freeze dried and room temperature readings.

 · Perform receiving, accessioning and distributing of testing samples to the laboratory as needed.

 · Maintain accurate records of incoming and outgoing samples.

 · Perform cell and tissue processing room disinfection procedures according to Clean Room and organizational guidelines.

 · Perform processing, packaging and labeling of the cells and tissues according to procedures, AATB, cGMP and organizational standards.

 · Maintain complete and accurate records of all steps in the cell or tissue product manufacturing process to assure product documentation and traceability.

 · Perform all necessary quality control procedures and maintain complete records of results.

 · Follow proper safety procedures.

 · Run departmental errands as directed.

 · May have interaction with and/or exposure to various groups, VIPs, and/or media.

 · Run departmental errands as directed.

 Performs other duties as assigned.

 Non-Essential Tasks 

 · Provide assistance to other departments as needed.

 Education 

 Required Minimum Education 

 Requires sixty (60) hours or Associate Degree from an accredited technical/vocational institute, college or university.

 Preferred Education 

 Licenses and/or Certifications 

 · Certification as a Medical Assistant and/or Donor Phlebotomy Technician preferred

 Experience 

 Required Minimum Experience 

 · No prior specific work experience required.

 Preferred Experience 

 · Prefer two or more years of laboratory experience, sterile technique, instruments and equipment sterilization techniques.

 · Prefer one year of blood center experience.

 Knowledge 

 · Must have a working knowledge of equipment and procedures for various technologies.

 · Must obtain a working knowledge of regulatory/quality requirements and perform within all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and policies.

 · Must have a working knowledge of component processing techniques.

 Skills 

 · Must be able to print and write legibly.

 · Must have excellent written and oral communication skills.

 · Must have strong computer skills.

 · Must be capable of operating laboratory and/or other job-related equipment.

 · Must be prepared to identify root causes of problems and select the best course of action when circumstances require.

 · Must have strong manual dexterity and technical abilities in the use of processing and testing equipment.

 · Must be capable of inputting computer data with accuracy.

 Abilities 

 · Must have the ability to lead training programs in component procedures.

 · Must be able to keep information confidential.

 · Must be able to make good sound judgment decisions.

 · Must be neat in appearance and well groomed.

 · Must be a self-starter and self-directed worker.

 · Must be professional, detail oriented, self-motivated, innovative, creative, assertive, organized, communicative, and have the ability to work independently.

 · Must perform well in repetitive work situations.

 · Must be able to work with interruptions, meet deadlines, and perform accurate work and/or reports.
