 Are you a passionate, forward-thinking educator dedicated to fostering global literacy? 

 Can you empower students from diverse cultural backgrounds? 

 Do you want to inspire the next generation of global citizens while teaching in a vibrant, innovative international school community? 

 The Island Private School of Limassol is a fast-growing, innovative international school in the thriving city of Limassol, Cyprus, committed to excellence, inclusion, and holistic education. 

 We are currently building our brand-new school campus on a beautiful 50,000 m² site, scheduled for completion by the end of 2027. This state-of-the-art campus will include a kindergarten, elementary school, high school, international boarding school, and dedicated accommodation for teachers. This is an exceptional opportunity to join a dynamic school on the cusp of major growth and transformation. 

 What makes us stand out? 

 🌐 Multicultural and internationally minded community 

 📈 Strong focus on professional growth and continuous development 

 💡 Innovative, forward-thinking learning environment 

 🤝 Collaborative and supportive teaching culture 

 📍 Vibrant location in Limassol, Cyprus 

 What will you do? 

 The primary purpose of this role is to establish and deliver a dynamic English language curriculum that fosters linguistic proficiency alongside a deep appreciation for the rich cultural heritage of English-speaking countries. You will be key to promoting global literacy within our student body, equipping learners with essential communication skills and a broader worldview necessary for success in an interconnected world. 

 Key Duties & Responsibilities 

 Teaching & Curriculum Delivery: Plan, teach, and assess high-quality EAL lessons tailored to individual needs across all proficiency levels (beginners to advanced). Develop strategies to enhance reading, writing, speaking, and listening skills, providing small-group or one-on-one interventions when necessary. 

 Collaboration & Integration: Work alongside classroom teachers to support EAL students across all curriculum areas. Collaborate with coordinators to ensure horizontal and vertical curriculum alignment, and promote a Content and Language Integrated Learning (CLIL) approach. 

 Assessment & Feedback: Design and implement formative and summative assessments aligned with MYP, Waldorf, or Cambridge objectives. Provide regular, constructive feedback to students and maintain accurate records of progress to share with parents and colleagues. 

 Learning Environment: Create a positive, inclusive, and stimulating classroom culture that encourages active participation. Integrate technology and varied educational resources to enhance language engagement. 

 Community Engagement: Participate in planning meetings, professional development opportunities, and wider school committees. Organize and facilitate extracurricular clubs, activities, and educational field trips. 

 Essential Qualifications & Experience 

 Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Education, English Language or Literature, TESOL, TEFL, CELTA, or a related field. 

 Experience: At least 2 years of experience teaching EAL in a mainstream school environment. 

 Instructional Skills: Demonstrated ability to differentiate instruction for varying language levels and exceptional classroom management skills to create a nurturing environment. 

 Core Competencies: Proficiency in integrating technology into language teaching, a positive attitude toward challenging situations, and excellent interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills. 

 Bonus Skills/Experience 

 A recognized teaching qualification (such as PGCE, QTS, or an equivalent certification). 

 Direct experience teaching within the IB MYP or Cambridge English frameworks. 

 Proficiency in additional languages commonly spoken in our community (such as Russian, Ukrainian, or Hebrew). 

 Prior teaching experience within a private school setting. 

 Private School Teaching experience 

 Safeguarding & GDPR 

 The school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. All staff are expected to share this commitment. The successful candidate will be required to undergo appropriate background checks, including criminal record checks, reference verification and any other safer recruitment procedures required by the school and local regulations. 

 Working Conditions 

 Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 08:00 – 16:00. 

 Remuneration: Competitive package based on your individual qualifications and experience. 

 Environment: Modern, professional, and fast-growing poly systemic school framework. 

 Health: Optional participation in the Company’s Group Medical Scheme. 

 Growth: Substantial opportunities for professional learning, specialized training, and career progression. 

 Referral Incentives: Eligibility for our employee referral program, which includes a €500 bonus. 

 What we offer 

 Modern, professional working environment 

 Optional participation in a Group Medical Scheme 

 Referral program with a 500 EUR bonus 

 Continuous learning and development opportunities 

 Career growth within a fast-growing poly-systemic school 

 How to apply 

 Click HERE to submit your CV and cover letter via our careers portal. 

 Note: Your application must include a brief statement (maximum of one page) describing the key features of your educational philosophy and your approach to working with young people. Please clearly outline how your unique experience and expertise align with the expectations of this role. 

 Our recruitment process: 

 Hiring team panel interview (30 minutes). 

 Trial lesson (60 minutes). 

 Interview with Faculty Leader (30 minutes). 

 Join The Island School and help deliver a world-class IB education in a collaborative, international environment.

 ✅ 4 Programs of IB curriculum 

 ✅ (PYP/MYP/DP) Montessori, Waldorf & TFL 

 ✅ Professional growth & training 

 ✅ An inspiring global communit y

Location: Kampala

 Duration of contract: 12 months with possibility of extension

 Start date: 1st November 2026

 Report to: Country Director

 About IsraAID: 

 IsraAID is an international non-governmental humanitarian aid organization based in Israel. Since we were founded in 2001, our teams have worked in emergency and long-term development settings in more than 60 countries around the world. IsraAID responds to emergencies and helps communities affected by crises rebuild their lives and their futures together. From hurricanes to refugee crises to global pandemics, we mobilize quickly and collaborate with communities at the deepest level, accompanying the process of becoming self-reliant in the ability to prepare and respond to emergencies and crises and return to adaptive functioning.

 In Uganda, we support the recovery and restoration of people affected by humanitarian crises and cultivate and nurture resilience and build agency while establishing systems and partnerships to reduce the risk of future disasters. We work in Southwestern Uganda in the Nakivale Settlement and Nyakabande transit centre.

 About the Position: 

 The Head of Programs provides strategic and operational leadership for all IsraAID Uganda programmes in the three 3 geopgraphical locations: Kampala, Nakivale, Nyakabande, and any other locations as prescribed by the country office. The role is responsible for the implementation, quality, coherence, and impact of all projects, and serves as the primary programme lead within the Country Management Team. The Head of Programs works closely with the Country Director, donor focal points, the MEAL department, and HQ technical advisors to ensure programmes are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

 Duties and Responsibilities: 

 Programme Leadership & Quality 

 Provide strategic oversight of all IsraAID Uganda programmes, including WASH, Nutrition, Child Protection, and other emerging sectors.

 Lead programme planning, design, and implementation across all field locations in line with IsraAID's global strategy and country priorities.

 Ensure all programme activities are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with donor requirements and IsraAID standards.

 Provide oversight of programme quality through regular field visits, programme reviews, technical support to field teams and ensuring that monitoring data, evaluations, community feedback, safeguarding concerns and lessons learned are systematically reviewed and used to strengthen programme effectiveness and impact.

 Lead the development and review of project work plans, monitoring frameworks, and programme reports.

 Ensure timely and accurate internal programme reporting to the Country Director, Country Management Team, and HQ

 Work closely with the MEAL Officer to ensure that robust monitoring, evaluation, accountability and learning systems are in place and that programme teams effectively utilize evidence and recommendations for adaptive management and continuous improvement. 

 Staff Supervision & Team Management 

 Directly supervise the senior programmatic officers, including WASH Officer, Area Project Officers, and Senior Nutrition Officer.

 Provide regular performance feedback, coaching, and development support to programme staff.

 Lead the coordination of programme team meetings and ensure effective communication across all field locations.

 Support recruitment processes for programme positions, including JD review, shortlisting, and panel interviews.

 Foster a positive, collaborative, and accountable team culture across the programme unit. 

 Donor Relations & Reporting 

 Lead the preparation of high-quality narrative reports for donors, in coordination with MEAL and field teams.

 Maintain relationships with donor focal points and support donor visits and programme reviews.

 Represent IsraAID Uganda in programme-related coordination forums, working groups, and partner meetings.

 Lead programme design and contribute substantially to proposal development, donor engagement, and resource mobilization efforts. 

 Partnerships & Stakeholder Engagement 

 Build and maintain strong relationships with Government counterparts, UN agencies, NGO partners, and community stakeholders.

 Represent IsraAID Uganda at national and district-level coordination meetings as required.

 Support the capacity building of partner Community-Based Organisations (CBOs) in programme implementation. 

 Planning, Budgeting & Compliance 

 Lead programme strategy development and contribute to the Country Strategic Plan, budgeting, and operational planning processes.

 Monitor programme budget utilisation in coordination with the Senior Finance Officer and flag variances in a timely manner.

 Ensure programme activities comply with IsraAID Uganda's policies, donor requirements, and applicable national regulations.

 Perform any other duties as assigned by the Country Director. 

 Risk Monitoring 

 Identify, monitor, and mitigate programmatic, operational, and contextual risks affecting programme delivery across all field locations.

 Maintain an up-to-date programme risk register and report risk status to the Country Director.

 Work with the MEAL Officer to integrate risk monitoring into MEAL systems, including tracking contextual changes that may affect project assumptions or logframe indicators.

 Flag any emerging risks related to security, access, partner performance, or compliance to the Country Director in a timely manner.

 Required Experience and Technical Competencies: 

 Bachelor's degree in Development Studies, Social Sciences, International Relations, Social Work and Social Administration, Public Health, or a related discipline. (Required)

 Master's degree in a relevant field. (Added advantage / Preferred)

 Additional training or certification in project management, MEAL, or humanitarian programming is an advantage.

 Minimum 6 years' progressive experience in humanitarian or development programming, including at least 3 years in a senior management or programme leadership role.

 Demonstrated experience managing multi-sectoral programmes (WASH, Nutrition, Child Protection, and/or MEAL) across multiple field locations.

 Proven experience working in a refugee, displacement, or humanitarian-response setting — experience in the Ugandan refugee context is an added advantage.

 Track record of successful programme design, implementation, and quality assurance against work plans, budgets, and donor agreements.

 Experience with donor-funded grants management and compliance (institutional and/or private donors), including timely and accurate reporting.

 Experience leading proposal development and resource mobilisation.

 Demonstrated experience in staff supervision and team leadership, including managing field-based teams.

 Experience in external representation and networking with government authorities (OPM, district local governments), UN agencies, donors, and coordination forums.

 Skills 

 Strong command of the full project cycle management (PCM) approach: design, implementation, monitoring, and close-out.

 Solid working knowledge of MEAL systems, including indicator and log-frame development, data use, and accountability to affected populations (AAP).

 Budget management and financial oversight of programme grants.

 Proposal and concept-note writing and donor reporting to a high standard.

 Understanding of safeguarding / PSEA and safe programming, and how to embed protection mainstreaming across sectors. 

 Risk identification and management across programmatic, operational, and contextual risks.

 Strong analytical, strategic-planning, and problem-solving skills.

 Excellent written and spoken English; strong report-writing skills.

 Proficiency in MS Office and comfort with data/reporting tools.

 Ability to represent the organisation credibly with donors, government, and partners. 

 Key Behaviors 

 Ability and willingness to take instructions.

 Honest, diligent and trustworthy

 Flexible and adaptable in terms of time management

 Team player

 Proactive attitude in dealing with unexpected situations

 Commitment to IsraAID’s values: Professionalism, Humanity, Collaboration, Flexibility and Adaptability, Resilience 

 ETHICAL STANDARDS 

 IsraAID has zero tolerance towards any acts of misconduct, sexual exploitation, and abuse. The recruitment process will include all candidates’ declarations and reference checks focused on misconduct and SEA.

 EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES 

 IsraAID is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability status.

 Part-time employment contract (20 hours - week) and excellent remuneration package

description:
Senior Operations Analyst (Executive Support) 

 Organization: Portfolio Acquisition Executive Maneuver Air (PAE MA)

 Duty Location: Redstone Arsenal, Huntsville, AL
 Position Type: Full-Time
 Security Clearance: SECRET (Active Required)
 Travel Requirements: Up to 10%

 Position Overview 

 The Senior Operations Analyst (Executive Support) provides high-level administrative, operational, and programmatic synchronization within the Army PAE MA. This role serves as a primary operational conduit and executive coordinator directly supporting Flag Officers and Senior Civilians, specifically:

 2-Star Generals (Major General / Deputy PAE MA)

 1-Star Generals (Brigadier General / Deputy PAE MA)

 Senior Executive Service (SES) (Executive Directors and Senior Civilians)

 Operating in a high-tempo, mission-critical environment, the Senior Operations Analyst ensures seamless battle rhythm execution, executive travel coordination, workflow synchronization, and protocol management across enterprise stakeholders, including military staff, Department of the Army Civilians (DAC), and defense contractor teams.

 Key Responsibilities & Duties 

 Executive Synchronization & Battle Rhythm Management 

 Maintain and synchronize the command battle rhythm for 2-Star, 1-Star, and SES leadership, encompassing executive staff calls, strategic portfolio reviews, and high-level decision briefings.

 Deconflict, prioritize, and manage complex executive master calendars, adjusting in real time to emergent operational requirements and senior Army directives.

 Prepare, organize, and administer executive meeting agendas, read-aheads, minutes, and post-meeting action item logs.

 Task Management & Executive Correspondence 

 Serve as the principal screener and gatekeeper for all incoming and outgoing headquarters taskings and executive correspondence.

 Track, route, and enforce suspense dates for command taskers using enterprise systems (e.g., Task Management Tool / TMT).

 Review, screen, and quality-control briefing slide decks, decision memorandums, Information Papers, and executive summaries to ensure adherence to Army Regulation 25-50 ( Preparing and Managing Correspondence ) and leadership preferences.

 Consolidate and draft recurring executive reports, including weekly Significant Activities (SIGACTs), staff call summaries, and command-level milestones.

 Travel Logistics & Defense Travel System (DTS) 

 Serve as primary Defense Travel Administrator / Arranger for General Officers and SES leadership, handling complex domestic and international travel itineraries.

 Author and process Travel Authorizations and Vouchers in DTS in strict compliance with the Joint Travel Regulations (JTR).

 Coordinate ground transportation, security escorts, lodging, and executive communications requirements during senior leader travel.

 Distinguished Visitors, VIP Protocol & Ceremonies 

 Direct, plan, and execute protocol logistics for visits involving 1-Star/2-Star Flag Officers, SES personnel, Congressional delegations (CODELs/STAFFDELs), foreign dignitaries, and defense industry executives.

 Determine and enforce protocol precedence, seating arrangements, motorcade coordination, and ceremonial standards in alignment with Department of the Army protocol guidance.

 Coordinate cross-functional support for change of command ceremonies, retirement ceremonies, senior leader conferences, and media events.

 Strategic Operational Support & Continuous Improvement 

 Interface with Project Managers (PMs), Project Directors (PDs), and Headquarters Directorate leads to align daily activities with enterprise strategic objectives.

 Evaluate management processes, internal workflows, and reporting architectures; propose and implement operational enhancements to optimize headquarters performance.

 Oversee and facilitate onboarding, security in-processing, and administrative transitions for incoming military and civilian staff officers.

 Position Requirements & Qualifications 

 Education & Credentials 

 Education: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university (Business Administration, Management, Public Policy, Communications, or related discipline preferred).

 Security Clearance: Must possess and maintain an active S. Government SECRET security clearance.

 Professional Experience 

 Experience Level: Minimum of 10+ years of progressive operational, administrative, or programmatic support experience within the Department of Defense (DoD), preferably within the Department of the Army or defense acquisition organizations.

 Executive Support Experience: Proven, successful background directly supporting or routinely interfacing with General Officers (O-7 / O-8) and Senior Executive Service (SES) 

 DoD Systems Mastery: Demonstrated hands-on proficiency with:
Defense Travel System (DTS)

 Task Management Tool (TMT) / Enterprise Task Management systems

 Microsoft Office 365 Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, SharePoint, Teams)

 Core Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs) 

 Military Protocol & Standards: Comprehensive knowledge of Army organizational hierarchy, staff structure, and Flag/SES etiquette.

 Executive Communication: Superior verbal and written communication skills; exceptional ability to distill complex technical data into concise executive briefings and memorandums.

 Discretion & Judgment: Demonstrated experience managing sensitive acquisition, personnel, and operational information with absolute confidentiality and professionalism.

 Agility & Problem Solving: High degree of initiative, sound judgment under pressure, and the capacity to adapt rapidly to shifting executive priorities.

 Working Conditions & Travel 

 Work Environment: Professional military headquarters environment at Redstone Arsenal.

 Travel: Occasional official travel (up to 10%) may be required to support off-site conferences, senior leader symposia, or travel advance

 BENEFITS 

 Health, Supplemental Health, Vision, Dental Insurance 

 401K matching 

 Short-term and Long-term Disability 

 PTO 

 JS Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws and ordinances. The JS Solutions management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities, access to facilities and programs, and general treatment during employment.

description:
Who we are?

 At Inchcape Shipping Services, our vision is to create a connected world where customers can trade successfully and make informed decisions in every port, everywhere. We achieve this by combining our worldwide infrastructure with local expertise, through our global network of more than 250 proprietary offices and a team of over 3,000 dedicated professionals. Our diverse customer base includes owners and charterers in the oil, cruise, container, and bulk commodity sectors, as well as naval, government, and intergovernmental organisations.

 We have an ambitious growth model, and a career here is certainly going to be a rewarding one that will allow you to bring your skills & experience. We embrace change and are open to new thinking and pushing for positive change in our industry.

 Main Purpose of Job 

 Directly reporting to the Port Manager – Port Manager JNPT India, the primary role for this position is to perform all functions relating to the Marine Services at JNPT Location, as well as the full range of support services to the Operations and adherence to excellence customer services in order to carry out the responsibility and to meet the expectation of the customer/principals. 

 This position should involve ensuring QMS standards are adhered to consistently in all operational activities, and to ensure required operation excellence in Offshore Support Service are practice to meet and exceed the expectations of the customer. 

 Excellent Knowledge of Marine Operations inclusive Shipping Agency, Owners protecting agency, Crew Logistics, Husbandry Services, etc. 

 Well versed with the documentation and local procedures, maintaining detailed SOP for Marine and offshore services and needs to update as and when required. 

 Supports to Commercial Team, Country Manager, Operations Manager ECI for any operational related requirements. 

 Team building and able to attend the task individually. 

 Excellent Communication & Coordination Skills: 

 Must be able to communicate effectively with ship crew, port officials, vendors, and internal teams. 

 Capable of handling high-pressure situations, last-minute changes, and operational contingencies with a solution-oriented approach. 

 Well-Versed with Computer Applications: 

 Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook). 

 Experience in using port or shipping software for documentation and reporting. 

 Able to work with online systems like PCS, ICEGATE, DGS e-platforms, etc. 

 Documentation & Compliance Awareness: 

 Strong knowledge of port documentation (e.g., IGM, crew list, customs forms). 

 Should be updated on local port regulations, ISPS procedures, and MMD/MoPS requirements. 

 Problem-Solving and Proactiveness: 

 Should be capable of independently handling vessel calls and resolving on-ground challenges without delay. 

 Must be proactive in updating stakeholders and ensuring smooth turnaround of vessels. 

 Assist principals with the requisite documents to obtain various statutory clearances. 

 Ensuring Zero facilitation/ gifts on board the vessel and NIL complaints from Master and Principals. 

 Ensuring all QMS and Health and Safety standards are being followed in case for all Operational activities. 

 Ensure Documentation Agents, Vendors (Hotel and Transport) vendors adhere Inchcape Health and Safety standards in all accepts. 

 Key Accountabilities: 

 Revenue Generation for Offshore Division: Identifying and Developing Providing major corporate accounts, cultivating the business network for further revenue generation and thus enhancing market share within the defined area of responsibility. 

 Market Intelligence: Maintain awareness of developments across industry by communication the market research to the Commercial team and Senior Management teams locally and regionally to ensure that the company continues to apply the most effective policies and approaches. Monitor competitors actively and ensures that the appropriate responses are developed to any perceived threats to business. Analyse trends in the business environment, help to develop products / services that are responsive. 

 Safety, Quality and Environment: Ensure Compliance to all relevant safety, Quality and environmental procedures and controls across the department to guarantee employee safety, legislative compliance, delivery and ISS HSE policies and procedures. 

 Budget & Cost Control: Prepare, gain acceptance and monitor implementation of the annual budget, to ensure that the budget targets are met, that revenue flows are maximized, and fixed costs are minimized, that areas of unsatisfactory performance are identified and rectified promptly, and potential performance improvement opportunities are capitalized upon. 

 Customer/ Vendor Relationship: Establish and maintain effective formal and informal links with major customers, relevant Liner departments and agencies, Local authorities, Key-decision-makers and other stakeholders generally, to exchange information and views and to ensure that the company is providing the appropriate range and quality of services. Maintain an awareness of customer requirements and any complaints to identify any areas that may need development or improvement 

 Debt Control: Follow up and Monitor the disbursement accounts turnaround and debt collection with the purpose of maintaining a low average of DA’s dates, debtors and credit periods within company set guidelines. 

 Teamwork: Keeps other colleagues to be updated of progress made with discharge operations for the purpose of advising them promptly of any problems arise and to enable them to inform the Principals in good time. 

 HSSE - Health, Safety, Security and Risk (Mandatory requirements) 

 Accountable for assessing HSSE risk and implementing risk controls within area of responsibility. 

 Accountable for reporting all accidents, incidents and near misses whether the persons are injured or not. 

 Taking action within area of accountability to ensure the HSSE of both the job holder and other persons who may be affected by acts carried out or failed to be carried out by the job holder while at work. 

 Ensure full compliance with the ISS HSSE Management System. 

 Essential: 

 Minimum 3 to 5 years’ experience in Shipping and Offshore Industry preferably in the related field. 

 Strong written and verbal communications skills with the ability to convey messages to others when English is not their first language. 

 Graduate / Post Graduate 

 LMS trainings (All Mandatory) 

 Desirable: 

 An imbedded awareness of the market 

 Enlightened business acumen and strong people management skills. 

 PG Diploma 

 Management of Risk 

 (Operational Risk, Health and Safety, Compliance and Corporate Mission Statement.) 

 I will ensure that I read, understand and comply with all company HSSE, Compliance and Ethics policies and procedures in effect in the Company’s Intranet, Athena, which may be updated from time to time- and avoid any activity that might lead to, or suggest, a breach of these policies. If there is an element of doubt, I will seek clarification. The term ‘Compliance’ covers all legislation, rules and codes in which the company must adhere to. 

 I confirm that I will satisfactorily complete any training in relation to HSSE, Compliance and Ethics, as deemed necessary by the Company and will continually support and demonstrate the principals laid out in the ISS Code of Excellence and ISS Mission Statement. 

 I understand that a breach of Company policies or failure to carry out necessary training may lead to disciplinary action being taken. 

 Why Inchcape Shipping Services?

 We believe in building a diverse and high performing workforce, that works together to provide our customers with the exceptional service they deserve. To reach the highest standards we depend on our people, their welfare, training and expertise. We realize the value of our staff and know that your unique experiences, skills and passions will help you to build a rich and rewarding career in our dynamic industry. Our values are at the center of everything we do and the successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate and fully adopt these: 

A diverse range of benefits, depending on your geographical location. Globally as a minimum you will receive: 

 A retirement savings plan 

 Life assurance 

 Holiday starting at 22 days 

 Healthcare 

 Competitive salary 

 Employee Assistance Programmed 

 Career development and progression opportunities 

 Values Award celebration events 

 Team building days

 Plus, much more!If you think that you have the right skills, knowledge and attitude to join our team, then we invite you to apply by simply clicking at the top of this advert!#ISSthebiggerpicture Appointment to this role will be subject to satisfactory references and possession of a valid Right to Work documentation depending upon your geographical location. Inchcape is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and equality; diversity and inclusion are at the center of everything we do. We recognize that our customers, colleagues, contractors and other partners are central to our success and that we work in a diverse society. We acknowledge not only our legal, but also our moral responsibility to ensure all groups have equality of opportunity

 In return, we will offer you:
 Progress - we adopt new thinking and push for positive change in our industry.
 The Power of People - we rely on the strength of local agent knowledge and relationships.
 Global Perspective - we connect the world and see the bigger picture.

description:
Company Description JSAS HealthCare, Inc. (JSASHC) is a CARF-accredited outpatient opioid treatment program licensed by the New Jersey Department of Health. The organization specializes in Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT), counseling, and peer support services for individuals with opioid use disorder. JSASHC focuses on evidence-based care delivered in an outpatient setting, enabling participants to receive treatment while maintaining their daily responsibilities. The team is committed to reducing the impact of opioid use disorder through compassionate, person-centered care and ongoing support for long-term recovery.

 Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Registered Nurse for our new Mobile Medication based in Neptune, NJ. The Registered Nurse in Substance Abuse Treatment will provide direct patient care within an outpatient opioid treatment setting, including administering and monitoring Medication-Assisted Treatment (such as methadone or buprenorphine) in accordance with clinical protocols and regulatory standards. Daily responsibilities include conducting nursing assessments, monitoring vital signs and withdrawal symptoms, documenting care accurately in medical records, and collaborating with physicians, counselors, and peer support staff to implement individualized care plans. The nurse will provide patient education on medications, harm reduction, and health promotion, as well as support crisis intervention and referral to higher levels of care when needed. Additional responsibilities include maintaining medication inventory, ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations, and participating in quality improvement and interdisciplinary team meetings.

 Qualifications 

 Active, unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in the State of New Jersey; current CPR/BLS certification required.

 Strong clinical assessment and patient care skills, including monitoring for medication side effects, withdrawal symptoms, and medical or psychiatric changes.

 Proficiency in accurate documentation, electronic health records (EHR) use, and adherence to regulatory and confidentiality standards (including HIPAA).

 Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with an interdisciplinary team and provide nonjudgmental, trauma-informed, and culturally sensitive care.

 Ability to manage time, prioritize tasks, and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced outpatient environment.

 Benefits 

 Sign on bonus $5,000.00

 Comprehensive medical, prescription, dental, vision and health reimbursement account. Eligible 60 days from hire. 

 Life insurance

 Long Term Disability insurance

 ALFAC

description:
Company Overview 

 Where metal meets momentum. Where bold ideas become the products everyone else wishes they built.
Welcome to JR Metal Works . One of the fastest-rising names in American manufacturing.

 We combine precision engineering, modern fabrication technology, and true craftsmanship to create products built to last. As we continue to grow, we remain deeply committed to quality, safety, and continuous improvement, on the shop floor and beyond.

 At JR Metal Works, you’re not just filling a role. You’re joining a team that values integrity, teamwork, and problem-solving. We invest in your growth so you can build a career with real impact.

 We offer competitive pay, a comprehensive benefits package, and clear opportunities for advancement in a company that’s moving forward—fast.

 Position Summary 

 The Project Designer is responsible for creating, reviewing, and supporting technical designs that meet customer specifications and internal manufacturing requirements. This role collaborates closely with customers, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure designs are accurate, manufacturable, and aligned with production capabilities.

 The Project Designer supports projects from design through production and installation, contributing to quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement across the organization.

 Core Responsibilities 

 Create and review technical drawings to ensure compliance with customer specifications, internal standards, and manufacturing requirements.

 Develop and maintain job travelers to support accurate and efficient production execution.

 Perform tolerance analysis on critical assemblies to ensure proper fit, function, and performance.

 Meet with suppliers, customers, and project stakeholders to review designs and implement changes as required.

 Modify and update designs to resolve operating, quality, or production issues.

 Provide installation support as needed to ensure successful implementation of designed components or assemblies.

 Attend team and project meetings to provide progress updates, coordinate with colleagues, plan next steps, and stay informed on emerging product lines.

 Maintain accurate documentation and adhere to JR Metal Works’ quality, safety, and continuous improvement standards.

 Qualifications & Skills 

 Proficiency in SolidWorks software and technical drawing creation.

 Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, tolerancing, and assembly design.

 Ability to interpret customer prints, specifications, and technical requirements.

 Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

 Effective communication skills with internal teams, customers, and suppliers.

 Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

 Commitment to quality, accuracy, and continuous improvement.

 Career Growth & Development 

 JR Metal Works is committed to helping employees build long-term, rewarding careers. Each position is supported by a Position Information Sheet (PIS) that clearly outlines role expectations, skill milestones, and growth pathways.

 Position Information Sheets provide transparency into:

 Performance and merit-based pay progression

 Skill and responsibility milestones

 Leadership growth and development opportunities

 Cross-training and internal advancement paths

 Training, certification, and professional development expectations

 Advancement at JR Metal Works is based on demonstrated performance, skill mastery, accountability, and alignment with company values. Employees are encouraged to actively engage with their Position Information Sheet and leadership team to track progress and plan their next career step.

 This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities. Duties may change at any time with or without notice. 

 Employment with JR Metal Works is at-will and may be terminated by either the employee or the Company at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law. 

 JR Metal Works is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. 

 Employees are expected to comply with all company policies, safety procedures, and applicable federal, state, and local regulations. Nothing in this job description creates a contract of employment or guarantees compensation or advancement.

Sobre Nosotros: 

 En Koltin , estamos rediseñando la forma en que cuidamos a nuestros papás, mamás, abuelos y abuelas, con el objetivo de ayudarles a mantenerse saludables, activos e independientes durante el mayor tiempo posible . Lo hacemos a través de nuestras membresías de salud , que integran: 

 Atención clínica enfocada en la prevención 

 Cobertura médica de gastos mayores 

 Programas de bienestar y comunidad 

 Somos la primera empresa en México que protege a personas adultas mayores, desde los 50 hasta los 84 años . Estamos creciendo rápidamente en todo el país, con un propósito claro: transformar la experiencia de salud para las Grandes Personas , haciéndola más humana, accesible y digna . 

 Sobre el puesto 

 Este es un puesto de ejecución, no de decisión: lleva a cabo la operación diaria de Comunidad para que la coordinación pueda concentrarse en crecimiento, experiencia y relación con aliados. Reporta directamente a Comunidad. 

 Eres un buen fit si eres una persona que: 

 Es muy organizada y tiene buena comunicación escrita y verbal 

 Se siente cómoda operando varios frentes a la vez y con plazos cortos 

 Sigue procesos definidos sin necesidad de tomar decisiones estratégicas 

 Tiene un fuerte fit cultural para el trato directo y cercano con personas adultas mayores (se valoran perfiles de Trabajo Social o afines) 

 Responsabilidades: 

 Gestionar la comunicación de Comunidad y resolver dudas de expertas 

 Operar el teléfono de Comunidad, dando seguimiento a mensajes y dudas de las Grandes Personas 

 Administrar los grupos de Líderes de Comunidad y Grupos de Interés por WhatsApp 

 Llevar el control del inventario de Comunidad 

 Coordinar las invitaciones a las Grandes Personas para las distintas actividades 

 Resolver los imprevistos operativos del día (asignación de lugares, comunicaciones urgentes) siguiendo los lineamientos ya definidos por la coordinación 

 Asegurar la correcta ejecución logística de las actividades de Comunidad 

 Objetivos del rol : 

 Sostener la ejecución diaria y la logística de la operación de Comunidad 

 Liberar a la coordinación de tareas operativas del día a día para que pueda enfocarse en crecimiento, experiencia y relación con aliados 

 Mantener los tiempos de respuesta y la calidad de atención a las Grandes Personas 

 B eneficios : 

 🎓 Acceso a herramientas y beneficios para tu crecimiento profesional, como cursos, talleres, libros, etc 

 💊 Asistencia médica privada por videollamada (médico general, nutriólogo y psicólogo) ilimitado para ti y 3 familiares 

 🏈 Acceso a herramientas para tu cuidado físico (Total Pass) 

 🌴 9 días adicionales de vacaciones por ley al año 

 👓 Seguro de Gastos Médicos Mayores 

 💻 Equipo necesario para hacer tu trabajo 

 💵 Apoyo mensual de $700 pesos adicionales al sueldo 

 💎 Ergonomics allowance por un monto 2,500 (monto de única ocasión para adecuar tu espacio de trabajo tras el periodo de prueba)

 Part-Time | Dublin 

 About the role 
Leevin Group is looking for a proactive and outgoing person to support our growth within the Irish university market.
This entry-level, part-time opportunity may be particularly suitable for a student interested in developing practical experience in sales, customer engagement and business development.
Main responsibilities

 Build relationships with universities, student societies and the local student community. 

 Promote Leevin’s accommodation services to prospective customers and partners. 

 Attend student fairs, induction events and university activities. 

 Contact and follow up with prospective customers and partners. 

 Record leads and activities in the company’s CRM system. 

 Work with the Commercial and Marketing teams on student-focused initiatives. 

 Identify new opportunities to increase Leevin’s visibility within the university market. 

 About you

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. 

 Good understanding of student life and the university environment in Ireland. 

 Confident, proactive and comfortable engaging with new people. 

 Interested in sales, marketing or business development. 

 Organised and customer-focused. 

 Valid permission to work in Ireland. 

 Desirable

 Involvement with a student union or university society. 

 Previous experience in sales, customer service, retail, hospitality or events. 

 Knowledge of the international student market in Ireland.

 Dublin

 Level:
 Entry-level

 20h

description:
We are looking for a dedicated, team-oriented candidate to join our Facilities Technician team at the Alhambra at Poinciana location in Kissimmee , FL! 

 Work Type: Full-time, year-round. Hourly. 

 Work Schedule: Varying shifts between 7AM-10PM. 

 Work Hours: 40 hours a week, 8-hour shifts. 

 This position requires weekend availability. 

 Must be available for an on-call schedule. 

 Robust benefits packages available. 

 Position Summary: 

 Supports facilities technician team with knowledge of all aspects of facilities maintenance. Enhancement of property work environment. Responds and attends to guest repair requests. Communicates with guests/customers to resolve maintenance issues. Performs preventive maintenance on tools and kitchen and mechanical room equipment, including cleaning and lubrication. Visually inspects tools, equipment, or machines. Carries equipment (e.g., tools, radio). Identifies, locates, and operates all shut-off valves for equipment and all utility shut-offs for buildings. Maintains maintenance inventory and requisitions parts and supplies as needed. Communicates each day’s activities and problems that occur to the other shifts using approved communication programs and standards. Displays basic knowledge or ability to acquire knowledge in the following categories: air conditioning and refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, pneumatic/electronic systems and controls, carpentry and finish skills, kitchen equipment, vehicles, energy conservation, and/or general building. Performs all surface preparation, painting, minor drywall and wood trim repair, light bulb and A/C filter replacement and the complete and thorough clean-up of the painting or repair area. Tests, troubleshoots, and performs basic repair on all types of equipment, plumbing (e.g., plunge toilets and unclog drains), electrical components including lamps, cosmetic items, extension cords, vacuum cleaners, internet devices, replace electrical switches and outlets, and other guest room items. Programs TV's and performs general housekeeping and technician-related inventory duties. Uses the Lockout/Tagout system before performing any maintenance work. Perform repairs on interior and exterior landscaping as well as external landscaping sprinklers. Displays basic computer skills including inputting air handler schedules and making temperature changes.

 Reports accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Follows all company policies and procedures, ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcomes and acknowledges all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests’ service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speaks with others using clear and professional language, prepare and review written documents accurately and completely, and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develops and maintains positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other associates. Complies with quality assurance and standards. Performs other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

 Key Duties/Accountabilities 

 Addresses guests' service needs in a professional, positive, and timely manner.

 Welcomes and acknowledges every guest with a smile, eye contact, and a friendly verbal greeting, using the guest's name when possible.

 Actively listens and responds positively to guest questions, concerns, and requests.

 Responds to all guest complaints promptly and, if cannot remedy the situation, let the proper people know so they can follow up and try to satisfy the guest. Cleans all technician areas as directed by Management.

 Looks for ways to conserve energy and report any ideas to Management.

 Maintains maintenance inventory and requisition parts and supplies as needed.

 Assures each day’s activities and problems that occur are communicated to the other shifts using approved communication programs and standards.

 Reads, logs, tracks, and interprets readings from meters, gauges and other measuring devices in accordance with inspection and rounds procedures.

 Assists in the compilation of data for preventive maintenance inspection records.

 Displays basic proficiency in the following categories: air conditioning and refrigeration, electrical, mechanical,

 Plumbing, pneumatic/electronic systems and controls, carpentry and finish skills, kitchen equipment, vehicles, energy conservation, and/or general building.

 Performs all surface preparation and painting, minor drywall and wood trim repair, light bulb and A/C filter replacement and the complete and thorough clean-up of the painting or repair area.

 Tests, troubleshoots, and performs basic repair on all types of equipment, plumbing (e.g., plunge toilets and unclog drains), electrical components including lamps, cosmetic items, extension cords, vacuum cleaners, internet devices, replace electrical switches and outlets, and program TV's.

 Performs repairs on interior and exterior landscaping as well as external landscaping sprinklers.

 Performs general housekeeping and technician-related inventory duties.

 Safety and Accident Prevention 

 Follows company and department safety and security policies and procedures to promote a clean, safe, and secure environment.

 Completes appropriate safety training and certifications to perform work tasks.

 Follows policies and procedures for the safe operation and storage of tools, equipment, and machines.

 Follows Hazardous Material Management Program procedures for handling and disposing of chemicals, fertilizer, pesticides, blood borne pathogens, etc., including using Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS).

 Uses proper equipment, wear appropriate personal protective clothing (PPE), and employ correct lifting procedures, as necessary, to avoid injury.

 Identifies and corrects unsafe work procedures or conditions and/or report them to management and security/safety personnel.

 Maintains proficiency of fire sprinkler and emergency power system and be familiar with the duties and responsibilities of the Fire and Emergency Rescue Teams.

 Expected Conduct 

 Utilizes professional language at all times

 Consistently models professional behavior

 Remains calm during stressful and hectic periods

 Self manages time and appropriate commitment to meeting goals

 Plans accordingly for job duties to be fulfilled when absent or taking leave

 Always presents a positive attitude with respect to the Company and co-workers

 Always represents the Company, especially when in the presence of team, vendors, and guests

 Stays compliant with Company policies and government regulations regarding employment practices, as communicated by the Human Resources Department.

 Reinforces these practices with team members, especially in relation to harassment, discrimination, and hostile work environment

 Qualities & Characteristics 

 Advanced maintenance facilities and technical knowledge

 Strong customer service orientation and skills

 Highly organized

 Excellent time management and multi-tasking skills

 Exceptional teamwork

 Ability to work flexible hours including weekends and evenings as required

 Clear, concise communications skills (verbal and written)

 Physical Demands 

 Visually inspects tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects).

 Reaches overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.

 Moves, lifts, carries, pushes, pulls, and places objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance.

 Grasps, turns, manipulates objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination.

 Enters and locates work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems.

 Moves over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces.

 Reads and visually verifies information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print).

 Stands, sits, or walks for an extended period or for an entire work shift

 Preferred Qualifications 

 ** Kindly be advised that all educational credentials listed on your resume will be subject to verification and validation. ** 

 High school diploma or G.E.D.; or one to three month’s related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

 Technical Trade or Vocational School Degree

 Company Culture 

 Celebrate Success

 Strive for Excellence

 Seek to Understand

 Adapt Quickly

 Tell the Truth

 Change Champions

 Human Centric

Communicates with guests/customers to resolve maintenance issues. Performs preventive maintenance on tools and kitchen and mechanical room equipment, including cleaning and lubrication. Visually inspects tools, equipment, or machines. Carries equipment (e.g., tools, radio). Identifies, locates, and operates all shut-off valves for equipment and all utility shut-offs for buildings. Maintains maintenance inventory and requisitions parts and supplies as needed. Communicates each day’s activities and problems that occur to the other shifts using approved communication programs and standards. Displays basic knowledge or ability to acquire knowledge in the following categories: air conditioning and refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, pneumatic/electronic systems and controls, carpentry and finish skills, kitchen equipment, vehicles, energy conservation, and/or general building. Performs all surface preparation, painting, minor drywall and wood trim repair, light bulb and A/C filter replacement and the complete and thorough clean-up of the painting or repair area. Tests, troubleshoots, and performs basic repair on all types of equipment, plumbing (e.g., plunge toilets and unclog drains), electrical components including lamps, cosmetic items, extension cords, vacuum cleaners, internet devices, replace electrical switches and outlets, and other guest room items. Programs TV's and performs general housekeeping and technician-related inventory duties. Uses the Lockout/Tagout system before performing any maintenance work. Perform repairs on interior and exterior landscaping as well as external landscaping sprinklers. Displays basic computer skills including inputting air handler schedules and making temperature changes.


Reports accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Follows all company policies and procedures, ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcomes and acknowledges all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests’ service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speaks with others using clear and professional language, prepare and review written documents accurately and completely, and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develops and maintains positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other associates. Complies with quality assurance and standards. Performs other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.


Key Duties/Accountabilities

  • Addresses guests' service needs in a professional, positive, and timely manner.

description:
Job Description | FP&A and Actuarial Analyst
Reports to: FP&A and Actuarial Director
Location: Paris, France or London, United Kingdom

About MAXIS GBN
MAXIS GBN was co-founded in 1998 by MetLife and AXA, two of the largest and most trusted insurance companies in the world. In 2016, MAXIS GBN became a joint venture and established itself in London with offices at Monument where we employ an international team of 100 staff, with another 90 based in eight countries around the world.
At MAXIS GBN, we work with multinational companies to help them deliver employee benefits (EB) to their staff around the world. We are a market leader in the global EB space, offering global pooled and captive solutions as well as comprehensive wellness packages.
We do this through working with a network of local insurance companies (members) in more than 100 markets globally. More than 80% of our member insurers are owned by MetLife or AXA, the other 20% are independent local insurers – all are experts in their markets and help us to find the right solutions for the local offices of multinationals and their employees based there.
Our London headquarters houses support services from global marketing to finance to client reporting and underwriting while working with colleagues based in offices in locations across Europe, the USA and Asia.

Summary of Responsibilities
The FP&A and Actuarial Analyst is responsible for supporting the financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, and analysis processes to drive strategic decision-making within the company. This role involves analysing financial data, preparing reports, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve financial performance and operational efficiency.

Key responsibilities include:
• Run quarterly profitability analysis on MAXIS portfolio
• Perform analysis to compare actual results against budgets and forecasts
• Analyse key financial metrics, operational KPIs, and business drivers
• Conduct forecasting and historical series analysis to propose corrective actions to specific technical issues detected in the portfolio, in full alignment with other technical departments
• Support strategic initiatives by providing financial modelling and scenario analysis
• Conduct ad-hoc deep-dive financial analysis to support decision-making
• Calculate and review reserves for outstanding claims and policy liabilities
• Development and management of technical features of MAXIS products
• Support in the relationship with AXA / MetLife about technical initiatives

Required Competencies
• Master’s degree in Mathematics, Actuarial Sciences, Statistics or equivalent discipline
• 2-3 years of experience in FP&A or actuarial role, equivalently 1-2 years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm. Any other relevant position is considered
• Strong proficiency in Excel
• Familiarity with programming languages (Python, R) is a plus
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent communication and presentation abilities
• Ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple priorities
• Detail oriented and proactive approach
• Willingness to work and ambition to grow in a dynamic and international environment
• Quick learner, proactive and enthusiast
• Fluency in English is required, French or any other language is a plus

Joins-toi à notre division logicielle, Matissoft, et prends part au développement de notre marché à l’échelle du Canada! En tant que Représentant des ventes – Reste du Canada, tu seras au cœur de notre stratégie de croissance et auras la responsabilité de faire rayonner nos solutions technologiques auprès des meuneries canadiennes, de l’Ontario jusqu’à la Colombie-Britannique.

Tu assureras la vente de l’ensemble des solutions technologiques conçu par l’équipe de Matissoft, en plus de maintenir le lien d’affaires avec les clients actuels.


TÂCHES ET RESPONSABILITÉS PRINCIPALES

  • Développer et mettre en œuvre une stratégie de vente ciblée pour accroître la présence des solutions Matissoft sur le territoire canadien ;
  • Réaliser en entier le processus de vente de solutions technologiques (ERP, MES/SCADA, TI, Instrumentation et contrôle) incluant :
    • La préparation, la coordination et l’animation de présentations commerciales auprès de différents niveaux hiérarchiques ;
    • Une participation à la négociation des ententes ;
    • La rédaction des propositions d’offres ;
    • La conclusion des ventes ;
  • Prospecter de nouvelles opportunités d’affaires chez nos clients actuels et de nouveaux clients;
  • Proposer des solutions technologiques adaptées aux enjeux opérationnels des meuneries canadiennes ; 
  • Établir et maintenir des relations solides et durables avec les clients ;
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes techniques (ingénierie, développement logiciel et intégration) pour garantir la pertinence et la faisabilité des solutions proposées ;
  • Assurer un suivi rigoureux des opportunités et gérer le pipeline des ventes dans le CRM (logiciel de gestion de la relation client) ;
  • Participer à des salons professionnels, conférences et événements de l’industrie afin de promouvoir l’entreprise.


PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

  • Diplôme en automatisation (DEC/BAC) ou dans un domaine technique connexe et 10 ans d'expérience pertinente ;

OU

Join our software division, Matissoft, and help us expand our market across Canada! As a Sales Representative - Rest of Canada, you’ll be at the heart of our growth strategy and will be responsible for promoting our technology solutions to Canadian Feed Mills, from Ontario to British Columbia.

You’ll be responsible for selling the full range of technology solutions developed by the Matissoft team, as well as maintaining business relationships with existing clients.


KEY RESPONSABILITIES

  • Develop and implement a targeted sales strategy to increase the presence of Matissoft solutions across the Canadian market;

  • Recommend technology solutions tailored to the operational challenges of Canadian feed mills;

  • Work closely with technical teams (engineering, software development and integration) to ensure the relevance and feasibility of proposed solutions;

Summary/Objective 

 The Supervisor will provide work direction to shift leadership team and subordinates to achieve safety, machine, quality, delivery, cost and people objectives set by the customer and MAU. This will require the Supervisor to manage the daily tasks of manufacturing and material movement associates working in various departments throughout the Mill.

 Position Type/Expected Hours of Work: 

 This is a full-time position. Hours are 12-hour rotating shifts, working 2-2-3 schedule.

 Essential Functions 

 Customer Expectations:

 Lead Pre-Shift Meetings.

 Attend scheduled daily performance meetings with the customer.

 Manage employee work assignments based on turnover and call-offs.

 Communicate shift turnover effectively.

 Perform Gemba walks throughout the shift (Process Compliance).

 Verify production via Hour-by-Hour reporting.

 Address issues that are below target.

 Document corrective actions.

 Respond/Perform special requests from the customer.

 Address Concerns & Provide Follow Up on actions taken.

 Update communication boards (SQDC).

 Ability to implement countermeasures and apply containment. 

 Ensure 5S standards are maintained.

 Ensure associate compliance with Dress code and MAU policies.

 Talent Management:

 Manage MAU associates.

 Sustain and Support Leader Standard Work.

 Be an agent of change and proactive with conflict resolution.

 Management Crisis i.e.
safety issues, injuries, property damage, etc.

 Provide continuous training efforts to improve team performance.

 Oversee Process Improvement.

 Take part in Safety investigations.

 Facilitate security compliance and suspension of employees.

 Operational Management:

 Promote/support a positive Safety Culture.

 Ensure profitability of the Minimize/eliminate property damage risk.

 Provide post-accident reports and drug testing.

 Maintain payroll/Kronos daily.

 Support and operate within headcount allocations.

 Manage expectations regarding Safety and Quality rules.

 Participate in continuous improvement projects when expectations aren’t met.

 Perform employee attendance counseling.

 Actively participate in Simple Problem solving.

 Competencies 

 Written and Verbal Communication Proficiency

 Customer/Client Focus

 Problem Solving/Analysis

 Time Management

 Project Management

 Decision Making

 Leadership

 Teamwork Oriented

 Results Driven

 Excellent office/computer skills

 Excellent interpersonal skills

 Required Competencies for all MAU Staff 

 Ethical Conduct

 Personal Effectiveness/Credibility

 Required Education and Experience 

 Associate’s degree OR High school diploma with three to five years supervisory experience in a manufacturing / logistics setting

 Preferred Education and Experience 

 Bachelor’s Degree

 HR Certification (PHR or SHRM-CP)

 Lean Greenbelt

 Root cause analysis training

 Supervisory Responsibility 

 Direct the activity of 20+ hourly associates

 Career Path Progression from this position 

 Operations Manager

 Platform Manager

 Site Manager

 General Manager

 Other Corporate Support Functions

 Work Environment or Working Conditions 

 The working conditions and environments are created by our customers’ facilities both in administrative areas and manufacturing environments. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, and fax machines. Customer sites sometimes include process manufacturing equipment and heavy power industrial vehicles. Environments may vary from non-temperature-controlled environments to GMP clean room required. 

 Physical Demands 

 This position may require the following to be performed with or without reasonable accommodation:

 Ability to bend, climb, stoop, kneel, crouch and lift approximately 75 pounds

 Ability to continuously mount and dismount a vehicle

 Ability to stand/walk for up to 8 hours

 Ability to climb 5 flights of stairs multiple times a day

 Travel 

 This role requires up to 5% travel.

 EEO Statement
 MAU is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Minorities, women, protected Veterans, and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

 Other Duties 

 Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

description:
Full-Time Assistant Teacher / Campus Floater 

 Infant, Toddler, and Preschool/Kindergarten | Morgan Hill, CA 

 Are you a nurturing, energetic educator who enjoys variety and being part of a supportive school community? 

 Montessori School of Silicon Valley is seeking a Full-Time Assistant Teacher/Campus Floater to support classrooms across our Morgan Hill campus. In this role, you will work with children from infancy through kindergarten, helping them develop independence, confidence, and a joyful love of learning. 

 As a valued member of our campus team, you will move between classrooms to maintain ratios, cover teacher breaks, and provide support wherever it is needed most. You will partner closely with Lead Guides and school leadership to maintain warm, orderly, and developmentally appropriate Montessori environments. 

 Responsibilities 

 Support Infant, Toddler, and Preschool classrooms throughout the school day. 

 Collaborate with Lead Guides and campus staff to maintain nurturing, engaging, and safe classroom environments. 

 Assist with daily routines, classroom transitions, individual and small-group activities, and teacher coverage. 

 Support children’s daily care needs, including diapering, toilet learning, feeding, and rest routines. 

 Provide attentive supervision and prioritize the safety and well-being of every child. 

 Model calm, respectful guidance and support children through redirection and social-emotional development. 

 Prepare classroom materials, refresh shelves, and help keep learning environments clean, organized, and inviting. 

 Communicate proactively with classroom teams and administrators regarding coverage, materials, and children’s needs. 

 Live our commitment to “Children First, Always." 

 Qualifications 

 A minimum of 12 Early Childhood Education units is required. 

 Current CPR and First Aid certification, or willingness to obtain certification. 

 Ability to obtain required criminal record and background clearances. 

 Experience working with infants, toddlers, or preschool-aged children is preferred. 

 Dependable, punctual, and consistent in attendance. 

 Warm, professional, patient, and calm, with a positive attitude. 

 Strong observational, organizational, and communication skills. 

 Ability to work collaboratively and adapt comfortably to different classrooms, age groups, and daily needs. 

 Ability to move throughout classrooms and playgrounds and assist with classroom materials and routines. 

 Interest in Montessori education. Previous Montessori experience is welcomed but not required, and training will be provided. 

 Schedule and Benefits 

 Full-time, Monday through Friday 

 Consistent daytime schedule 

 Medical and dental insurance 

 401(k) with employer match 

 Paid time off and paid holidays 

 Professional development and Montessori training opportunities 

 Tuition reimbursement for continued education 

 Supportive, collaborative school community 

 Compensation 

 Competitive hourly rate based on education and experience 

 Grow With Us 

 This position is an excellent opportunity to gain experience across multiple age groups, learn from experienced Montessori educators, and build a meaningful career in early childhood education. We offer ample opportunities for professional growth and advancement within our school community.

description:
About Miggo 

Miggo is building the next generation of application security. We operate a high-scale, data-intensive platform and are looking for a strong DevOps Engineer with SRE capabilities to join a strong, ambitious team. This is an opportunity to have real impact on the company and help build something big from the ground up.

 The Role 

You'll own and evolve the infrastructure and reliability of our production platform — a distributed, data-heavy system running on AWS and Kubernetes. You'll work closely with engineering to keep our services fast, reliable, and observable as we scale, while continuously improving our automation, deployment, and operational processes.

This role is a fit for someone responsible and hands-on, who wants to contribute to the team effort, take ownership, and keep learning and expanding their capabilities.

 What You'll Do 

 Design, build, and operate scalable, resilient infrastructure on AWS and Kubernetes.

 Own reliability: define SLOs/SLIs, improve observability, and drive down toil through automation.

 Manage and tune our core data and workflow systems — ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and Temporal — for performance and reliability at scale.

 Build and maintain CI/CD and GitOps workflows using ArgoCD and GitHub.

 Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform.

 Lead incident response, run postmortems, and drive systemic improvements.

 Establish and improve engineering and operational processes suited to a company operating at scale.

 Partner with development teams to make the right reliability, cost, and scalability tradeoffs.

 What We're Looking For 

 Strong hands-on experience as a DevOps and/or SRE engineer.

 Deep experience with Kubernetes and AWS in production.

 Solid experience with Temporal, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and ClickHouse.

 Experience with Terraform (IaC) and GitOps tooling such as ArgoCD.

 Familiarity with processes and practices for companies operating at scale.

 A responsible, ownership-driven mindset with strong collaboration and communication skills.

 Eagerness to learn, grow, and contribute to a shared team effort.

 Our Stack 

AWS · Kubernetes · ArgoCD · Terraform · ClickHouse · PostgreSQL · Kafka · Temporal · GitHub

 Why Miggo 

 Big impact: your work directly shapes how we scale and operate.

 Build something meaningful: help lay the foundation for a strong, growing platform.

 Strong team: work alongside talented engineers who care about quality and ownership.

 Growth: room to expand your skills and take on increasing responsibility.

description:
Hey future leader! If you’ve been feeling like you’ve hit a ceiling and crave more, MilkShake Factory is calling your name. We’re a family-owned business with a passion for creating sweet experiences, and we’re looking for driven leaders who are ready to grow into General Managers and beyond. With 10 locations in Pittsburgh and a national presence on the rise, the sky’s the limit for your career with us!

 Why Join MilkShake Factory? 

 Great Pay for Great Work: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we make sure it shows in your paycheck.

 Flexibility for Your Life: Need balance? We get it! Flexible scheduling makes sure you’ve got time for work and play.

 Take That Much-Needed Break: With 13 days of paid time off, you’ll have plenty of time to recharge.

 Unlimited Growth Potential: Dreaming of becoming a General Manager? We’ve got a clear path to help you get there—your success is our priority!

 Team-First Vibes: We’re all about people, and that starts with a collaborative, supportive environment where every team member shines.

 Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, pet insurance—we’ve got you and your loved ones covered.

 Lead with Confidence: You’ll run the show at your location, but you’re never alone—we’ll be there to back you up every step of the way.

 Guest-Centered Service: Delivering an exceptional guest experience is at the heart of what we do. We’re all about those memorable moments that keep people coming back for more.

 Who Fits Right In? 

 Natural Leaders: If you love inspiring your team and keeping things positive, this is your jam.

 Growth-Minded Go-Getters: You’ve got your sights set on growth, and we’re here to help you reach it.

 Future General Managers: If you’re hungry for that next step, we’ll help you make it happen.

 Clear Communicators: You know how to connect with your team and keep things running smoothly.

 Mentor Material: You’re passionate about helping others grow, just like we are.

 Ready to Shake Things Up? 
Hit that apply button, and let’s make your next career move the most exciting one yet. We can’t wait to see how you grow with us at MilkShake Factory!

description:
Arborist Trainee - Andover, NH

 $19-21 Hourly 

 Lucas Tree Experts, a leader in the tree care industry, is looking for motivated individuals to join our team as Ground Operations Technicians/Arborist Trainees. The ideal candidate will be self-motivated and willing to learn all aspects of the trade: felling, climbing, rigging, equipment operation, and vegetation management. 

 No experience in the tree industry necessary! Lucas Tree Experts provides FREE on-the-job training for those willing, able, and interested in learning this skilled trade.

 Are you looking for a company that provides career advancement opportunities? 

 Lucas Tree Experts will not only pay for your licensing and certifications to advance your career in the Tree Industry, but they will also provide wage increases for each that is obtained along the way.

 Why Lucas Tree Experts?

 Free On-the-Job Training (Including CDL)

 High earning potential with weekly incentives

 Safety first culture

 Advancement opportunities

 Paid time off and paid holidays

 Competitive and comprehensive benefits package

 401(k) with company match

 Work outdoors!

 This is a full time, year-round, outdoor, physical labor opportunity. Duties: manual removal of vegetation from work areas, pesticide application, safely operating various forestry equipment ( skidders, mowers, chainsaws, ATV's ) and performing line clearance, pruning, and removals. 

 REQUIREMENTS: 

 Must be able to work 45 hours weekly.
Must be 18 years of age with a High School Diploma/GED/or equivalent.
Must have a current and valid driver’s license with reliable transportation.
Must be able to work outside in various types of weather.
Must be physically able to perform the requirements of the position (i.e., walk on uneven grounds, carry 75 lbs.)
Must be willing to work at varying heights.
Must be willing and able to learn how to run a bucket truck & operate equipment safely.
Must be willing and able to obtain a CDL A or B license.
Must be willing and able to obtain, and maintain licenses & certifications as required by the position in order to grow your career.
Must be able to successfully complete a post offer physical & drug screen as well as a background and motor vehicle check.

 Successful professionals at Lucas Tree Experts have come from a variety of backgrounds, including Utility Line Clearance, Integrated Vegetation Management, Arboriculture, Field Operations Management, Supervisor, Environmental Studies, Horticulture, Arborist, Forestry, Off-Road, Natural Resource Management, Storm Restoration, and Landscape Maintenance.

 Lucas Tree Experts offers paid, hands-on, on-the-job training, paid educational courses for advancement in the industry. We also offer safety and bonus incentive programs as well as a complete benefits package.

 Come work for a company that offers advancement opportunities and a great quality of work life! 

 *Please Note: Correspondence will be primarily via e-mail. Please provide us with a working e-mail on your application. If you don't hear from Lucas Tree within a day, please check your spam folder.
