description:
At Mergon, we mould ideas for a sustainable future. We work with leading brands like Tesla, BMW, Xerox and Abbott to design, manufacture and deliver sustainable products for the vehicles and equipment of the future. 

 We care deeply about our colleagues, customers and our community and have a curiosity that constantly pushes us to innovate and improve. We are competent, capable and invest in our people and our processes so that we continue to grow and do our best work every day. 

 Role Overview 

 We are seeking an experienced EHS and Facilities Manager to join our team at Mergon International. This is a broad and influential leadership role with accountability for the effectiveness, continual improvement and assurance of our Health and Safety Management System, which is certified to ISO 45001, our Environmental and Energy Management Systems, certified to ISO 14001 and ISO 50001, and the leadership of the Facilities team on site. 

 A central part of the role is to help Mergon further strengthen its safety culture by embedding health and safety into day-to-day operational management. The EHS and Facilities Manager will provide the framework, expertise, coaching, challenge and assurance that enables line managers to own safe work execution and safety outcomes in their areas. The role is therefore both a technical leadership position and a key change leadership role, supporting the transition from safety being managed by the EHS function to safety being led by the line and enabled by EHS. 

 The successful candidate will ensure strong regulatory compliance, effective risk management, meaningful employee consultation and participation, and continued improvement in EHS, facilities, energy and environmental performance across the site. 

 Key Responsibilities 

 Health & Safety Leadership, Governance and Management System 

 Own, maintain and continually improve the Mergon International Health and Safety Management System in line with ISO 45001, ensuring it is effective, practical, risk-based and embedded into how work is planned, supervised and improved. 

 Act as the site subject matter expert for health and safety legislation, ISO 45001 requirements, risk management and best practice safety leadership. 

 Ensure the Safety Statement, risk assessment process, operating procedures, emergency arrangements and legal compliance registers remain current, effective and proportionate to site risks. 

 Develop the site safety strategy, annual EHS plan and improvement roadmap, aligned with business priorities, manufacturing performance, employee wellbeing and continuous improvement objectives. 

 Establish clear safety roles, responsibilities and expectations for senior leaders, line managers, supervisors and employees, ensuring that operational ownership of risk is understood and consistently applied. 

 Provide coaching, tools, standards and challenge to line managers so that they can effectively own risk assessments, safe systems of work, safety conversations, corrective actions and safe work execution in their areas. 

 Integrate safety into daily and weekly management routines, including tier meetings, Gemba walks, layered process audits, management of change reviews, project reviews and operational performance discussions. 

 Support Operations, Engineering, Quality and Continuous Improvement teams to ensure new processes, equipment, layouts, automation, materials and changes to existing operations are assessed and controlled before implementation. 

 Lead the development of strong leading indicators, including safety observations, hazard reporting, near miss reporting, corrective action closure, audit completion, training compliance and leadership safety activity. 

 Monitor and report on lagging indicators, including lost time accidents, recordable injuries, first aid cases, incident trends and regulatory events, ensuring insight is used to prevent recurrence and improve controls. 

 Facilitate effective employee consultation and participation in health and safety, ensuring employees are engaged in hazard identification, risk assessment, improvement activity and learning from incidents. 

 Coordinate emergency preparedness arrangements, including emergency response teams, drills, procedures, equipment and lessons learned from exercises or events. 

 Benchmark and share best practice within the Mergon Group and externally where appropriate, helping to raise standards across sites. 

 Incident Management, Learning and Assurance 

 Ensure all incidents, near misses and hazards are reported, triaged, investigated and closed out in a timely and effective manner. 

 Ensure line managers lead incident investigations and own corrective and preventive actions for their areas, with the EHS function providing methodology, facilitation, root cause expertise and independent challenge. 

 Verify the effectiveness of corrective actions and ensure learning is communicated across relevant teams, shifts, processes and sites. 

 Develop and maintain an audit and inspection programme that tests both compliance and the effectiveness of operational controls. 

 Escalate significant risks, repeated non-conformances or ineffective controls through appropriate governance channels, ensuring timely leadership action. 

 Prepare clear EHS performance reports for site leadership, Group leadership, regulatory bodies and customers as required. 

 Environmental & Energy Management 

 Maintain and continually improve the Environmental and Energy Management Systems to meet the requirements of ISO 14001 and ISO 50001. 

 Monitor and report on environmental and energy indicators, including carbon footprint, water usage, waste generation, recycling rates and energy consumption. 

 Develop and implement policies, procedures and improvement initiatives for waste management, recycling, emissions reduction, resource efficiency and energy performance. 

 Conduct environmental and energy audits and inspections to identify risks, compliance gaps and opportunities for improvement. 

 Support Mergon sustainability goals through practical energy-saving, waste-reduction and environmental improvement projects. 

 Liaise with external stakeholders, including regulators, customers, suppliers and service providers, on environmental, energy and compliance matters. 

 Facilities Management 

 Own the management, maintenance and compliance of site facilities that are critical to employee safety, welfare and business continuity, including welfare facilities, building fabric, grounds, utilities and associated infrastructure. 

 Ensure employee welfare facilities, including canteen, sanitary facilities, changing areas, first aid facilities, drinking water provision and welfare spaces, are maintained to appropriate legal, health, hygiene and company standards.

 Maintain the integrity and compliance of the site building fabric, including roofs, floors, fire doors, walkways, stairs, pedestrian routes, lighting, drainage and structural elements, ensuring hazards are identified and addressed promptly.

 Manage site grounds and external areas, including roads, car parks, pedestrian walkways, traffic management systems, fencing, signage, landscaping, drainage and winter maintenance activities, ensuring they remain safe and fit for purpose.

 Team Leadership and Change Leadership 

 Lead, develop and motivate the on-site EHS and Facilities team, building a high-performing function that is trusted, commercially aware and operationally engaged. 

 Set clear priorities, objectives and development plans for the team and ensure work is aligned with business risk and site priorities. 

 Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, learning and continuous improvement across EHS, Facilities and the wider site leadership team. 

 Coach line managers and supervisors to build confidence and competence in safety leadership, risk assessment, incident learning and employee engagement. 

 Influence at all levels of the organisation, challenging constructively where safety standards, behaviours or controls do not meet expectations. 

 Work cross-functionally with Production, Engineering, Quality, HR and Continuous Improvement to optimise plant performance while protecting people, the environment and the business. 

 Qualifications & Experience 

 A recognised qualification in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Management, Facilities Management, Engineering or a related discipline. 

 Demonstrable experience managing ISO 45001, ISO 14001 and/or ISO 50001 management systems in a manufacturing, industrial or similarly regulated environment. 

 Strong knowledge of health and safety legislation, environmental compliance, building regulations, contractor management and operational risk control. 

 Experience supporting or leading a culture change programme where safety accountability is embedded into line management. 

 Strong practical experience in risk assessment, incident investigation, root cause analysis, audit, corrective action management and management of change. 

 Experience leading and developing teams in a fast-paced operational environment. 

 Ability to coach, influence and challenge managers and employees at all levels while maintaining strong working relationships. 

 Strong data analysis, reporting, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convert EHS data into practical business insight. 

 Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and experience using EHS, facilities, maintenance or action-tracking systems is desirable. 

 Ability to manage multiple priorities, balance compliance with operational practicality and deliver sustainable improvement. 

 Key Attributes 

 Visible, credible and practical safety leader. 

 Strong coach and facilitator who builds ownership in others rather than taking ownership away from them. 

 Confident decision-maker with sound judgement and the courage to escalate risk when required. 

 Continuous improvement mindset with the ability to connect EHS performance to manufacturing excellence, reliability and employee engagement. 

 Collaborative, resilient and comfortable working in a hands-on manufacturing environment. 

 Benefits 

 26 days holidays 

 Career growth and development opportunities 

 Wellness Programme 

 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) 

 Company gym 

 Health insurance for you and your family 

 Competitive salary

description:
One Tree Planted is a leading global nonprofit organization dedicated to reforestation and nature-based solutions. Our mission is to foster a sustainable and resilient future through innovative nature-based solutions rooted in the science of trees. We envision a future where climate change is mitigated, biodiversity thrives, and the well-being of life on Earth is transformed through the power of trees. With a global network of partners and volunteers, we're committed to restoring vital ecosystems, mitigating climate change, and supporting local communities one tree at a time. 

 We are seeking a motivated and creative Photo & Video Intern to join our award-winning Marketing and Communications team. This internship offers an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience in digital asset management, content creation, and storytelling in support of our environmental mission. The ideal candidate is passionate about visual storytelling, organized, eager to learn, and excited to contribute to a purpose-driven organization. 

 The ideal start date for this position is immediately. 

 POSITION PURPOSE: 

 The Photo & Video Internship offers an opportunity to gain hands-on experience with the systems, workflows, and creative processes behind visual storytelling at a mission-driven organization. Working alongside our Production and Marketing & Communications teams, the intern will learn how photo and video content moves from the field into an organized media library and ultimately becomes compelling content for a variety of audiences and platforms. 

 Throughout the internship, the intern will have opportunities to shadow experienced media professionals, contribute to active projects, and develop practical skills in digital asset management, video and photo production, and content development. 

 Reporting Relationships 

 Reports to Manager of Photo/Video Production 

 ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS 

 Media Management & Storytelling (50%): 

 A significant part of the internship will focus on learning the art and practice of industry-standard media tagging, cataloging, and asset management. Working closely with the production team and Video Coordinator, the intern will gain experience organizing, tagging, and uploading photo and video assets from field projects, site visits, and global partners. 

 Through this work, the intern will learn how thoughtful metadata and media organization make visual assets more accessible and useful across an organization. They will participate in reviewing and updating existing media libraries, conducting quality assurance checks on new uploads and media ingestion, and helping ensure visual content is accurately cataloged. 

 The intern will also support organizational storytelling by generating and organizing interview transcripts and related materials, gaining exposure to how interviews and field documentation are developed into larger stories and communications. 

 Content Production & Creative Collaboration (50%): 

 The intern will also participate in the creative side of photo and video production, working alongside video editors, producers, graphic designers, and social media colleagues. Depending on project needs and the intern's experience, this may include assisting with photo and video editing, color correction, and quality assurance of finished materials. 

 As part of the Marketing and Communications team, the intern will be invited to participate in creative brainstorms and explore how content ideas are developed around campaign goals and organizational priorities. 

 Learning Experience 

 This internship is designed as a learning experience for someone interested in photography, video production, digital media, communications, or visual storytelling. The intern will gain exposure to both the creative and operational sides of media production while learning from professionals across production, design, social media, and communications. 

 By the end of the internship, the intern will have a stronger understanding of professional media workflows, digital asset management, visual storytelling, collaborative content production, and the role photo and video play in communicating complex climate and nature topics. 

 INTERNSHIP REQUIREMENTS: 

 EDUCATION : 
 Currently enrolled in a degree in Film, Communications, Media Production, Environmental Studies, or a related field. 

 Technical Skills` 

 Familiarity with or interest in learning Digital Asset Management (DAM) systems. 

 Familiarity with Adobe Premiere Pro and Photoshop. 

 Familiarity with Canva. 

 Basic understanding of file formats, media encoding, and digital content workflows. 

 Soft Skills 

 Highly organized with strong attention to detail. 

 Effective verbal and written communication skills. 

 Ability to take initiative, collaborate effectively and follow guidance in a learning environment. Strong research and analytical skills. 

 IDEAL LOCATION: Remote, USA 

 Compensation 

 This is an unpaid internship. Academic credit may be available depending on school requirements. Academic credit cannot be guaranteed. Students must coordinate directly with their academic counselor. One Tree Planted can provide required documentation only after approval from the school. This internship is a temporary learning experience, and there is no expectation or guarantee of employment upon completion. 

 Hours & Duration: Fall or Spring Semester Internship | 10-20 hours per week | Dates aligned with student academic calendar. 

 Submission Requirements 

 To be considered for this position, please submit: 

 A cover letter explaining your interest in this role and how your background aligns with One Tree Planted’s mission. 

 An up-to-date resume. 

 A link to your portfolio, reel, or examples of previous video/photo work. 

 (Optional) 

 The internship is intended to outline the general nature, learning objectives and educational responsibilities of the role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties or responsibilities that may be required of the intern. Learning tasks and responsibilities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time to support the intern’s educational development. This internship is unpaid and structured to provide training, mentorship and exposure aligned with academic or early career learning goals. One Tree Planted is an equal opportunity organization. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all interns, volunteers and employees. 

 Please note that all emails from our team will come from an @ onetreeplanted.org address, or from our HRIS system called BambooHR. One Tree Planted will never request payment from you, and we will only ask for sensitive information (like social security number, birthdate, or banking details) if an offer of employment has been made.

Depending on project needs and the intern's experience, this may include assisting with photo and video editing, color correction, and quality assurance of finished materials.


As part of the Marketing and Communications team, the intern will be invited to participate in creative brainstorms and explore how content ideas are developed around campaign goals and organizational priorities.


Learning Experience

  • This internship is designed as a learning experience for someone interested in photography, video production, digital media, communications, or visual storytelling. The intern will gain exposure to both the creative and operational sides of media production while learning from professionals across production, design, social media, and communications.
  • By the end of the internship, the intern will have a stronger understanding of professional media workflows, digital asset management, visual storytelling, collaborative content production, and the role photo and video play in communicating complex climate and nature topics.


INTERNSHIP REQUIREMENTS:

EDUCATION:
Currently enrolled in a degree in Film, Communications, Media Production, Environmental Studies, or a related field.


Technical Skills`

  • Familiarity with or interest in learning Digital Asset Management (DAM) systems.  
  • Familiarity with Adobe Premiere Pro and Photoshop.
  • Familiarity with Canva.
  • Basic understanding of file formats, media encoding, and digital content workflows.

Soft Skills

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to take initiative, collaborate effectively and follow guidance in a learning environment. Strong research and analytical skills.

IDEAL LOCATION: Remote, USA

Compensation 

This is an unpaid internship. Academic credit may be available depending on school requirements. Academic credit cannot be guaranteed. Students must coordinate directly with their academic counselor. One Tree Planted can provide required documentation only after approval from the school. This internship is a temporary learning experience, and there is no expectation or guarantee of employment upon completion.  



Hours & Duration: Fall or Spring Semester Internship | 10-20 hours per week | Dates aligned with student academic calendar. 


 

Submission Requirements

To be considered for this position, please submit:

  • A cover letter explaining your interest in this role and how your background aligns with One Tree Planted’s mission.
  • An up-to-date resume. 
  • A link to your portfolio, reel, or examples of previous video/photo work. 

(Optional)


The internship is intended to outline the general nature, learning objectives and educational responsibilities of the role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties or responsibilities that may be required of the intern. Learning tasks and responsibilities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time to support the intern’s educational development. This internship is unpaid and structured to provide training, mentorship and exposure aligned with academic or early career learning goals. One Tree Planted is an equal opportunity organization. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all interns, volunteers and employees.


Please note that all emails from our team will come from an @onetreeplanted.org address, or from our HRIS system called BambooHR. description:
Oneview Healthcare is a global software company, working with hospitals and senior care facilities around the world. Our platform helps caregivers to make real-time care decisions while improving care coordination and workflows. At Oneview, we empower patients to become active participants in their own health care. With hospital installations all over the globe, we know what it takes to organize systems, data, and people to add value and improve the quality of the healthcare experience. 

 The Role: 

 The successful candidate will be a customer-oriented individual who is passionate about the Oneview product. You will be the first line of support and will solve technical problems and provide support for all assigned areas. The goal is to make sure that customer value is maintained, and service level commitments are consistently met. 

 Responsibilities & Accountabilities: 

 Assuring all Oneview Healthcare customers are provided efficient, friendly and timely support. 

 Provide 1st and 2nd level technical (Hardware and Software) support to Oneview’s global users, typically interacting with the internal technology support function at healthcare institutions, in an accurate, efficient, and timely manner. 

 Monitoring and Log analysis to identify problem trends. 

 Assist customers in the triage and problem-solving process and properly escalate unresolved incidents to the next level of support where required. 

 Follow up with customers, provide feedback and see problems through to resolution. 

 Utilize excellent customer service skills to exceed customers’ expectations and meet and exceed the set customer-specific service level agreements. 

 Perform quality assurance testing as necessary with the other technology teams. 

 Ensure the documentation of the root cause is recorded in the tickets and incidents are closed with 100% customer satisfaction. 

 Participate in growing knowledge of help desk procedures, products and services. 

 Requirements: 

 Relevant work experience in a technical support, application support or similar SaaS support environment 

 Ability to work as part of a team or to work unsupervised and take responsibility for the completion of tasks with a high percentage of first line resolution. 

 Fast learner and self-starter, eagerness to learn the technical details of how our software works. 

 Good troubleshooting skillsets and proven experience of testing proposed solutions. 

 Relevant qualification in Computer Science or similar related discipline and/or a minimum of 3+ 
 years relevant work experience. 

 Knowledge of Microsoft Technologies - MSSQL, Web Applications, Windows Server and Azure Cloud Infrastructure. 

 Scripting skills - PowerShell or similar 

 Knowledge of enterprise monitoring tools – Datadog or similar 

 Networking knowledge in Routing and Switching (VLAN, DHCP, DNS) 

 Experience with Airwatch or any other Mobile device management tool is beneficial. 

 Knowledge of Healthcare System, HL7 standards and integration engines (Mirth) is beneficial. 

 Enterprise AV/IPTV experience is beneficial. 

 Excellent interpersonal communication skills including flexibility with a diverse customer base across the world. 

 Fluent English, both verbally and in writing 

 Applicants must be flexible to work within our rotating shift patterns – including weekend work and Public Holidays. 

 Please note: This is shift working pattern so we are looking for people who are available out side of normal hours and possible weekend work as we operate a 24hour Support Model.

description:
Somos OTAMERICA , proveedor logístico para el almacenamiento en tanques de productos químicos, gases y petróleo. Contamos con operaciones en 12 terminales en 5 países: Argentina, Brasil, Colombia, Panamá y Perú. 

 Nuestra visión es ser el socio preferido en la logística energética; nos centramos en la excelencia operativa, el liderazgo en seguridad, la protección medioambiental y las personas, nuestro activo más importante. 

 Nos esforzamos por ser una empresa justa y por respaldar el crecimiento continuado del negocio mediante la contratación de colaboradores cualificados, a quienes ofrecemos un entorno laboral variado y saludable; promovemos la igualdad de oportunidades y la diversidad e invertimos en el desarrollo profesional de nuestro personal. 

 Descripción del Puesto: Para nuestra operación en Paracas, estamos buscando una persona para el puesto de Loading Master 

 Objetivo: Dirigir y supervisar la transferencia de hidrocarburos entre buques y terminales, asegurando seguridad, eficiencia y cumplimiento normativo desde el fondeo hasta el zarpe. Asimismo, liderar la Gestión Marítima y Protección, garantizando planificación, control de riesgos y respuesta oportuna ante emergencias frente a derrames. 

 Requisitos: 

 Profesional en Ciencias Náuticas, Oficial de Marina Mercante experiencia cómo "Capitán" ó "Primer Piloto" con un periodo mínimo de 05 años de embarque efectivo en buques tanque en posesión de su certificado de competencia ó formación en Ingeniería Petroquímica, Petróleo, Industrial, Mecánica, Química ó carreras de especialización afines.

 5 años de experiencia a bordo de buque desempeñado funciones de loading máster y/o en supervisión de operaciones de hidrocarburos y/o manipuleo de carga, inspecciones/ operaciones en buques tanques (Petroleros y/o Gaseros y/o Quimiqueros).

 Conocimientos en inspecciones de vetting y regulaciones marítimas portuarias como de estándares internaciones como OCIMF.

 Inglés Intermedio, será evaluado en pruebas en línea y entrevistas.

 Disponibilidad para residir en Pisco.

 Licencia de Conducir – A1. 

 Residencia en Perú vigente. 

 Conocimientos Técnicos: 

 Contar con los certificados vigentes de los siguientes cursos, según el terminal o instalación portuaria donde operará:

 Terminales Petroleros: Curso Modelo OMI 1.02: Formación Avanzada en Operaciones de Carga de Petroleros.

 Terminales Quimiqueros: Curso Modelo OMI 1.03: Formación Avanzada en Operaciones de Carga de Quimiqueros.

 Terminales Gaseros: Curso Modelo OMI 1.05: Formación Avanzada en Operaciones de Carga de BT para el Transporte de Gas Licuado.

 Curso Modelo OMI 1.19 - Técnicas de Supervivencia Personal.

 Curso Modelo OMI 4.02 - Operador Primera Respuesta para casos de derrame (OPRC - Nivel 1).

 Curso Modelo OMI 4.03 - Supervisor/jefe en el lugar del siniestro para casos de derrame (OPRC - Nivel 2)

 Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word, Outlook): Intermedio a avanzado. 

 Gestión de Cadena de Abastecimiento. (deseable). 

 Normas PBIP, HSSE, gestión documental.

 Desafío Profesional: 
 Desarrollar Programa Entrenamiento Técnico Loading Master

 Lugar de trabajo 
Sede: Pisco
Horario: Operativo 
Contrato Trabajo: 1 Año con renovación.

 Beneficios 

 Salario: Confidencial 

 Tarjeta de Alimentos : Promedio 560.00 soles 

 Utilidades, gratificaciones de Ley, EPS cubierta 70% & Seguro de Vida y Riesgo en el trabajo.
Movilidad 

 Beneficios diferenciales 
Tarjeta de aguinaldo por navidad & regalo hijos menores 12 años por navidad.
Acceso beneficio de salud física y emocional: S/700.00 soles al año
Día libre por cumpleaños

description:
Why we're hiring for this role 🥳

 As we scale across African markets, the volume and complexity of merchant integrations continues to grow, particularly outside standard business hours. We need dedicated Application Engineers on our night shift to ensure merchants receive the same quality of technical support and integration guidance around the clock, without gaps in coverage. 

This role combines: 

 Hands-on technical support for merchants integrating with Peach's payments infrastructure 

 Direct collaboration with Product, Engineering and Account Management to solve real merchant problems in real time 

 Ownership of documentation and process improvement to drive self-service and reduce repeat queries 

 Relationship building with merchants and their technical teams as their primary point of contact during integration

 How you'll be making a difference 

 Serve as the primary technical point of contact for merchants and their technical teams during integration, working in a night shift environment 

 Understand merchant requirements and translate how Peach's products can solve their business and technical challenges 

 Partner with Product, Engineering and Account Management to help merchants understand what is technically possible 

 Interact with merchants by email, phone and video to guide them through integration and troubleshoot issues 

 Optimise internal and external documentation and processes across our product suite 

 Work with the Team Lead to refine tools and practices that increase self-service efficiency, recommendation accuracy and overall service quality

 Who you are: 

 Comfortable working on a shift basis outside of standard business hours 

 Strong understanding of technical systems with the ability to translate that knowledge into clear merchant guidance 

 Background working with switches and payment infrastructure such as MSDK, Base24, ACI, Bankserv/Payinc, or technical banking experience with payments and card issuing 

 Self-organised with the initiative to identify and act on opportunities for improvement 

 Strong relationship builder with both internal teams and external stakeholders 

 Working business writing and spoken English 

 Valid work authorisation in your country of residence

 Advantageous Experience: 

 Understanding of programming languages such as Python or JavaScript 

 Previous payments industry experience 

 Familiarity with API-based integrations and RESTful services

 Things we take seriously: 

 Merchant experience during unsociable hours is held to the same standard as business hours 

 Clear, accurate technical communication over assumption 

 Proactive problem-solving over waiting to be asked 

 Documentation that helps the next person, not just the person who wrote it

description:
At Phillip Jeffries, we’re on a mission to make the world more beautiful, one wall at a time. What started in a family garage in 1976 has grown into a global leader in luxury wallcoverings, known for our exceptional products, elevated service, and passion for design. We believe in building strong relationships and creating standout experiences for our clients around the world. 

 If you’re inspired by thoughtful design, meaningful relationships, and being part of a team that’s shaping extraordinary interiors, we invite you to apply for Sample Manufacturing Associate . In this role, you’ll be responsible for picking and packing our wallcovering with precision, reporting to the Sample Manufacturing Assistant Manager and based at our Fairfield, NJ location with the working shift Monday – Friday 6am-2:30pm 

 What You’ll Be Doing 

 Manually glue Phillip Jeffries samples, meeting daily production metrics (expected output of approximately 200 samples per hour) 

 Select master samples based on daily picking lists and provide them to machine operators as needed 

 Refile master samples accurately at the end of each shift and upon completion of sample runs 

 Receive incoming product and properly store materials in designated warehouse locations 

 Become cross‑trained on the guillotine and other equipment as needed 

 Assist with sample gluing and related production tasks 

 Maintain and clean all necessary equipment 

 Keep work areas clean, organized, and free of debris 

 Support the Sample Manufacturing Assistant Manager with additional tasks as assigned 

 What You Bring to the Table 

 Previous warehouse experience preferred 

 Ability to multi-task and prioritize tasks 

 Good attendance & punctuality 

 Respectful and courteous 

 Strong attention to detail and follows through skills. 

 Excellent time management and follow up skills 

 Strong communication skills - both verbal and written 

 Ability to work in a team or as a single individual 

 Basic computer skills 

 Possess high integrity 

 Able to work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment 

 Experience with WMS systems, a plus 

 Physical Requirements 

 Ability to stand for extended periods 

 Capable of lifting 50–100 pounds 

 The Phillip Jeffries Experience 

 At Phillip Jeffries, we believe exceptional work deserves exceptional care. Our commitment to creating a more beautiful world extends to how we support our team, offering thoughtfully designed benefits and meaningful perks that reflect our appreciation for your talent and time. 

 Your Compensation Journey 

 Hourly rate starting at $19.25 an hour, based on your experience and technical expertise 

 Annual bonus opportunity to reward your performance 

 Cost of Living increases that honor your growth and commitment 

 Generous retirement plan with an automatic company contribution of approximately 10 percent with no employee match required 

 Health Benefits That Take Care of You 

 Comprehensive medical coverage with employee premiums as low as $40 per month 

 Coverage options for spouse, domestic partner, civil union partner, and family 

 Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) to offset medical expenses 

 Prescription, dental, and vision coverage to support whole-person wellness 

 Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) for healthcare and dependent care 

 Employee Assistance Program that supports your mental, financial, and physical well-being 

 Pet insurance for your four-legged companions 

 Time to Recharge 

 16 paid personal days each year to relax, recharge, or travel 

 Paid holidays including New Year’s Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, the day after Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, and New Year’s Eve 

 Additional paid time off during our annual company closure between Christmas and New Year’s 

 Earn extra paid time off by completing your annual wellness physical 

 Up to three paid days each year to give back through volunteer work 

 Career Elevation 

 Structured onboarding with clear 30, 60, and 90-day milestones and continued training for long-term success 

 Perks at Work 

 Exclusive employee discount on Phillip Jeffries wallcoverings to elevate your home 

 Access to Working Advantage with discounts on travel, entertainment, and everyday purchases 

 Phillip Jeffries is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and equality in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, age, national origin, religion, physical and mental disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/assignment, citizenship, pregnancy or maternity, protected veteran status, or any other status prohibited by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

 With offices in Abu Dhabi, Dubai and Manchester, QComms has a reputation for big ideas, new insights, relentless tenacity and achieving exceptional results for our clients – across the UAE, Middle East, United Kingdom, Europe. 

 Our vision 

 We aspire to be the world’s most sought-after communications agency, inspiring moments of brilliance and happiness through our exceptional services and actions; a collective of creatives and communicators who we encourage and nurture in both mind and body; adding unparalleled value to our clients and making a real difference in the world. 

 Why join us 

 QComms is a special place to work, made up of a passionate team who deliver brilliance and exceptional service to our clients. Our people are very important to us and we like to look after them by providing a range of opportunities and benefits, including: 

 Be better at what you do: 

 Qcademy offers you the opportunity to learn and grow with us. We pride ourselves on our teams’ personal and professional development. 

 We promise to give you all the tools you need in a great workspace so you can focus on being the best version of you. 

 You are our story: 

 We believe that our people are our greatest achievement and know our team is our greatest asset. 

 We regularly show our appreciation to our people and celebrate their achievements. 

 Flexible Fun Work Space: 

 Our people enjoy coming into work and spending time with each other. 

 We offer flexibility to help our people get the balance right between life in and outside of work. 

 We are a team of professionals who know what it takes to get the job done. 

 But we also know how and when to have fun. 

 Be part of something bigger: 

 We embrace diversity and inclusion. Our team is proudly made up of people from across the globe and we see this as one of our greatest strengths. 

 With international offices and a global client portfolio QComms continues to grow and you can be part of the journey. 

 Create Impact:

description:
At Prairie Ridge, our front desk team plays a vital role in the experience of every client we serve. As a Support Staff / Receptionist, you are often the first point of contact, helping create a welcoming, respectful, and supportive environment for individuals seeking mental health and substance use services. This position offers the opportunity to be part of a team that is committed to making a meaningful difference in the lives of others while working in a collaborative, fast-paced healthcare setting. 

 TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

 Treat all individuals with dignity and respect while maintaining agency standards of confidentiality, professionalism and objectivity. 

 Maintain all HIPAA and 42 CFR confidentiality requirements and regulations as outlined in CARF policies and procedures. 

 Answer the telephone and route calls to appropriate staff. 

 Schedule and maintain staff appointments through use of agency software program. 

 Greet the public and agency clientele. 

 Perform secretarial duties for clinical and administrative staff, as assigned. 

 Open and dispense mail; mail outgoing correspondence daily. 

 Maintain supply of office forms as needed. 

 All other duties as assigned by the Office Manager. 

 QUALIFICATIONS 

 Understanding of the mission of Prairie Ridge and the clients we work with. 

 Proficiency in managing manual and computerized data collection systems. 

 Proficiency in typing, filing and general office skills, as well as oral and written communication skills. 

 Ability to meet the public and agency clientele in a warm, helpful manner. 

 While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls; and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to walk and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is often required to stand, reach with hands and arms, and climb or balance. 

 The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or more up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

Head of Trade Marketing 

 REPORTS TO: Commercial Director - Alcohol 

 DIRECT REPORTS: 3

 ABOUT RICHMOND 

 At Richmond, we don’t just build brands—we ignite them. As Ireland’s leading trend-spotting premium brand builder, we’ve been shaping the future since 1992. Our mantra is simple: Where Great Brands Meet Great People . We don’t just hire employees; we bring on bold, agile, and energetic innovators who thrive on shaking up the status quo. We're not just about distributing products—we’re about disrupting the market, challenging the norms, and launching game-changing ideas and products that leave a lasting impact.

 JOB DESCRIPTION 

 We are looking for a commercial, execution-focused leader to build Richmond’s Trade Marketing capability within the Alcohol Business Unit. This role owns how brand and customer plans show up in trade — through shopper strategy, POS toolkits, customer sell-in support and execution standards across ROI and NI.

 As senior owner of the Last Three Feet, the Head of Trade Marketing will set clear standards, lead the team, manage POS partners and make execution simpler, faster and more measurable.

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

 Own shopper strategy, POS toolkits and execution standards 

 Lead Alcohol shopper strategy across ROI and NI, aligned to brand, commercial and customer priorities.

 Own POS toolkits, customer sell-in support and execution standards, with clear KPIs by channel and activation type.

 Measure performance across visibility, availability, compliance, rate-of-sale and ROI.

 Deliver end-to-end POS planning and fulfilment 

 Run the POS process from brief and forecast through production, storage, allocation, deployment and evaluation.

 Deliver activation assets on time, in full and within budget, with clear status, risks and actions.

 Improve POS forecasting, stock control and storage, reducing waste and obsolete materials.

 Manage trade marketing agencies and POS suppliers 

 Own day-to-day trade marketing agency and POS supplier relationships, including briefs, service levels and escalation.

 Track supplier performance across quality, cost, speed, innovation and delivery reliability.

 Coordinate new-brand onboarding and launch execution 

 Coordinate the full new-brand onboarding process, ensuring each function understands actions, owners, timings and decision points.

 Ensure every new-brand launch is execution-ready, with aligned customer tools, activation plans, POS readiness and launch tracking.

 Lead the team and embed clear ways of working 

 Lead and develop the Trade Marketing team, setting clear objectives, priorities and accountability.

 Embed clear roles and decision rights with Consumer Marketing, Commercial Heads, National Accounts, Field Sales, Supply Chain and Insights.

 Run a simple operating rhythm for planning, KPI reviews, field feedback and post-activation learnings.

 KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 

 7+ years’ FMCG trade marketing, shopper marketing or commercial activation experience, ideally in alcohol, beverage or premium branded goods.

 Strong record in shopper strategy, POS toolkits, customer sell-in support and execution standards.

 Commercially sharp, with experience managing budgets, suppliers, POS forecasts, stock and ROI.

 Proven ability to lead teams, set priorities and build accountability across functions.

 Confident working cross-functionally with Consumer Marketing, Commercial Heads, National Accounts, Field Sales, Supply Chain, Insights, suppliers and Brand Owners.

 Highly organised, pacey and detail-focused, with strong project management discipline.

This role combines client leadership, strategic advisory work, and team development in a fast-growing life sciences consulting practice.

 What You'll Do 

 Client & Engagement Leadership 

 Serve as day-to-day client lead across multiple engagements, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders

 Lead client meetings and executive discussions, delivering insights and recommendations with credibility

 Identify opportunities to expand scope and deepen long-term client partnerships

 Strategic Advisory 

 Lead engagements in pricing strategy, market access, reimbursement, payer strategy, evidence generation, launch planning, and portfolio optimization

 Advise clients across the product lifecycle from pre-launch through lifecycle management and competitive differentiation

 Translate market dynamics, payer requirements, and policy trends into actionable strategic guidance

 Project Delivery 

 Oversee multiple concurrent engagements; planning, staffing, budgeting, risk management, and financial performance

 Direct workplans, analytical frameworks, and client deliverables

 Synthesize complex qualitative/quantitative data into clear, actionable recommendations

 Team Leadership 

 Mentor and develop Consultants, Associate Consultants, Senior Analysts, and Analysts

 Foster a high-performance, collaborative team culture

 Support performance management, career development, and recruiting

 Business Development 

 Contribute to proposals, pitches, and account growth opportunities

 Support thought leadership through publications, conferences, and internal capability building

 What You Bring 

 Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Public Health, Health Economics, Business, or related field (advanced degree — MBA, MPH, PharmD, PhD, MSc — preferred)

 7+ years in management consulting, pharma strategy, market access, pricing, or commercialization

 Proven experience leading client-facing consulting engagements and managing project teams

 Deep knowledge of pharmaceutical pricing, reimbursement, and market access dynamics (US and/or global)

 Strong executive presence, communication skills, and project budgeting experience

 Demonstrated coaching and people-leadership capabilities

 Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and Teams

 Comfort operating in a global, cross-cultural environment

 FLSA Status: Exempt

 Medical Front Desk Supervisor General Description 

 The Medical Front Desk Supervisor is responsible for the overview and supervision of patient check-in and check-out, collection of fees, and supervision of the front office, including staff supervision. This position will require working collaboratively with our providers (including resident physicians and advanced practice providers) and nursing staff. The Medical Front Desk Supervisor is responsible for ensuring all reception duties are performed according to policy.

 Mission & Value Statements 
The mission of Salina Family Healthcare Center is to serve our community at the crossroads of compassionate healthcare and professional education. 

 Salina Family Healthcare Center is guided by the following fundamental values:

 Excellence;

 Innovation;

 Access;

 Teamwork;

 Equal dignity;

 Education;

 Ethics & integrity;

 Patient-centered. 

 Medical Front Desk Supervisor Essential Duties 

 Greet patients and visitors in a prompt, courteous and helpful manner.

 Check patients in & out for appointments.

 Verify cash box each morning and balance at the end of each day.

 Assist other staff to answer phone calls and scheduling needs.

 Call other agencies and/or taxis for patients as needed.

 Assist with deliveries from UPS and FedEx by unlocking vestibule door, sign for packages, ensure notification of proper employees, and ensure refrigeration of items as necessary.

 Build providers schedules each month while working collaboratively with Residency Program Manager.

 Re-assign provider panels upon resident graduation and as needed.

 Is alert for credit problems and verify financial class status on new patients.

 Ensure all worker’s compensation and/or liability accident forms are completed and scan appropriately and, as needed, exposure packets are provided.

Contract, Fixed-Term: January 4 – July 3, 2027 

 The Specialty Coffee Association (SCA) is seeking a Marketing Coordinator, Events to assist in the delivery of marketing tasks for World of Coffee tradeshows and the World Coffee Championships in 2027. This is a dynamic role: we need someone who is organized, self-motivated, and not afraid to dive in! 

 This role is ideal for someone early in their marketing or communications career who is hungry to grow — someone who is exceptionally detail-oriented, agile, self-disciplined, and an excellent team member and collaborator. 

 What You’ll Do
Event Marketing Support (core of the role) 

 Execute a pre-planned social media plan; traffic and curate graphic assets and photography with the creative team, author captions, and deploy campaigns on schedule. 

 Build newsletters to a pre-planned schedule in collaboration with the events, sponsorship, and creative teams; curate photography, graphics, and copy to build visually stunning and informative newsletter campaigns. 

 Update imagery, graphics, and copy on event websites as needed. 

 Assist onsite event and competition teams; assist with onsite production, organize onsite photography, deploy social campaigns, and coordinate asset and collateral delivery with the event audio-visual teams. 

 Create post-event reports for both tradeshows and competitions and ensure event photography and videography collateral is delivered to sponsors as contracted. 

 Sponsorship Support 

 Work closely with the Sponsorship team to ensure contracted sponsorship benefits are fulfilled across web, social media, newsletters, and the event mobile app. 

 Coordinate with the sponsorship and events teams to receive, organize, and deliver sponsor-delivered assets as required and ensure contracted sponsorship benefits are programmed and deployed as required. 

 General Administration 

 Assist in reviewing and proofing all marketing collateral for events and competitions including event structures, signage, marketing materials, and more. 

 Ensure team folders and files are well organized and easy to navigate. 

 Assist in analytics and progress reporting to internal teams, escalating project snags and issues as required. 

 What We’re Looking For 

 Marketing Experience (Required) 

 Minimum three years of Marketing, Sponsorship, Communications or Administrative experience. 

 Proficiency in Microsoft Tools including Teams, SharePoint, and Microsoft Office programs. 

 Proficiency in marketing tools and platforms including Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Buffer, Squarespace, Airtable, and others. 

 Strong command of written and spoken English. 

 Ability to follow detailed instructions and meet strict deadlines. 

 Preferred but Not Essential 

 Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign. 

 Attributes 

 Strong self-discipline, motivation, organizational skills, and a keen eye for detail. 

 Ability to prioritize and balance multiple demands at once. 

 Comfortable receiving, applying, and providing creative feedback. 

 Strong communication skills. 

 Interest in specialty coffee and international food and beverage culture. 

 Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic, and collaborative environment. 

 What You’ll Gain 

 Hands-on experience working on global brand campaigns, with real project and task ownership. 

 Direct mentorship and feedback to sharpen your skills and build your experience. 

 Exposure to marketing across digital, events, and global competitions. 

 International travel. 

 A collaborative, mission-driven team environment.

description:
IST Endpoint Administrator 

 Full-Time | 1.0 FTE | Permanent 

 Take ownership of the technology that supports teaching, learning and business operations across a growing Christian College. 

 South Coast Baptist College is seeking an experienced IST Endpoint Administrator to join our Information Systems & Technologies (IST) team. 

 This role manages the College’s endpoint environment, ensuring devices, systems and technology services are secure, reliable and fit for purpose. Working closely with the Director of Information Systems & Technologies and the broader IST team, you will provide technical expertise and support across the College. 

 South Coast Baptist College is an independent, co-educational Christian school serving families in Perth’s southern metropolitan region and beyond. 

 Please click here for our Statement of Faith. 

 About the role 

 Working as part of our IST team, you will: 

 Manage the lifecycle, deployment and asset management of College devices. 

 Administer endpoint management platforms including Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Jamf and Google Admin Console. 

 Manage device security, configuration, compliance and application deployment. 

 Administer Microsoft 365 services, Active Directory and Group Policy, including staff onboarding and offboarding. 

 Provide Level 2 and Level 3 technical support and troubleshoot complex endpoint, identity and Microsoft 365 issues. 

 Contribute to technology planning, procurement, documentation and continuous improvement. 

 Work collaboratively with staff, vendors and the broader IST team to deliver reliable and secure technology services. 

 Please click here for the full Job Description. 

 About you 

 You are an experienced IT professional who enjoys solving complex technical problems and improving the way technology is managed and delivered. 

 You will bring: 

 Demonstrated experience administering Microsoft 365, Microsoft Intune and Active Directory in a production environment. 

 Experience managing endpoint devices within a centrally managed environment. 

 Experience supporting Windows, macOS, iOS and ChromeOS devices. 

 Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills, including root cause analysis. 

 Experience using scripting or automation to improve operational efficiency. 

 Strong communication and customer service skills, with the ability to work with users of varying technical knowledge. 

 The ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a collaborative IST team. 

 Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines. 

 A willingness to learn, adapt to new technologies and respond positively to feedback. 

 An awareness of current and emerging technologies and cybersecurity practices. 

 Experience working within an education environment will be highly regarded. 

 Essential requirements 

 Cert IV, Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. 

 Minimum two years' experience in a similar IT systems, endpoint or technical administration role is preferred. 

 Relevant industry certifications, such as Microsoft, Apple, Google or ITIL certifications, are desirable. 

 Commitment to providing a high standard of professional and customer-focused technology support. 

 Commitment to maintaining a safe, secure and responsible technology environment. 

 Applications 

 Applications close: Friday, 9th October 2026 

 Applications will be reviewed as they are received, and the College reserves the right to appoint a suitable candidate prior to the closing date. 

 Please include: 

 Cover letter and resume. 

 Relevant qualifications and supporting documents. 

 Visa / Residency Status / Passport. 

 Enquiries 

 HR Department 

 (08) 9540 4406 

 HR@scbc.wa.edu.au

description:
An exciting opportunity to join an industry-leading company in the nonprofit software market.

 At Enthuse, we’re on a mission to transform digital fundraising by building the technology that empowers great causes. Our donations, event registration, and fundraising platform helps thousands of charities raise millions.

 Launched in 2012, we’ve come a long way - we’ve grown the team to over 70 people and now serve thousands of charities. Enthuse is headquartered in London, with operations in Scotland, Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland. What's more, Enthuse is the official online fundraising partner for London Marathon Events and The Great Run Company. 

 Reporting to the Head of Sales , you’ll lead a team of Business Development Associates and Business Development Managers, creating a high-performance culture that delivers consistent sales growth while developing and coaching future sales talent.

 The successful candidate will be joining at an exciting stage of our journey. Enthuse recently joined The Access Group's Not for Profit Division, giving us the backing, scale and investment of one of the UK's leading software providers while maintaining our mission of helping charities raise more through outstanding fundraising technology.

 How you'll contribute 

 Lead, coach and develop a team of Business Development Associates and Business Development Managers to consistently achieve and exceed sales targets. 

 Recruit, onboard and retain top sales talent, creating a high-performing and collaborative team. 

 Conduct regular 1:1s, pipeline reviews and forecast meetings to maximise performance and deal progression. 

 Coach the team through complex sales opportunities and support negotiations with key stakeholders. 

 Use data, KPIs and sales insights to identify coaching opportunities, improve conversion rates and optimise performance. 

 Own territory planning and account allocation, ensuring maximum market coverage and opportunity generation. 

 Embed best practice sales methodologies across the team, with experience of MEDDPICC, CHAMP or similar being desirable. 

 Maintain accurate forecasting, CRM hygiene and pipeline management within HubSpot. 

 Work closely with Marketing, Customer Success and Product to maximise commercial opportunities and share customer feedback. 

 Lead by example, bringing energy, accountability and motivation to the wider commercial team. 

 About you 

 Proven experience managing and developing a successful B2B sales team, ideally within SaaS. 

 Demonstrable experience recruiting, onboarding and developing high-performing sales professionals. 

 Strong understanding of the full end-to-end sales process with experience coaching others through complex opportunities. 

 Experience with MEDDPICC, CHAMP or similar sales methodologies is desirable. 

 Highly data driven, using KPIs, conversion metrics, forecasting and pipeline analysis to drive performance. 

 Experience creating, managing and optimising sales territories. 

 Commercially minded with excellent forecasting and pipeline management skills. 

 A motivational leader who builds an engaging, accountable and high-performing culture. 

 Creative and solution focused, always looking for better ways to improve results and processes. 

 Excellent coaching, communication and stakeholder management skills. 

 Resilient, adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. 

 Strong organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail. 

 A genuine passion for helping charities succeed through technology. 

 What you’ll get 

 We celebrate together with an early Friday finish with optional team drinks, team incentives, and a variety of company socials. 

 We believe work-life balance matters and have flexible hours, working from home, and support part-time work 

 We believe in giving back and give you one paid day to fundraise for a charity of your choice. 

 We want you to travel well with the Cycle to Work scheme and a London-based office. 

 We will support your journey through our learning and development program with an allowance for training each year and Personal Development Plans, as well as a mentor program that offers structured support from senior team members. 

 Holiday allowance: 25 days holiday and bank holidays (33 in total). We increase holidays based on length of service, so for every year you’re with us, you’ll get an additional day’s holiday up to 28 days. We also offer an additional 5 days of unpaid holiday. 

 A Wellbeing Day! 

 Enthuse Wings! Work from abroad for up to 4 weeks of the year! 

 Private health insurance coverage 

 Places for Races, as partners of London Marathon Events and Great Run, we get access to a number of participant places for major fundraising events. So if you're a keen runner, swimmer or cyclist - you could be in luck. 

 Come as you are. Love what you do. 

 At Enthuse, we want to create a positive impact on a global scale. And to do that we know that the people at Enthuse have to reflect all global lives and identities. 

 We work flexible hours, we support remote working, and if that doesn’t quite work, we will definitely listen to what will. We’re striving to create a place where all feel valued and welcome — and would love to hear how we could do that for you. 

 No matter what your background, identity, or even if your experience doesn’t exactly match — we’d love to hear from you! 

 Our Values 

 Be enthusiastic: We are can-do and proactive 

 Be curious: We believe progress is made by asking questions 

 Be reliable: You can trust us to get the job done

description:
Role Summary 

 This is a newly created graduate position within the Business Operations team of a rapidly growing financial technology business. The role will involve building out and maintaining the processes and procedures needed to ensure that the operations department continues to scale with control and support the morphing requirements of a fast-growing business. 

 The role will involve working closely with team members across the organisation including Sales, Customer Success, Product, Finance, HR, Engineering and Security to ensure that robust and effective controls and processes are in place to support all aspects of the operations of the company. The role will involve a significant amount of project work given the high growth nature of the business which means that considerable emphasis is placed on new initiatives to help drive the continued success of the organisation. 

 A key part of the role will involve driving the operational aspects of our key business initiatives including international expansion to the US and APAC and expanding our distribution channels. Additionally, the role will include work to support external audits and certification processes required for regulatory and client acquisition purposes. 

 This role represents an excellent opportunity for a highly motivated and focused candidate to join a high performing and likeminded team committed to making a real change to the finance industry. 

 Key Responsibilities 

 Take ownership of the day-to-day BAU processes and functions within the business operations space. 

 Build out and maintain policies, procedures and controls required to run the business effectively and scale with control. 

 Support external audit engagements and certification processes to help drive and evidence our control agenda. 

 Work closely with the internal security team to ensure access to company resources is controlled effectively. 

 Support the customer onboarding processes to ensure due diligence is correctly performed. 

 Manage the procurement process for future employees, liaising with HR, the hiring managers and Internal IT Support. 

 Work closely with the HR team to facilitate the employee onboarding and offboarding process. 

 Support building foundations to scale the business across geographical locations and in different market verticals. 

 Contribute to building out KPIs and metrics for the operations department to ensure clear visibility and provide a basis for sound well informed decision making. 

 Work with the wider FINBOURNE team to execute the strategy of the business. 

 Skills and Experience 

 Highly motivated with a desire to take on new challenges and operate outside of comfort zone. 

 Ability to deliver multiple workstreams under pressure whilst maintaining attention to detail. 

 Desire to learn and expand knowledge of the financial technology industry and capital markets. 

 Excellent communication skills with people of varying levels of seniority. 

 Experience working with Microsoft Office suite and the ability to quickly learn and utilise new workplace technologies necessary to operate the department (e.g. MS PowerApps). 

 Proactive approach to managing workload and willingness to take ownership of deliveries. 

 Relevant degree or equivalent qualification. 

 Just some of our benefits 

 Competitive salary plus performance based bonus. 

 Health & Wellbeing: A competitive health insurance policy that disregards previous medical history. This also includes dental, optical, mental health support and comprehensive cancer cover. 

 Cycle to work scheme and Gym discounts: Buy a bike and cycling accessories out of your pre-tax salary and spread the cost over 12 months, as well huge discounts off Hussle, KOBOX and Nuffield Health gyms. 

 Hybrid: We have a mature attitude towards hybrid working. Whether you’re a night owl, morning person, parent, carer or simply need flexibility to work a different pattern to the norm, we’re committed to helping you be productive and work in a way that is best for you. 

 Professional learning and development: External training and accreditations are supported, as well internal training and development programs. 

 Maternity, paternity and adoption leave: Paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave, which includes 13 weeks full pay for maternity and adoption leave and 6 weeks full pay for paternity leave 

 Holiday: 25 days holiday plus bank holidays 

 About FINBOURNE 

 We are a young, dynamic financial technology company aiming to re-engineer the world of investing to make it clearer, faster and more cost effective for everyone. 

 At FINBOURNE, we offer a hugely supportive environment to build a career, with continuous learning and development opportunities. We have a collaborative culture of testing and exploring problems together to find the best evidence-based solutions. We respect your independent thought, your intellectual curiosity and your opinion. 

 Our solution is open, API first and developer friendly – a true first for the asset management industry. You can see what our team is busy building on Github. 

 For more information about us please visit our website.

description:
ABOUT FOREVER CHEESE 

 Forever Cheese is a privately held specialty food company headquartered in New York City, with a warehouse in Secaucus, NJ and a manufacturing facility in Illinois. For over 25 years, we’ve been the leading importer of fine artisan cheese, cured meats, nuts, and accompaniments from Italy, Spain, Portugal, and Croatia. Our company-owned brands include Mitica®, Drunken Goat®, and Fulvi® Pecorino Romano.

 In 2023, we welcomed W.A. Imports to the Forever Cheese family — the premier source of the finest Japanese and Pacific Rim ingredients for North America’s top restaurant kitchens.

 CONSIDER JOINING US 

 We’re looking for an enthusiastic, solution-oriented, and self-motivated individual to join us. Consider us if you want to:

 Work in a dynamic environment with a chance to make an impact 

 Develop lasting relationships with great people

 Have the opportunity to build a satisfying career

 BENEFITS 

 Robust healthcare offerings: medical, dental, vision, telehealth, FSA and HSA plans 

 Company-paid life and disability insurance

 Paid Parental Leave

 Roth and pre-tax 401(k) options including an employer match

 Generous paid time off policies, including vacation, holiday, and sick days

 THE ROLE 

 The Customer Service Manager leads the inside team responsible for order management, customer communications, and the operational workflows that keep the commercial team running. You’ll own the full order-to-invoice process across our customer segments, set and enforce the service standards the team works to, and serve as the day-to-day decision-maker on order exceptions, short-ships, and credit holds so field reps stay focused on selling.

 This is a player-coach role. You’ll manage a team of 3–5 Customer Service reps while staying close enough to the work to make the call when it matters. You’ll report to the COO and work closely with Sales, Purchasing, Warehouse, and Finance.

 SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATES 

 Have a growth mindset — seek to continuously strengthen skills and improve on past performance while embracing challenges and feedback. 

 Have a passion for food or an interest in learning about the specialty food industry.

 Aim to not only meet expectations but preempt issues or potential problem areas with a solution-oriented mindset.

 WHAT YOU'LL OWN 

 Team and order workflow 

 Manage a team of Customer Service reps supporting our retail, foodservice, and distributor segments.

 Run order workflow end-to-end across E21 and customer portals.

 Set and enforce SLAs for queue management, kickback resolution, and order confirmations.

 Make the call on substitutions, short-ships, and credit holds.

 Own outbound freight coordination — carrier selection, load scheduling, and in-transit communication — to hit delivery windows at the lowest landed cost.

 NIF, retailer compliance, and pricing 

 Review all New Item Form submissions before they go to the executive team.

 Keep specs, certifications, and documentation current across every retailer portal.

 Serve as the last line of review on pricing approvals.

 Reporting and deduction recovery 

 Publish a weekly flash to the Director of Sales: bookings, shipments, fill rate, top wins, top issues.

 Produce monthly scorecards by segment, rep, account, and brand.

 Own deduction recovery and short-ship reconciliation with AR, with disputes filed inside retailer windows.

 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

 Required 

 3–6 years in customer service management, sales operations, or commercial operations — ideally in food, CPG, or distribution.

 Experience managing an inside customer service or sales support team.

 A track record of owning order management, SLA enforcement, and cross-functional operational workflows.

 Working knowledge of ERP and order management systems.

 Ability to juggle a high volume of concurrent priorities without dropping things.

 Based in or able to commute to Secaucus, NJ (on-site).

 Preferred 

 Background in specialty food, cheese, imported food, or perishable CPG.

 Experience with E21, KeHE Connect, or retailer deduction management.

 Experience with import-driven supply chains and long-lead-time demand planning.

 WHAT YOU'RE LIKE 

 You close loops. Open items don’t sit on your list for a week. 

 You build processes that work when you’re not in the room.

 You stay calm under operational pressure and decisive when a call needs to be made.

 You communicate clearly across functions and levels.

 You take care of the customer and the team at the same time.

 You have a growth mindset. You embrace feedback and continuously look for ways to do things better.

Job Opportunity: 

 Temporary Contract Records Coordinator 

 Employee type: 

 Temporary, Full-Time

 Location: 

 Conroe, TX (On-site)

 Compensation: 

 $19.00 – $21.00 per hour, depending on experience 

 Come Grow with Us! Forsite is actively looking for a Temporary Contract Records Coordinator to join our Corporate Team. This is a temporary, on-site position based in Conroe, TX, supporting a focused contract-organization project for our corporate offices. At Forsite, we don’t just work together – we support, challenge, and grow together. We believe in flexibility, collaboration, and fostering an environment where everyone can thrive.

 Who We Are 

 Forsite is a leading provider of integrated solutions for energy infrastructure, natural landscapes and wildfire protection. Our staff are industry leaders in forestry, technology, aerial patrol, LiDAR & imagery capture/processing, analytics, strategic planning, resource and land management/stewardship and professional forestry. We are a company that is committed to innovation and is constantly growing with clients across North America and abroad in multiple sectors.

 We take pride in our team culture, where supporting one another is second nature. We are a dynamic, people-focused business that thrives by delivering value to our customers, creating opportunities for our employees, and drawing on our expertise for sustainable solutions that balance economic, environmental and social goals. We will apply our skills, knowledge and technologies to be the best forest management company.

 We foster and sustain a safe and respectful environment of diversity and inclusion where everyone can reach their full potential. If you’re looking for a workplace that values collaboration, innovation and having fun while making a meaningful impact, you’ll fit right in.

 What You Will Do 

 Locate and collect all existing contracts from current storage locations (paper, email, shared drives, etc.)

 Consolidate all contracts into a single, well-organized OneDrive folder using a clear, consistent file structure

 Review each contract and extract key details, including parties, effective and expiration dates, rates, term length, and renewal or termination provisions

 Record extracted contract information accurately into the provided cataloging worksheet

 Identify and flag missing, incomplete, expired, or soon-to-expire contracts for follow-up

 Maintain strict confidentiality of contract and business information

 What You’ll Need 

 Forsite welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and is looking for the right person to join our team. If you don’t meet every requirement but bring relevant skills, experience and a great attitude, we encourage you to apply!

 Must have:

 High school diploma or equivalent

 1+ years of administrative, clerical, or records management experience a plus

 Proficiency with Microsoft OneDrive, Excel, and Word

 Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail and accuracy

 Ability to read, interpret, and accurately summarize contract terms

 Ability to work independently and meet deadlines with minimal supervision

 Who You Are 

 A team player who enjoys working collaboratively and contributes to a positive team environment; reliable and accountable

 A problem solver who thinks critically and proactively finds solutions.

 A good decision maker who exercises sound judgment in dynamic situations

 A strong communicator, both written and verbal (and technical writing would be great)

 Quality-driven – pays attention to detail and takes pride in delivering high-quality work

 Someone who can work independently under limited direct supervision as well as in a dynamic team environment

 You are adaptable and resilient, and you thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift; you’re comfortable working on multiple projects at once and can adjust to changing demands

 Professional, friendly and respectful, and committed to excellent service

 What We Provide 

 We offer a flexible and rewarding work environment, including:

 Competitive, market-benchmarked hourly pay

 A consistent, predictable schedule

 A supportive, collaborative team environment

 Diversity, Equity & Inclusion 

 At Forsite, we are committed to fostering a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered to succeed. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our team. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, identities and experiences, including but not limited to Indigenous peoples, racialized individuals, persons with disabilities, women, LGBTQ2+individuals, and veterans. If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know – we are happy to support you. 

 We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.
