About the Role 

 Based in Chennai, India , the Senior HR Executive will provide comprehensive HR support to employees, managers and HR. This role supports the employee lifecycle and the consistent delivery of core HR services, including payroll coordination, onboarding, offboarding, HRIS administration, compensation, employee relations, benefits, compliance, leave management, performance management, HR reporting and analytics, and general HR administration.

 The role requires sound judgement, strong attention to detail and a practical, service-oriented approach to applying regional processes while recognizing local employment requirements and business needs.

 Key Responsibilities: 

 Research and respond to employee inquiries relating to regional HR policies, processes and employment matters in a timely and professional manner.

 Process new hire information, employee status changes and other HR transactions in HRIS and internal systems, ensuring employee data and records are accurate and up to date.

 Prepare and provide HR reports, analytics and employee data to HR leadership and management as required.

 Support the end-to-end onboarding process, including preparation of new hire documentation, coordination with relevant stakeholders and updating HR systems.

 Support the offboarding process, including exit documentation, exit interviews, final payroll inputs and HRIS updates.

 Support the onboarding and offboarding of Independent Contractors, where applicable.

 Under the guidance of the HR leader, support managers in handling employee relations matters, including appropriate processes, documentation and resolution of employee issues.

 Support employee performance management processes, including annual performance reviews, goal setting, salary review processes, market benchmarking and related HR activities.

 Support managers with performance management documentation and employee-related actions where required.

 Manage employee leave and absence requests in HR systems and respond to employee queries relating to leave policies and entitlements.

 Support benefits administration, including employee enrolment, changes, renewals and coordination with regional benefits providers and HR vendors.

 Support annual compensation and benefits processes, including salary benchmarking, market data and compensation review activities.

 Assist with payroll-related activities by providing accurate employee information, validating payroll inputs and coordinating with Payroll and Finance teams to resolve payroll-related queries.

 Support HR compliance activities and ensure HR processes are aligned with applicable local employment laws.

 Assist with internal and external HR audits and provide relevant documentation and employee records as required.

 Support the development, implementation and communication of HR policies, processes and programmes.

 Maintain a high level of confidentiality when handling employee information, compensation data and sensitive employee relations matters.

 Prepare employment-related documents, including employment letters, confirmation letters, transfer letters, verification letters and other HR documentation.

 Liaise with external HR vendors, benefits providers and other service providers as required.

 Should have experience and knowledge handling the visa application process.

 Education and Professional Qualifications: 

 Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration or related discipline, or equivalent HR qualifications.

 Minimum 5 years of HR experience , preferably within a multinational or global organization.

 Experience supporting HR operations.

 Good understanding of HR processes including employee lifecycle management, HRIS, payroll, benefits, leave management, performance management and employee relations.

 Working knowledge of employment practices and HR compliance requirements across APAC countries.

 Experience working with HRIS platforms; experience with BambooHR or other global HR systems is an advantage.

 Strong attention to detail and ability to consistently meet time-sensitive deadlines.

 Strong organizational and administrative skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

 Self-starter with the ability to work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively with a global HR team.

 Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with employees and managers across different countries and cultures.

 High level of integrity and confidentiality when handling sensitive employee information.

 Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a practical and solutions-oriented approach.

 Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic and multicultural environment.

 Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint.

 You need to be- 

 Wildly curious and entrepreneurial

 Committed to customer success

 A self-starter invested in your future

 A persuasive communicator

 Deeply Analytical

 Excited about Disruptive Trends

 Benefits 

 A friendly work environment with an ‘open door’ policy

 A strong career path with growth opportunities.

 Be part of a global team that strives for excellence, and fosters an Olympic spirit

 Feed your intellectual curiosity by collaborating across all levels of the company across the globe

 Global Recognition - President’s Club & Chairman’s Club Awards

 Continuous learning and coaching

 Flexible work policy

 Frost & Sullivan, the Transformational Growth Journey Company, has spent more than 60 years partnering with clients to develop transformational growth strategies by focusing on innovation and growth opportunities driven by disruptive technologies, mega trends, emerging markets and new business models. Today, more than ever before, companies must innovate, not only to survive, but thrive in the future.  Works to continuously improve the effectiveness and efficiency of court practices, processes, and procedures. Advises the public, County officials, and attorneys of court and/or departmental guidelines. Implements changes in departmental operations due to changes in the law or court policy.

 Performs other duties as required.

 Associate degree in business or public administration, criminal justice, law, political science/international relations, or other liberal arts degree in a related area.

Depuis plus de 35 ans, Gecko Alliance s’impose comme un leader mondial dans l’industrie des spas. Reconnue pour son expertise en design, en production et en mise en marché de solutions innovantes, l’entreprise se distingue par une équipe passionnée, dynamique et engagée. 

 

Gecko offre à ses clients des solutions personnalisées et à la fine pointe de la technologie pour équiper leurs spas : systèmes de contrôle, claviers, pompes et accessoires hautement performants, conçus pour optimiser l’expérience utilisateur et soutenir le succès des manufacturiers du secteur. 

 

Aujourd'hui, nous sommes à la recherche d’un gestionnaire de projets d’expérience. 

La mission principale qui attend cette personne sera de parvenir à piloter efficacement des projets en développement de produits en lien avec les différentes activités de l’entreprise.  

 

Tâches et responsabilités



Support en Gestion de projets et programmes 

  • Prendre en charge la planification et orchestrer la mise en œuvre de projets d’entreprise, en veillant à respecter les objectifs et les délais fixés ;  
  • Définir précisément les divers attributs du projet (définition du mandat, temps alloué, ressources nécessaires, budget prévu, gestion des risques, etc) ; 
  • Analyser et contrôler rigoureusement la performance du projet, notamment les variances entre la planification et le réaliser pour garantir le succès de l’organisation ; 
  • Soulever les enjeux qui impactent le succès des projets et proposer des plans d'actions à l'équipe de direction; 
  • Préparer les rapports, indicateurs et autres éléments de suivi et de contrôle de projets ; 
  • Documenter et évaluer les demandes de changements en considérant leur impact ; 
  • Assurer une documentation complète des étapes du projet ; 
  • Instaurer chez les participants une rigueur dans l’exécution de leurs tâches ; 
  • Communiquer efficacement et visiblement l’avancement des projets auprès des parties prenantes ; 
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de la méthodologie, des outils et des modèles de gestion du processus et de suivi des projets de Gecko.    



Compétences recherchées

  • 8 à 10 années de réalisations et d’expérience dans la gestion de projets multiples ;
  • Expérience et/ou connaissance du secteur manufacturier ;
  • Expérience et/ou connaissance en développement de produits ;
  • Formation universitaire complétée et pertinente ;
  • Certification du PMI (Project management Institute) considérée comme un atout. 



Profil recherché

  • Leadership, engagement et appropriation – Être capable de fonctionner et de motiver des équipes dans un environnement dynamique et multi-départemental ; 
  • Influence – Avoir la capacité de guider l’avancement d’un projet afin d'atteindre les objectifs de l'entreprise ; 
  • Capacité d'adaptation – Avoir la capacité de faire pivoter les projets/initiatives en fonction des besoins et des priorités de l'entreprise.  



Lieu de travail : bureau de Québec

Vous voulez apprendre à concevoir des produits électroniques qui finissent réellement en production, entourés d'ingénieurs expérimenté pour accélérer votre apprentissage? C'est ce poste.


Vous joindrez une équipe multidisciplinaire (génie mécanique, génie électrique, programmation) et serez impliqué à toutes les étapes de développement, de l'exploration technologique jusqu'à la mise en production. Un ingénieur senior de l'équipe vous encadrera activement sur les revues de conception, les choix de composantes et les tests.


Vos principales responsabilités

  • Concevoir les circuits électriques et électroniques pour les nouveaux produits;
  • Participer à la sélection des composantes électriques/électroniques;
  • Développer et assembler les circuits prototypes utilisant des microcontrôleurs;
  • Élabore des plans de tests et participe à la mise en route de circuits électroniques;
  • Participer aux revues de conception;
  • Rédiger et maintenir à jour le dossier de conception;
  • Concevoir les produits en prenant en considération les capacités et contraintes de notre usine de fabrication (DFM);
  • Effectuer des tests de pré-certification et soutenir la certification de nos produits (UL, CE);
  • Offrir un support technique de deuxième niveau à notre équipe de services techniques, sur des enjeux électriques/électroniques.

 

Le profil que nous recherchons

Vous êtes une personne reconnue pour votre jugement technique, votre créativité, votre capacité à résoudre des problèmes complexes et votre approche pragmatique du développement de produits. Vous aimez autant approfondir un enjeu technique que collaborer avec différentes expertises pour faire progresser un projet.

 

Vos compétences et connaissances :

  • BAC en génie électrique (complété ou en voie de l'être);
  • 0-3 ans d'expérience pertinente (stages et projets académiques comptent);
  • Membre de l'OIQ, ou éligible et engagé à le devenir;
  • Bonne maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'oral et à l'écrit;
  • Curiosité, rigueur, et envie d'apprendre en contexte manufacturier réel.


Ce qui s'offre à vous:

  • Mentorat structuré par un ingénieur senior;
  • Exposition directe à toutes les étapes de développement produit, de l'idée à la production;
  • Environnement multidisciplinaire où vos idées sont entendues dès le premier jour.


Seront considérés comme des atouts

  • Connaissance du logiciel Altium;
  • Exposition aux microcontrôleurs et microprocesseur;
  • Expérience touchant à la certification de produits (UL, CE).

 

 Ce que nous vous offrons :

  • Horaire flexible avec possibilité de télétravail 2 jours/semaine;
  • Gamme d’avantages sociaux complète : assurances collectives, PAE, télémédecine, REER, etc.;
  • Café, breuvages et collations offerts au bureau;
  • Vacances offertes dès la première année.


Ce qui nous distingue

  • Une entreprise technologique québécoise reconnue dans son industrie;
  • Une équipe R&D multidisciplinaire où les expertises travaillent étroitement ensemble;
  • Des projets de développement de produits concrets, de la conception jusqu’à la production;
  • Un environnement où votre expertise technique sera mise à contribution et où vous aurez la latitude nécessaire pour proposer de nouvelles approches;
  • Une culture qui valorise l’innovation, l’amélioration continue et le partage des connaissances;
  • Des possibilités de développement professionnel avec le soutien de votre gestionnaire.

description_raw:
Gecko Alliance est un fabricant et distributeur de contrôles électroniques principalement pour l’industrie spa. En collaboration avec nos clients, de la conception à la production, nous leur offrons des solutions personnalisées et innovantes pour équiper leurs spas : systèmes de contrôle, claviers, pompes et accessoires à la fine pointe de la technologie. Nous établissons des relations à long terme avec nos clients depuis plus de 35 ans déjà. 

En rejoignant Gecko Digital, l'équipe derrière nos plateformes cloud, nos applications mobiles et nos objets connectés, tu participeras activement à cette modernisation et à la valeur que nous apportons à nos clients et aux utilisateurs de leurs produits. 


Ton rôle 

Tu assures la qualité de nos solutions numériques : plateformes cloud, applications mobiles et objets connectés (IoT). Intégré à l'équipe de développement cloud, en mode agile / scrum, tu combines tests manuels, plans de tests, automatisation et validation bout en bout sur des spas connectés pour détecter rapidement les régressions et sécuriser les livraisons. 


Qualité pendant le développement 

  • Tester les nouvelles fonctionnalités avant leur intégration et détecter les régressions tôt dans le cycle; 
  • Participer aux cérémonies agiles de l'équipe cloud et contribuer à définir les critères d'acceptation des nouvelles fonctionnalités; 
  • Effectuer des tests manuels ciblés (exploratoires / fonctionnels), puis convertir les cas pertinents en tests automatisés. 

Développer et maintenir l'automatisation des tests

  • Bonifier, entretenir et fiabiliser la suite de tests automatisés de l'équipe (interfaces web, applications mobiles, API); 
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe pour faire exécuter les tests automatisés en continu et rendre les résultats faciles à lire. 

Validation bout en bout en environnement réel (spas connectés) 

  • Prendre en charge la validation des spas connectés du lab, de l'appareil jusqu'au cloud et aux applications iOS et Android; 
  • Utiliser les spas au quotidien pour simuler des cas d'usage réels, valider l'observabilité et repérer les comportements anormaux tôt. 

Plans de tests et contribution au processus de release 

  • Écrire, maintenir et exécuter les plans de tests (fonctionnels, régression, validation de version) et en documenter les résultats; 
  • Travailler avec l'équipe de tests intégrés pendant les générations de version : valider la régression, aligner la couverture de tests et combler les trous. 

Support et reproduction de problèmes 

  • Collaborer avec l'équipe de support pour investiguer et reproduire les problèmes rapportés par les clients; 
  • Documenter les bugs de façon claire et actionnable, puis contribuer à leur correction avec les développeurs cloud. 

Outillage et efficacité 

  • Utiliser et créer des outils/scripts/utilitaires qui accélèrent la validation, améliorent la qualité des diagnostics et réduisent le travail répétitif; 
  • Explorer et adopter de nouveaux outils, incluant l'IA, pour accélérer la création de tests, l'analyse des résultats et la documentation. 


Profil recherché 

  • DEC ou BAC en informatique, génie logiciel ou équivalent; 
  • Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en assurance qualité logicielle ou en support technique (exigé); 
  • Expérience des tests manuels et volonté claire de pousser l'automatisation; 
  • Connaissance pratique des stratégies de tests : plans de tests, régression, exploratoire, critères d'acceptation; 
  • À l'aise avec l'investigation : reproduction, analyse de logs, documentation de bugs; 
  • Bonne capacité à travailler en équipe (développement cloud, support, tests intégrés) dans un contexte agile / scrum et de livraison continue; 
  • Volonté d'apprendre, curiosité pour les nouveaux outils et l'IA, et intérêt marqué pour l'automatisation des tests. 


Atouts (si applicable) 

  • Expérience avec des plateformes et outils de test comme Playwright, Qase, Magnitude ou équivalents; 
  • Expérience de tests sur applications mobiles iOS et Android et sur appareils IoT connectés; 
  • Connaissance de Python, JavaScript/TypeScript ou d'un langage de script; 
  • CI/CD et exécution automatisée (ex. GitHub Actions).

 Key Responsibilities 

 Assemble parts, components, and finished products according to work instructions and specifications.

 Use basic hand tools and power tools to complete assembly tasks.

 Inspect parts and completed assemblies for proper fit, quality, and workmanship.

 Maintain required production rates while ensuring accuracy and quality.

 Properly handle and organize materials, components, and finished products.

 Follow all company safety procedures and PPE requirements .

 Maintain a clean, safe, and organized workstation.

 Accurately complete required production and quality documentation.

 Work cooperatively with supervisors, leads, quality personnel, and other production team members.

 Perform additional production or assembly duties as assigned.

 Qualifications 

 High school diploma or GED preferred.

 Previous assembly, manufacturing, warehouse, or production experience is preferred but not required.

 Entry-level candidates with a strong work ethic and willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.

 Ability to safely use basic hand and power tools.

 Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.

 Basic mechanical aptitude is preferred.

 Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

 Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

 Dependable attendance and punctuality are required.

 Ability to stand for extended periods and perform repetitive assembly tasks.

 Ability to lift and move materials as required by the position.

 What We're Looking For 

 We are looking for individuals who are reliable, safety-conscious, quality-focused, and ready to work . Successful candidates should be comfortable working as part of a production team and willing to learn new assembly processes and procedures.

About us 

 Fullers360 has been connecting Aucklanders and visitors to the Hauraki for over 40 years. With a team of 350+ and a fleet of high-speed ferries and modern buses, we proudly serve nearly 6 million passengers a year - getting commuters to work and visitors to explore. 

 Our Waiheke Bus Company introduced Auckland’s first electric bus fleet, and we’re proud to be operating Auckland first hybrid-electric fast ferries. Sustainability, community and a down-to-earth culture are the heart of everything we do. 

 About our role 

 Reporting to the Head of Marine Operations, you’ll play an integral role in leading, coaching and developing our crew. This includes day to day contact and follow ups with your team to create a positive culture and an environment where they'll be enabled to succeed. 

 As the CDM, you'll work cross-functionally across Fullers to deliver a world class ferry service which is operated safely, reliably and delivers an exceptionally high standard of service and quality to our customers. 

 This role requires someone with the ability to think on their feet, with a pragmatic approach to problem solving. Due to the varied nature of the position, effective time-management, a proactive nature and influencing skills are key for success. 

 This is a permanent, full-time salaried role at 40 hours per week which requires flexibility to work over weekends, and public holidays as needed. 

 To be considered suitable for our role you’ll possess the following skills/attributes: 

 At least two (2) years people leadership experience with the ability to demonstrate success at developing, coaching and mentoring direct reports

 Extensive knowledge of the Waitemata Harbour and surrounds

 Sound communication skills with the ability to have robust conversations including performance feedback as well as professionally interact with stakeholders (internal & external)

 Sound computer literacy skills, preferably able to work in MS Office and Excel including reporting

 Sound knowledge of quality and safety management systems

 A willingness to learn with a passion towards continuous improvement. 

 Beneficial: 

 Someone from the maritime industry who's completed relevant qualifications (SRL / MEC5 / PAX / 500 TL) preferred but not essential

 Knowledge of MOSS, maritime rules as well as the Maritime Transport Act and Health and Safety at Work Act 2015 

 Experience with e-learning platforms

 About our benefits and perks (T&C's apply) 

 Free ferry travel for work and leisure for our full-time permanent employees (partner and dependents under 18 travel free for leisure, 25% discount if commuting)

 Free travel on Waiheke Bus Company Buses for work purposes

 Free hot beverages before, during or immediately after a shift/work hours and 50% discount on all other café items 

 For leisure (off duty/non-work related) all café purchases have a 50% discount 

 Free uniform, annual flu vaccination and EAP (employee assistance program)

 Access to subsidised CBD parking if you're commuting from Auckland city ($30 per week)

 Access to discounted gym memberships (Auckland Council & Les Mills) and discounted healthcare (Southern Cross)

 Our company culture 

 As an organisation, we encourage our people to always treat others with respect, to act with integrity, to be open and trustworthy, and to use good judgment. Our people work hard, approach problems as challenges and learn from their successes as well as their failures.

 If this role sounds like you, please apply today!

Warehouse Associate – Conroe, TX 

 Job Summary 

 Full Circle Recruiting is seeking dependable and motivated Warehouse Associates for positions supporting our manufacturing client in Conroe, Texas . This is a great opportunity for individuals looking to build experience in a warehouse, distribution, manufacturing, or production environment.

 Warehouse Associates will be responsible for receiving, organizing, moving, picking, packing, and preparing materials and products while maintaining inventory accuracy, quality standards, and a safe work environment.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Receive, unload, inspect, and properly store incoming materials and products.

 Pick, pack, stage, and prepare materials or finished products for production or shipment.

 Move materials throughout the warehouse using carts, pallet jacks, or other approved material-handling equipment.

 Verify quantities, part numbers, labels, and documentation for incoming and outgoing materials.

 Maintain accurate inventory counts and assist with cycle counts and inventory audits.

 Properly organize materials, parts, supplies, and finished products in designated storage locations.

 Identify and report damaged, missing, or incorrect materials and products.

 Assist with shipping and receiving activities, including labeling, packaging, and staging orders.

 Support production teams by ensuring materials and components are delivered to designated work areas as needed.

 Follow all company safety procedures and PPE requirements .

 Maintain a clean, safe, and organized warehouse and work area.

 Accurately complete required warehouse, inventory, shipping, and receiving documentation.

 Work cooperatively with supervisors, leads, production personnel, quality personnel, and other warehouse team members.

 Perform additional warehouse, material-handling, or general labor duties as assigned.

 Qualifications 

 High school diploma or GED preferred.

 Previous warehouse, shipping and receiving, manufacturing, inventory, or production experience is preferred but not required.

 Entry-level candidates with a strong work ethic and willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.

 Experience using pallet jacks or other warehouse equipment is preferred.

 Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.

 Basic math and inventory-counting skills.

 Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

 Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced warehouse or manufacturing environment.

 Dependable attendance and punctuality are required.

 Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and perform repetitive tasks for extended periods.

 Ability to lift, carry, push, and move materials as required by the position.

 What We're Looking For 

 We are looking for individuals who are reliable, safety-conscious, organized, detail-oriented, and ready to work . Successful candidates should be comfortable working as part of a warehouse and production team, handling materials efficiently, and maintaining accurate inventory and shipping information.

GREEN LAKE COUNTY JOB DESCRIPTION 

 TITLE: Clinical Therapist

 DEPARTMENT: Health and Human Services/Behavioral Health Services

 LOCATION: Government Center

 SUPERVISOR: Behavioral Health Services Unit Manager

 PAY GROUP: 8

 SUMMARY: To provide essential community based mental health and substance use services to persons with a mental illness and/or substance use disorders that will enable them to obtain and/or maintain independent living in the community.

 DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 

 Providing assessment and treatment of children, families, and adults. This includes interviewing collateral sources in order to gather information (i.e., individual, family, referral source, community agencies, etc.).

 Provides individual and group treatment opportunities

 Collaborates with psychiatrist, crisis team, and community-based staff to provide care as part of a comprehensive treatment team

 Coordination of services within the Department of Health & Human Services and with outside agencies/supports.

 Provides crisis counseling, crisis intervention and being part of the 24 hour on-call crisis team

 Maintains behavioral health charts, including use of the electronic health record. This would include completing necessary forms, (i.e., release of information, insurance claim, scheduling appointments, et.).

 The remaining time is spent attending and participating in staffings, in-services, supervision and trainings.

 May assist with client contacts in the community such as home visits, team meetings, and group activities.

 SKILLS AND ABILITIES: 
Basic everyday living skills, the ability to understand, follow and provide directions; reading, writing (reports) is necessary. Additionally, it is preferred to have comprehensive knowledge of the needs of individuals with chronic mental illness, substance abuse and other mental health issues, practices of counseling and recovery, crisis intervention and response; ability to relate to and communicate effectively with staff, community professionals, agencies and the general public. Must have a valid Wisconsin Driver's License and access to an insured vehicle. Skill in the use of general office equipment, including but not limited to: telephone, copy machine, calculator, dictation equipment, computer terminal, fax machine, and automobile. A video camera may also be used to tape interviews.

 QUALIFICATIONS: 

 EDUCATION: A Master's degree in a Social Work, Clinical Psychology, Marriage and Family, or a related field

 EXPERIENCE / JOB KNOWLEDGE: 3,000 hours post master’s clinical supervision with at least 1,000 hours of the 3,000 being supervised post-degree clinical experience with chronically mentally ill persons is preferred. Must be Licensed or eligible to apply asa Mental Health and Substance Abuse Counselor. (Clinical Social Worker, Professional Counselor, C.A.P.S.W. (Certified Advanced Practice Social Worker), etc., or License eligible in Wisconsin). Must be certified/certifiable medical assistance provider in Wisconsin.

 WORKING CONDITIONS: 

 PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Listening, talking, sitting, writing, reading or visually observing. Some standing, walking, reaching and low lifting. In unusual circumstances, it may be necessary to stoop, kneel, and lift/carry objects weighing up to 40 pounds.

 Management’s assignment of essential functions is not designed to limit the manner in which duties may be accomplished. Management shall comply with all applicable workplace laws and shall communicate with any employee with a disability to determine the availability of a reasonable accommodation(s) to allow the employee to perform the essential functions of the job. 

 ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS: Over 90% of work done is inside. In about 10% of the time situations develop where there is a threat of physical attack or injury from clients This is a public service position, and employee is required to be courteous, cooperative and respectful at all times with the public and clients; also establishes and maintains a courteous and cooperative and respectful working relationship with other employees, supervisors and public officials.

 This position description has been prepared to assist in defining job responsibilities, physical demands, working conditions and needed skills. It is not intended as a complete list of job duties, responsibilities and/or essential functions. This description is not intended to limit or modify the rights of any supervisor to assign, direct, and control the work of employees under supervision. The county retains and reserves any and all rights to change, modify, amend, add to or delete from, any section of this document as it deems, in its' judgment, to be proper.

 Established in 1987, Greystone Construction is a versatile general contractor serving commercial, industrial, agribusiness, municipal, multifamily, and senior housing clients across the United States. Our headquarters are located in Shakopee, Minnesota with additional offices in Georgetown, Texas; Bismarck, North Dakota; and Spirit Lake, Iowa. Greystone has completed projects in 39 states and counting. 

 Our reputation for safety, integrity, and construction excellence has earned us partnerships with some of the best companies in the markets we serve. Consistently delivering quality and building lasting relationships are the foundation of our success. 

 At Greystone, every team member is a leader. We empower our people to act with purpose and deliver results that exceed expectations. Guided by our shared values and vision, we pursue limitless potential in people and places, striving to make a positive impact on every project, every client, and every community we serve. 

 Summary 

 The Drywaller safely performs all carpentry, drywall and assigned tasks on job sites. Drywallers are responsible in performing work to the highest quality and safety standards while also assisting less experienced team members. Drywallers will report directly to the Lead Drywaller or Superintendent on site. 

 Essential Duties & Responsibilities 

 Enforce all Company safety policies, OSHA policies and other applicable safety standards. 

 Perform work on construction sites to the highest of quality and safety standards. 

 Operate hand and power tools of all types. 

 Inspection and operation of aerial equipment, skid steers and forklifts. 

 Hange, tape, sand and paint drywall in a timely matter 

 Unload materials, store efficiently and stage jobsite for operations. 

 Maintain a clean and safe jobsite. 

 Perform other related duties as required. 

 Demolition 

 Qualifications 

 5 years previous drywalling experience. 

 Ability to travel to job sites as required. 

 Able to apply sound judgment and problem-solving skills to projects and challenges. 

 Skills, Knowledge and Abilities 

 Ability to read and comprehend blueprints. 

 Knowledge of acceptable construction site practices including occupational safety and health regulations. 

 Ability to comprehend and follow complex direction. 

 Determine the kind of tools and equipment needed to complete each task assignment. 

 Must be comfortable with high intensity work environment. 

 High level of motivation, integrity, and commitment to team and customers. 

 Strong work ethic, decisive, ambitious, with an unwavering commitment to quality and professional work. 

 Working Environment / Physical Requirements 

 Sitting, standing, walking un-even surfaces, climbing, kneeling, lifting up to 50 lbs on a regular basis and occasionally lifting up to 80 lbs. 

 Must be capable of working on job sites where temperatures and noise level can fluctuate, and the ability to see, hear, and verbally communicate with co-workers and clients as needed. 

 Must have near visual acuity to review written documentation. 

 Ability to wear job required Personal Protective Equipment. 

 Our total rewards 

 Up to 100% company paid health insurance for our team members. 

 Safety training and professional development opportunities. 

 Annual discretionary profit-sharing contribution to the 401k. 

 401(k) match 25% of employee contribution up to 8% of your annual wages. 

 Why Greystone 

 We value Safety, Teamwork, Relationships, Integrity, Versatility, and Excellence —the foundation of how we think and act every day.

 We’re an employer of choice —committed to professional and personal growth through our total rewards philosophy , encompassing competitive pay, benefits, work-life balance, recognition, and career development. 

 Equal Opportunity Employer (It is my understanding that now that we are a Federal contractor / subcontractor, we need to identify ourselves as such in our EEO statement. I’m not an expert, but I think the following still lists all the protected statuses per Federal and Minnesota state laws.) 

 As a federal contractor, Greystone is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA)

Exchange Coordinator 

 Join the Hunter Automotive Group Team 

 Hunter Automotive Group is looking for a motivated, customer-focused Exchange Coordinator to join our team. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with customers, building relationships, solving problems, and identifying opportunities to help customers find their next vehicle. 

 The Exchange Coordinator works closely with the Service and Sales teams to connect service customers with potential vehicle exchange and upgrade opportunities while providing an exceptional customer experience. 

 What You'll Do 

 Customer Experience 

 Meet with service customers and provide a friendly, professional experience. 

 Listen to customer needs and help identify potential vehicle exchange opportunities. 

 Address customer questions and concerns and assist with finding solutions. 

 Build strong customer relationships through professional communication and follow-up. 

 Vehicle Exchange Opportunities 

 Present vehicle exchange and upgrade opportunities to eligible service customers. 

 Identify opportunities such as lease returns, expiring contracts, service customers, Care Connect opportunities, and other potential customers. 

 Connect interested customers with a Sales Consultant to continue the vehicle purchase process. 

 Maintain an organized log of customer opportunities and follow-up activity. 

 Follow-Up & CRM 

 Confirm appointments and maintain accurate information in the CRM. 

 Follow up with prospective customers and service-drive opportunities. 

 Track customer interactions, appointments, and exchange opportunities. 

 Conduct weekly check-ins with Sales Management to review opportunities and progress. 

 Teamwork 

 Work closely with Service Advisors, Sales Consultants, and Sales Management. 

 Communicate customer needs and opportunities effectively between departments. 

 Support dealership sales and customer satisfaction goals. 

 What We're Looking For 

 Previous automotive, sales, service, or customer service experience is a plus. 

 Strong communication and relationship-building skills. 

 Comfortable speaking with customers and discussing vehicle options. 

 Strong follow-up and organizational skills. 

 Comfortable using CRM systems and technology. 

 Self-motivated, proactive, and goal-oriented. 

 Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment. 

 Strong work ethic and positive attitude. 

 Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record. 

 What We Offer 

 Competitive Pay & Performance-Based Incentives 

 Medical Insurance 

 Dental Insurance 

 Vision Insurance 

 Wellness Program 

 401(k) with Company Match 

 Paid Time Off 

 Paid Holidays 

 Employee Discounts on Vehicles, Parts & Services 

 Career Growth Opportunities 

 Ongoing Training & Development 

 Supportive Leadership Team 

 Positive, Team-Oriented Work Environment 

 Employee Appreciation Events & Celebrations 

 Closed Sundays 

 Why Hunter Automotive Group? 

 Hunter Automotive Group is a fourth-generation, family-owned company that has proudly served Western North Carolina since 1940. We believe in developing our employees, promoting from within, and creating opportunities for long-term career growth. 

 Our Core Focus is to improve the quality of life for our employees, customers, and community. 

 Our Core Values 

 Honesty 

 Continuous Improvement 

 Strong Work Ethic 

 Positive Attitude 

 If you enjoy working with people, creating opportunities, and helping customers find the right vehicle for their needs, we'd love to meet you! 

 Apply today and join the Hunter Automotive Group team! 

 Hunter Automotive Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description:
Health & Safety Manager (Multi-Site Retail) 

 Reporting to: General Manager \ Chief People Officer 

 Work location : Burmarrad, Malta 

 Territory Responsibility: Group 

 Hudson Group is an international retailer and distributor primarily involved in the sport and fashion wear sectors. The Group’s head office is in Malta but is also present through offices in Italy, Cyprus, Morocco, Nigeria, Kenya and Algeria.

 Though Hudson Holdings was founded in 2006, the Group’s roots reach as far back as 1987 when the first pair of NIKE was sold in Malta.

 Role purpose 

 The Health & Safety Manager will lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of health and safety systems across all retail locations in Malta, including stores, warehouses, and administrative facilities.

 This role ensures full compliance with the Health and Safety at Work Act (Chapter 646 of the Laws of Malta) and all related subsidiary legislation, while fostering a strong safety culture aligned with EU directives and retail operational standards.

 The key duties and responsibilities of the role are as follows: 

 Legal Compliance & Governance 

 Ensure compliance with Maltese Occupational Health and Safety legislation, including the Health and Safety at Work Act (Chapter 646).

 Maintain adherence to the Work Place (Minimum Health and Safety Requirements) Regulations (S.L. 646.08) and other applicable subsidiary legislation.

 Liaise with the Occupational Health and Safety Authority (OHSA) during inspections, audits, and compliance reviews.

 Oversee legally required risk assessments and ensure timely implementation of corrective measures.

 Develop, implement, and maintain an up-to-date Health & Safety Policy and supporting procedures.

 Monitor legislative updates and ensure company policies reflect regulatory changes.

 Multi-Site & Multi-Country Safety Management 

 Conduct regular site audits across all retail outlets, warehouses, and administrative facilities in Malta and when required, other Hudson territories.

 Implement standardised health and safety protocols tailored to retail and logistics environments.

 Monitor incident reports and lead investigations into accidents, near-misses, and emerging risk trends.

 Support store and operational management in hazard identification and preventive action planning.

 Track audit findings and ensure timely closure of corrective actions.

 Training, Competence & Culture 

 Develop and deliver Health & Safety training programmes for all employees.

 Verify that designated competent persons meet OHSA criteria.

 Promote safety awareness and embed a proactive safety culture across all sites.

 Reporting & Documentation 

 Maintain detailed and accurate safety documentation and compliance records.

 Establish standardised reporting templates and KPIs.

 Report compliance performance, risks, incidents, and improvement plans to senior leadership.

 Support or act as the Health & Safety Reporting Officer (HSRO) where required.

 Monitor key safety metrics.

 Emergency Preparedness & Continuous Improvement 

 Lead safety culture and engagement initiatives across all sites.

 Develop and oversee emergency preparedness standards and drills.

 Benchmark safety practices against EU directives and retail best practice.

 Identify operational improvements to reduce risk and enhance workplace safety performance.

 How you will be measured: 

 Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR)

 % Legal & Internal H&S Compliance Across All Sites

 Audit Findings Closure Time

 Mandatory H&S Training Coverage

 Near-Miss & Safety Observation Reporting Rate

 What You Will Bring to the Role: 

 Level 5 qualification or higher in Occupational Health & Safety.

 Recognised training in Maltese OHS legislative frameworks.

 Registered or meet OHSA’s definition of a “Competent Person.”

 Strong working knowledge of the Health and Safety at Work Act (Chapter 646).

 Experience developing and delivering engaging health & safety training programs.

 Demonstrated experience in reporting, governance frameworks, and structured health & safety documentation management and implementation.

 Ability to influence managers and operational teams to embed a strong safety culture.

 Experience liaising with regulatory authorities.

 Experienced in documentation management, control systems, and structured implementation of health and safety policies and procedures.

 Fluent in English (written and spoken).

 Willingness to travel regularly across Hudson territories.

 Core competencies: 

 Strong communication skills (clear, assertive, and practical)

 Influencing and stakeholder management

 Ability to remain calm under pressure

 Proactive mindset and initiative-driven

 Adaptability in fast-paced retail environments

 Coaching and mentoring capability

 Collaborative and cross-functional working style

 Attention to detail

 Problem-solving mindset

Join us in making a difference! Apply today and become part of a workplace where people and purpose come together to transform lives. 

 We are currently looking for a Cleaner to join us on a part-time basis. Our cleaner shall be responsible for maintaining the cleanliness and upkeep of the premises, ensuring a safe and well-kept environment. This includes overseeing the sanitation and general maintenance of the departments and clinic facilities to provide a healthy and safe space for students, staff, and visitors. 

 Duties & responsibilities 

 Sweeping and mopping floors across classrooms, offices, hallways, bathrooms and common areas. 

 Dusting and cleaning furniture, windows, shelves and fixtures. 

 Cleaning and sanitising restrooms and replenishing supplies. 

 Emptying bins and ensuring waste is disposed of appropriately. 

 Cleaning windows, walls and other surfaces to maintain a tidy environment. 

 Following all relevant health and safety and cleaning procedures . 

 Using cleaning chemicals and equipment safely and responsibly. 

 Reporting any hazards, maintenance issues or equipment malfunctions. 

 Monitoring cleaning supplies and maintaining appropriate stock levels. 

 Managing and segregating waste according to applicable procedures. 

 Working closely with staff to ensure cleaning activities do not disrupt daily operations. 

 Supporting with the preparation of spaces for meetings, activities and events. 

 Maintaining confidentiality and complying with GDPR policies and procedures . 

 Following Inspire’s Code of Ethics & Professional Conduct and organisational policies. 

 Working collaboratively with colleagues and contributing to a positive and respectful working environmen t. 

 Core skills & qualities 

 The ideal candidate should be in possession of the following: 

 Proven experience in housekeeping, janitorial work, or facilities maintenance. 

 Knowledge of cleaning chemicals and equipment. 

 Ability to follow instructions and complete tasks efficiently. 

 Strong attention to detail and a commitment.

description:
Location: This position serves clients throughout Contra Costa County. The role is not limited to Walnut Creek only.

 Day Schedule — sessions are generally scheduled between 8:30 a.m. and 6:00 p.m.

 Services are provided one-to-one on a weekly schedule, generally between 8:30 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. Days and session length are based on each client's needs, and hours can vary. Availability across the week helps us match you with clients.

 About the role 

 Inspired Living provides Independent Living Services to adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities, building the skills that support independence. As an ILS Instructor, you are assigned a small number of clients and work with each of them one-on-one, teaching the skills they have chosen to work on. Sessions are individual rather than group based. The exception is occasional company client events, where staff and clients come together.

 This is a teaching role, not a caregiving or companion role. You are not there to do things for the client. You are there to show them how, practice with them, and step back as they take it on themselves. Skill building is incremental. Instructors often teach and practice the same skill across many sessions before a client performs it independently.

 Where you work and what you teach 

 Sessions take place in the client's home or out in the community, typically in blocks of several hours.

 Skill areas commonly include:

 Cooking, meal planning, grocery shopping, and food safety

 Budgeting, banking, paying bills, and managing benefits

 Household routines, cleaning, and laundry

 Personal hygiene and health routines, including scheduling and attending medical appointments

 Using public transportation and getting around the community

 Communication, self-advocacy, and problem solving

 Building and maintaining safe relationships

 Community outings are part of the work when they serve a goal: practicing a bus route, doing the week's shopping, going to the bank.

 What the job asks of you 

 Work independently. No supervisor is on site with you. You manage the session, your time, and your own judgment in the moment. You escalate to your ILS Manager when something is outside your scope.

 Document every session. Service notes and timesheets must be accurate and submitted on time. 

 Show up consistently. Consistency and routine are central to the service. Clients depend on scheduled sessions taking place as planned.

 Drive. You travel to clients and transport them during sessions when authorized to do so. 

 Communicate promptly. 
Schedule changes, client concerns, safety issues, and incidents go to your ILS Manager right away. 

 Schedule and hours 

 Part-time. You must be available for at least three four-hour blocks per week, on at least three separate days, between 8:30 a.m. and 6:00 p.m.

 You have input into which blocks you take, and schedules are set around client availability. Assigned hours depend on current client assignments and can change when a client's needs, goals, or availability change. Hours are not guaranteed.

 What you need 

 High school diploma or GED

 At least six months of paid or volunteer experience supporting people with disabilities, or comparable human services experience

 Ability to communicate clearly in English, spoken and written

 Spanish proficiency preferred; required for some client assignments

 Valid California driver's license, a reliable vehicle, and current registration and insurance

 CPR and First Aid certification, or willingness to obtain it before your first client session

 Employment offers are contingent on completion of a background check.

 Essential functions 

 Travel by vehicle to client homes and community locations, typically up to 30 minutes each way and occasionally longer depending on the assignment

 Operate a vehicle and transport clients safely

 Stand and walk for extended periods during sessions, including in homes, stores, transit, and other community settings

 Occasionally lift or carry up to 25 pounds, such as groceries, laundry, or supplies

 Read, write, and complete electronic documentation

 Communicate by phone, text, and email

 If you need an accommodation to perform these functions or during the hiring process, let us know.

 Compensation and benefits 

 Mileage reimbursement in accordance with company policy

 Monthly phone stipend

 401(k) with company match, subject to plan terms and eligibility

 Paid sick leave as provided under California law

 Discretionary bonus review twice per year; bonuses are not guaranteed and eligibility and amount are subject to company review and approval

 Employee perks and discounts

 About us 

 Inspired Living provides Independent Living Services across California. We believe adults with developmental disabilities should be supported to make their own decisions, build their own skills, and live the lives they choose. Our instructors are the people who make that real, one session at a time.

 Inspired Living is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

 Employment with Inspired Living is at-will.

As an ILS Instructor, you are assigned a small number of clients and work with each of them one-on-one, teaching the skills they have chosen to work on. Sessions are individual rather than group based. The exception is occasional company client events, where staff and clients come together.


This is a teaching role, not a caregiving or companion role. You are not there to do things for the client. You are there to show them how, practice with them, and step back as they take it on themselves. Skill building is incremental. Instructors often teach and practice the same skill across many sessions before a client performs it independently.


Where you work and what you teach

Sessions take place in the client's home or out in the community, typically in blocks of several hours.


Skill areas commonly include:

  • Cooking, meal planning, grocery shopping, and food safety
  • Budgeting, banking, paying bills, and managing benefits
  • Household routines, cleaning, and laundry
  • Personal hygiene and health routines, including scheduling and attending medical appointments
  • Using public transportation and getting around the community
  • Communication, self-advocacy, and problem solving
  • Building and maintaining safe relationships


Community outings are part of the work when they serve a goal: practicing a bus route, doing the week's shopping, going to the bank.


What the job asks of you

  • Work independently. No supervisor is on site with you. You manage the session, your time, and your own judgment in the moment. You escalate to your ILS Manager when something is outside your scope.
  • Document every session. Service notes and timesheets must be accurate and submitted on time.
  • Show up consistently. Consistency and routine are central to the service. Clients depend on scheduled sessions taking place as planned.
  • Drive. You travel to clients and transport them during sessions when authorized to do so.
  • Communicate promptly.
    Schedule changes, client concerns, safety issues, and incidents go to your ILS Manager right away.


Schedule and hours

Part-time. You must be available for at least three four-hour blocks per week, on at least three separate days, between 8:30 a.m. and 6:00 p.m.


You have input into which blocks you take, and schedules are set around client availability. Assigned hours depend on current client assignments and can change when a client's needs, goals, or availability change. Hours are not guaranteed.


What you need

  • High school diploma or GED
  • At least six months of paid or volunteer experience supporting people with disabilities, or comparable human services experience
  • Ability to communicate clearly in English, spoken and written
  • Spanish proficiency preferred; required for some client assignments
  • Valid California driver's license, a reliable vehicle, and current registration and insurance
  • CPR and First Aid certification, or willingness to obtain it before your first client session


Employment offers are contingent on completion of a background check.


Essential functions

  • Travel by vehicle to client homes and community locations, typically up to 30 minutes each way and occasionally longer depending on the assignment
  • Operate a vehicle and transport clients safely
  • Stand and walk for extended periods during sessions, including in homes, stores, transit, and other community settings
  • Occasionally lift or carry up to 25 pounds, such as groceries, laundry, or supplies
  • Read, write, and complete electronic documentation
  • Communicate by phone, text, and email


If you need an accommodation to perform these functions or during the hiring process, let us know.


Compensation and benefits

  • Mileage reimbursement in accordance with company policy
  • Monthly phone stipend
  • 401(k) with company match, subject to plan terms and eligibility
  • Paid sick leave as provided under California law
  • Discretionary bonus review twice per year; bonuses are not guaranteed and eligibility and amount are subject to company review and approval
  • Employee perks and discounts


About us

Inspired Living provides Independent Living Services across California. We believe adults with developmental disabilities should be supported to make their own decisions, build their own skills, and live the lives they choose. Our instructors are the people who make that real, one session at a time.


Inspired Living is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.


Employment with Inspired Living is at-will.

Data Processing Executive – US Mortgage 

 About Infrrd 

 We are Infrrd — the Enterprise AI company that uses AI and Machine Learning technologies to help our customers automate human tasks. We are looking for a Data Processing Executive who will help with data annotation and correction of US Mortgage documents to support our growing clientele. This role will be responsible for classifying data and becoming a subject matter expert on US mortgage documentation.

 About the Role 

 As a member of the Data Processing team, the Data Processing Executive will work on US mortgage document handling end-to-end — from annotating and correcting data, to verifying accuracy, classifying documents, and maintaining quality standards across large volumes of mortgage files. This is a hands-on operational role suited to someone who enjoys detail-oriented work and wants to build deep, real-world expertise in US mortgage documentation and processes.

 What you will do? 

 Data Annotation & Correction : Accurately annotate and correct US mortgage documents to support downstream data processing and model accuracy.

 Data Quality Assurance : Verify and ensure the quality and accuracy of data extracted and processed from mortgage documents.

 Document Classification : Classify mortgage documents by type and become a subject matter expert in US mortgage documentation.

 Data Processing : Process customer information, transactions, and updates related to US mortgage documents, and input collected data into company systems accurately and efficiently.

 Data Verification: Confirm, corroborate, and remove unnecessary data, or combine data from multiple sources to ensure consistency and accuracy.

 Reporting : Generate reports as required by the department, in accordance with outlined standards and timelines.

 Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand process requirements and communicate updates or issues clearly to team members and stakeholders.

 Confidentiality & Compliance: Maintain strict confidentiality of all customer and mortgage-related information in line with company policy.

 Productivity : Meet productivity metrics as assigned by the department.

 Who You Are 

 Bachelor’s Degree

 2+ years of experience in a similar role within the US Mortgage industry

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 Technical skills (MS Excel, Google Apps Suite; Sheets, Docs, Slides, etc.)

 Strong attention to detail and basic ability to comfortably operate a computer

 Ability to prioritize and multitask

 Flexible to work night shifts (post-training) and rotational shifts based on client requirements

 Must have a stable internet connection

 Location : Work from Office - Bangalore

 Shift Details : During the initial training period, work hours will be in the day shift to support onboarding and process familiarization. Once training is complete, the role will transition to rotational shifts based on client requirements.

 Job Type : Contract role for 1 year and will be further renewed based on mutual interests.

description:
About inline 

 inline is a software startup focused on maximizing restaurant efficiency managing tables and reservations. We have thousands of restaurants including leading chain brands, Michelin-starred restaurants, shopping malls, and busy brick-and-mortar restaurants. We also partner with food-tech platforms, social apps, and various media services to grow the exposure and business for inline restaurant customers. Our team is launching and exploring more global opportunities in key cities, including Tokyo, Osaka, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Kuala Lumpur, Vancouver, Melbourne, Sydney and the cities in the US. For people with solid professional skills and talent, who are highly motivated to expand their career and learn in a fast, flexible environment, we have several opportunities to build the business with our team and write the legend inline for the next thousand partners at a rapid pace. 

 The Role 

 At Inline, the primary responsibility of the Senior GTM Operations Specialist – Performance Management is to strengthen how our GTM organization measures performance, identifies business risks and opportunities, and makes data-driven decisions across Business Development and Customer Success. 

 This role goes beyond reporting. You will take ownership of translating business questions into meaningful performance indicators, analytical frameworks, dashboards, and actionable insights. By connecting data with business context, you will help teams understand not only what is happening, but also why it is happening, what is likely to happen next, and what actions should be taken. 

 To succeed in this role, you should be highly analytical, commercially minded, and comfortable working with ambiguous business questions. You will collaborate closely with BD, CSM, Business Operations, Revenue Operations, BI & Analytics, Finance, and other stakeholders to ensure GTM performance is measured consistently and that insights are translated into meaningful business actions. 

 This role plays a critical part in building a more proactive and data-driven GTM organization, enabling teams and leaders to identify performance gaps early, make better decisions, and continuously improve business outcomes. 

 If this sounds like you – read on! 

 Key Responsibilities 

 Business Performance Monitoring & KPI Management 

 Define, develop, and maintain key GTM performance indicators across the customer lifecycle, including metrics such as conversion, upsell, renewal, retention, and churn. 

 Build and maintain performance dashboards and reporting frameworks that enable BD, CSM, and management teams to clearly understand business performance and progress toward targets. 

 Continuously monitor performance trends and anomalies, proactively identifying significant changes, emerging risks, or areas requiring further investigation. 

 Analytics & Business Insights 

 Conduct deep-dive analyses across areas such as conversion, customer retention, revenue performance, customer segmentation, and behavioral trends to identify key business drivers and performance gaps. 

 Translate complex data into clear and actionable business insights, recommendations, and potential next steps for relevant stakeholders. 

 Develop early-warning analyses to identify potential business risks or performance deterioration before they materially impact results. 

 Evaluate the impact of business initiatives, operational changes, or GTM strategies and provide recommendations for further optimization. 

 Planning, Forecasting & Target Setting 

 Develop and maintain forecasting models to provide visibility into expected GTM performance and support quarterly and annual business planning. 

 Provide historical performance analysis, benchmarks, business assumptions, and scenario analysis to support early-stage target discussions and evaluate the feasibility and implications of proposed targets. 

 Partner with the Bonus & Incentive Planning function during target planning by providing performance data and analytical recommendations, while formal target setting and related incentive design remain owned by the Bonus & Incentive Planning function. 

 Monitor actual performance against agreed targets and forecasts, identify key variances, and provide insights into underlying drivers, emerging risks, and potential areas requiring action. 

 Data Quality & Metric Alignment 

 Partner with Product Team,Revenue Operations, and relevant stakeholders to ensure GTM performance metrics are consistently defined, understood, and applied across teams. 

 Identify and investigate discrepancies across reporting sources, CRM systems, and operational data to ensure performance analyses are reliable and decision-ready. 

 Maintain clear documentation and business definitions for key GTM metrics, ensuring teams have a shared understanding of how performance is measured. 

 Business Decision Support & Data Enablement 

 Partner closely with BD, CSM, and leadership teams to translate business questions into structured analyses and decision frameworks. 

 Provide analytical support for strategic and ad-hoc business questions, while identifying opportunities to convert recurring requests into standardized reporting or self-service solutions. 

 Help stakeholders interpret performance data and develop stronger data-driven decision-making capabilities across the GTM organization. 

 Cross-functional Collaboration 

 Collaborate with Business Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, BD, CSM, Product, and other teams to connect business context with data and ensure insights lead to meaningful actions. 

 Act as a key point of contact for GTM performance-related questions, helping stakeholders clarify problems, identify relevant metrics, and determine the appropriate analytical approach. 

 Preferred Experience & Personal Traits 

 Minimum of 4–5 years of relevant experience in Business Operations, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Strategy & Operations, Business Analytics, Performance Management, or related fields. 

 Strong experience analyzing business performance and working with KPI frameworks, forecasting, target setting, or performance tracking for Sales, Business Development, Customer Success, or other GTM functions. 

 Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets and experience working with CRM systems such as Salesforce and business intelligence or reporting tools. Experience with SQL, Python, or other analytical tools is a strong plus. 

 Analytical Skills: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to structure ambiguous business questions, identify meaningful patterns, and translate complex data into actionable business insights. 

 Business Acumen: Able to connect data with commercial and operational context, understand key business drivers, and distinguish meaningful signals from reporting noise. 

 Problem-Solving: Comfortable investigating unclear or unexpected performance changes, identifying root causes, and developing practical recommendations rather than stopping at observation. 

 Communication: Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings clearly to both operational teams and senior stakeholders. 

 Ownership: Able to independently own analytical projects from problem definition and data validation through analysis, recommendation, and follow-up. 

 Detail-oriented with a strong commitment to data accuracy, consistency, and reliability. 

 Self-motivated, able to work independently, manage priorities, and operate effectively in a fast-changing and ambiguous environment. 

 Experience leading cross-functional analytical projects or mentoring junior team members is a plus.

description:
Key Responsibilities 

 Lead the Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) function for transmission line and substation projects. 

 Develop, implement, and maintain project-specific Quality Plans (QAP), Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), Method Statements, and quality procedures. 

 Ensure compliance with project specifications, client requirements, applicable Indian Standards (IS), IEC, IEEE, ISO 9001, and statutory regulations. 

 Oversee quality inspections for civil, structural, electrical, mechanical, erection, testing, and commissioning activities. 

 Monitor supplier and vendor quality performance, conduct vendor evaluations, and ensure material quality compliance. 

 Review and approve material inspection reports, factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), calibration records, and quality documentation. 

 Plan and conduct internal quality audits, supplier audits, and support external/client audits. 

 Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and ensure timely closure. 

 Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Construction, HSE, and Project Management teams to achieve project quality objectives. 

 Ensure complete quality documentation, inspection records, and turnover dossiers for project handover. 

 Monitor quality KPIs, analyze trends, and implement continuous improvement initiatives. 

 Lead, mentor, and develop site quality engineers, inspectors, and QA/QC teams. 

 Participate in client meetings, technical reviews, and project quality discussions. 

 Support bid and proposal teams by reviewing quality requirements during project tendering. 

 Required Qualifications 

 Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline. 

 Master's degree is an added advantage. 

 Certification as an ISO 9001 Lead Auditor is preferred. 

 Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt or equivalent quality certification is desirable. 

 Experience 

 Minimum 12 years of experience in QA/QC within transmission line and substation EPC projects. 

 Proven experience in EHV transmission projects (132 kV, 220 kV, 400 kV, 765 kV, and above). 

 Experience managing quality functions for multiple projects simultaneously. 

 Exposure to client inspections involving utilities such as Power Grid, State Transmission Utilities, or private developers. 

 Experience with EPC contractors in the power transmission sector is highly preferred. 

 Technical Skills 

 Strong knowledge of transmission line construction, substations, testing, commissioning, and quality control practices. 

 Thorough understanding of Indian Standards (IS), IEC, IEEE, ISO 9001, and client-specific quality requirements. 

 Expertise in quality documentation, inspection planning, welding inspections, material testing, FAT, SAT, and commissioning quality. 

 Knowledge of quality management tools such as RCA, CAPA, FMEA, 5 Why Analysis, and Statistical Process Control. 

 Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and ERP systems such as SAP or Oracle is desirable. 

 Ability to review engineering drawings, technical specifications, and quality documentation. 

 Leadership & Behavioral Competencies 

 Strong leadership and people management skills. 

 Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. 

 Analytical thinking with strong problem-solving capabilities. 

 High attention to detail and commitment to quality excellence. 

 Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and projects in a fast-paced EPC environment. 

 Strong planning, organizational, and decision-making skills. 

 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 

 Compliance with project quality objectives and client specifications. 

 Reduction in quality defects and Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs). 

 Timely closure of CAPA and audit observations. 

 Successful completion of client, third-party, and certification audits. 

 Vendor quality performance and material acceptance rates. 

 On-time submission of quality documentation for project handover. 

 Improvement in customer satisfaction and project quality metrics. 

 Preferred Industry Experience 

 Candidates with experience in power transmission EPC organizations, utilities, or infrastructure companies involved in transmission line and substation projects will be preferred. 

 Travel Requirement 

 Frequent travel to project sites across India as required for inspections, audits, quality reviews, and client interactions.

Key Responsibilities 

 Lead the Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) function for transmission line and substation projects. 

 Develop, implement, and maintain project-specific Quality Plans (QAP), Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), Method Statements, and quality procedures. 

 Ensure compliance with project specifications, client requirements, applicable Indian Standards (IS), IEC, IEEE, ISO 9001, and statutory regulations. 

 Oversee quality inspections for civil, structural, electrical, mechanical, erection, testing, and commissioning activities. 

 Monitor supplier and vendor quality performance, conduct vendor evaluations, and ensure material quality compliance. 

 Review and approve material inspection reports, factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), calibration records, and quality documentation. 

 Plan and conduct internal quality audits, supplier audits, and support external/client audits. 

 Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and ensure timely closure. 

 Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Construction, HSE, and Project Management teams to achieve project quality objectives. 

 Ensure complete quality documentation, inspection records, and turnover dossiers for project handover. 

 Monitor quality KPIs, analyze trends, and implement continuous improvement initiatives. 

 Lead, mentor, and develop site quality engineers, inspectors, and QA/QC teams. 

 Participate in client meetings, technical reviews, and project quality discussions. 

 Support bid and proposal teams by reviewing quality requirements during project tendering. 

 Required Qualifications 

 Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline. 

 Master's degree is an added advantage. 

 Certification as an ISO 9001 Lead Auditor is preferred. 

 Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt or equivalent quality certification is desirable. 

 Experience 

 Minimum 12 years of experience in QA/QC within transmission line and substation EPC projects. 

 Proven experience in EHV transmission projects (132 kV, 220 kV, 400 kV, 765 kV, and above). 

 Experience managing quality functions for multiple projects simultaneously. 

 Exposure to client inspections involving utilities such as Power Grid, State Transmission Utilities, or private developers. 

 Experience with EPC contractors in the power transmission sector is highly preferred. 

 Technical Skills 

 Strong knowledge of transmission line construction, substations, testing, commissioning, and quality control practices. 

 Thorough understanding of Indian Standards (IS), IEC, IEEE, ISO 9001, and client-specific quality requirements. 

 Expertise in quality documentation, inspection planning, welding inspections, material testing, FAT, SAT, and commissioning quality. 

 Knowledge of quality management tools such as RCA, CAPA, FMEA, 5 Why Analysis, and Statistical Process Control. 

 Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and ERP systems such as SAP or Oracle is desirable. 

 Ability to review engineering drawings, technical specifications, and quality documentation. 

 Leadership & Behavioral Competencies 

 Strong leadership and people management skills. 

 Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. 

 Analytical thinking with strong problem-solving capabilities. 

 High attention to detail and commitment to quality excellence. 

 Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and projects in a fast-paced EPC environment. 

 Strong planning, organizational, and decision-making skills. 

 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 

 Compliance with project quality objectives and client specifications. 

 Reduction in quality defects and Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs). 

 Timely closure of CAPA and audit observations. 

 Successful completion of client, third-party, and certification audits. 

 Vendor quality performance and material acceptance rates. 

 On-time submission of quality documentation for project handover. 

 Improvement in customer satisfaction and project quality metrics. 

 Preferred Industry Experience 

 Candidates with experience in power transmission EPC organizations, utilities, or infrastructure companies involved in transmission line and substation projects will be preferred. 

 Travel Requirement 

 Frequent travel to project sites across India as required for inspections, audits, quality reviews, and client interactions.

description:
Lead the shift. Elevate the guest experience. 

 Jack’s Point Hospitality is looking for an experienced Duty Manager to join our Guest Services team in Queenstown. 

 This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys being at the centre of the operation — ensuring guests receive a seamless, personalised experience while supporting the team and keeping the property running smoothly.

 As the senior on-shift contact for Front Office and Guest Services, you’ll take ownership of arrivals, departures and in-stay guest service, lead the team through each shift and confidently manage anything that comes your way.

 What you’ll be doing

 Lead the day-to-day operation of Front Office and Guest Services, ensuring smooth and efficient arrivals and departures through Opera Cloud. 

 Coordinate closely with Housekeeping, Guest Services and Porters to ensure rooms and guest services are ready for arriving guests. 

 Lead and support Guest Services Agents and Porters, providing direction, coaching and feedback throughout the shift. 

 Take ownership of guest issues and service recovery, resolving concerns promptly and professionally. 

 Proactively look for opportunities to enhance the guest experience and generate additional revenue through relevant upgrades, activities, services and local experiences. 

 Monitor guest satisfaction throughout the stay and anticipate and address issues before they escalate. 

 Coordinate operational issues with the relevant teams and suppliers, keeping the Rooms Division/Lodging Manager informed of significant matters. 

 Manage incidents, emergencies and security concerns in line with property procedures. 

 Complete shift handovers, incident reporting, payment reconciliation and end-of-shift checks, ensuring the property is secure and guest-ready. 

 Maintain strong communication across Rooms Division and the wider business, ensuring important guest information and outstanding matters are followed through. 

 Be a calm, professional and positive presence on shift, setting the standard for guest service and team performance.

 What we’re looking for

 You’ll be an experienced hospitality professional who is confident leading a team and making decisions when things don’t go to plan.

 Ideally, you’ll have:

 At least 12 months’ experience as a Duty Manager, Front Office Manager or senior guest services professional within a hotel or premium accommodation environment. 

 Proven experience supervising and supporting a team. 

 Excellent communication, interpersonal and conflict-resolution skills. 

 Strong organisational skills and attention to detail. 

 Confidence using property management systems and standard computer software. 

 A calm, solutions-focused approach and the ability to make sound decisions under pressure. 

 Flexibility to work across a 7-day roster, including evenings, weekends and public holidays.

 It would be great if you also have:

 Opera Cloud or similar PMS experience. 

 First aid certification. 

 A full New Zealand Driver Licence. 

 Knowledge of Queenstown’s attractions, activities and luxury travel offering.

 Why Jack’s Point Hospitality?

 This is an opportunity to join a growing hospitality operation in one of New Zealand’s most spectacular locations. 

 You’ll play an important role in shaping the guest experience while working alongside a team that values genuine hospitality, professionalism and getting the details right.

 Successful candidates will be offered competitive remuneration and the opportunity to progress in their career. The role is full-time permanent, with a minimum of 30 hours guaranteed per week, with flexibility to work weekends, public holidays and rostered early morning or late evening shifts as required by the business. 

 Ready to join us? 

 If you’re an experienced hospitality leader who enjoys taking ownership, supporting a team and creating memorable guest experiences, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now with your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience.
